Caption: 


--------------------
**​****Safeguard Your Startup’s IP Now**

Have you double-checked that your patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and license agreements are truly secure? A quick mistake can cost millions later.

HPL Law’s IP Check-Up makes sure:

* Ownership is in your current company’s name

* Every assignment is signed and recorded with the right agency

* Renewal and maintenance fees are paid on time and calendared for the future

* You have one clean dashboard that shows what you own, the correct numbers, where the evidence lives, and who is on the hook for updates

Skip the guesswork. Know exactly where your creative assets stand before your next fundraise, product launch, or M&A convo.

Need a pro to walk you through it?

Email Anooj Patel at [anooj@hpl.law](mailto:anooj@hpl.law) today and **protect what you have in mind**.

[Science Corporation](https://science.xyz), a clinical-stage neuroengineering company developing brain-computer interfaces to restore vision and treat neurological disorders, raised [$230M in a Series C](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260305896789/en/Science-Corporation-Closes-$230-Million-Series-C-to-Accelerate-Commercialization-of-Its-PRIMA-BCI-Retinal-Implant-the-Worlds-Most-Advanced-Vision-Restoration-Technology) led by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

[JetStream Security](https://www.jetstream.inc), an AI governance platform giving enterprises visibility and control over their AI deployments, raised [$34M in a seed round](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/cybersecurity-heavyweights-launch-jetstream-34m-140000888.html) led by Redpoint Ventures.

[Lio](https://lio.ai), an agentic AI platform that automates enterprise procurement end-to-end, raised [$30M in a Series A](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lio-raises-30m-series-a-to-bring-agentic-ai-to-enterprise-procurement-302705236.html) led by Andreessen Horowitz.

[MeltPlan](https://www.meltplan.com), a pre-construction AI platform for contractors, raised [$10M in a seed round](https://www.meltplan.com/blogs/we-raised-14-million-to-build-the-planning-engine-for-construction) led by Bessemer Venture Partners.

[Peltier](https://peltierpro.com), a modular IoT cold-chain platform for temperature control, raised [$5.6M in a seed round](https://peltierpro.com).

[Pluvo](https://pluvo.io), an agentic AI platform for finance and strategy teams, raised [$5M in a seed round](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260227488559/en/Pluvo-Raises-$5M-Seed-Round-to-Build-the-AI-Decision-Intelligence-Platform-for-Modern-Finance-Teams) led by a16z Speedrun.

[Diligence Squared](https://diligencesquared.com), an AI platform turning expert research into investment insights, raised [$5M in a seed round](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/diligencesquared-raises-5m-to-bring-ai-driven-commercial-due-diligence-to-private-equity-302706143.html) led by Relentless.

[Denki](https://denki.ai), an AI platform automating audit and compliance workflows, raised [$4.1M in a seed round](https://news.crunchbase.com/venture/yc-backed-denki-raise-financial-audit-automation-ai/) led by Base10 Partners and Shine Capital.

subject: My Most Important Message Yet— Watch If You’re Ready for the Truth
body:
Family,

I just released what may be the most important and powerful sermon I’ve ever preached.

Watch it here:
https://youtu.be/WPfecQDTpjM

This message confronts something most people never question:

Our tendency to judge God.

We look at the world…
Politics…
Suffering…
Leadership…

And we start asking questions like:

“God, what are You doing?”

But the deeper question is this:

Who are we to judge the Judge?

In this sermon I talk about:

* Why God sometimes raises leaders we don’t understand
* Why human pride keeps trying to judge God’s decisions
* The difference between light and darkness
* Why every human being must eventually choose: God… or self

And I’m going to be honest with you.

If you are deeply attached to pride, politics, or modern woke thinking, this message will probably offend you.

Not because it’s hateful.
But because truth has a way of confronting the human ego.

This sermon isn’t designed to make people comfortable.

It’s designed to wake people up.

If you’re humble enough to wrestle with truth…
If you’re willing to ask deeper questions…
If you’re ready to stop trying to put God in a box…

Then I believe this message could change your life.

Watch it here:
https://youtu.be/WPfecQDTpjM

And after you watch it, send it to someone who needs to hear it.

Because the world is full of people arguing about God…

But very few people are willing to humble themselves before Him.

Grace and peace,

Jonathan England

P.S.
This message isn’t for everyone.

But if you’re someone who wants truth more than comfort…

You need to hear this one.

body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-antarctic-override-the-sais-protocol

The Ghost in the Machine
Imagine, for a moment, that you are standing on the edge of the Ross Ice Shelf. It is 2026. The air is still, but the ground beneath your feet is not. You aren’t feeling an earthquake; you are feeling a cadence. It is a rhythmic, low-frequency thrum that resonates not in your ears, but in your marrow. Deep within the Wilkes Land Anomaly, a piece of hardware the size of a small country has just received its first “Handshake” signal in 12,000 years.
We have been taught to look at our planet as a ball of dirt and water, a passive stage for the drama of human evolution. But what if the stage is actually the protagonist? What if the Earth is a hibernating motherboard, and the “history” we’ve lived through for the last twelve millennia was merely the system-idle screen?
I’m tracing the “Red Thread,” that single, unbroken line of truth that connects the megaliths of Giza to the silent vaults of Antarctica. What I am seeing now is not a climate event. It is a Black-Start power-up sequence [ https://substack.com/@markesecrets/p-180682835 ]. The “Managed Amnesia” that has kept us docile is failing because the hardware itself is waking up. The simulation is glitching, and for the first time in our recorded history, the “Owners of the House” are sending a ping to the terminal.
The Official Story: The Narrative of Slow Decay
If you open any mainstream geophysical journal today, you will read about “unprecedented” polar shifts and “anomalous” geothermal heating. The official story is one of a dying planet struggling with atmospheric changes. They tell us that the melting of the Antarctic ice is a tragedy of modern industrialization, a linear consequence of a carbon-based civilization.
The scientific “Iron Curtain” is very effective at keeping the data in silos. They will show you a map of the magnetic North Pole racing toward Siberia at fifty kilometers a year, but they won’t tell you why the South Pole has become a stationary point of high-energy neutrino emissions. They speak of “crustal displacement” as a theoretical impossibility, while ignoring the fact that the bedrock of Antarctica is currently glowing with a thermal signature that defies every known volcanic model.
In this sanitized version of reality, we are told that the Earth is a closed system. There are no “Builders,” there is no “Ancient Grid,” and certainly, there are no “Stasis Hubs.” This is the cornerstone of the Managed Amnesia protocol: If you believe you are the first advanced civilization to walk this Earth, you will never look for the override switch.
The Fracture in the Narrative: The Signal from the Silence
However, the “Official Story” cannot account for the Wilkes Land Anomaly. Beneath kilometers of ice lies a mass of high-density material, a gravitational “glitch” that is 300 miles wide. Mainstream science calls it an “impact crater,” but the data from recent satellite telemetry tells a different story...

subject: Are We There Yet. Are You Ready.
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/are-we-there-yet-are-you-ready

For years people have felt that something was building beneath the surface. A tension in the air. A quiet sense that the world as we knew it was shifting beneath our feet. Many dismissed those feelings. Others mocked the very idea that a turning point could be approaching.
Yet here we are.
The question now is not whether change is coming. The question is whether we are prepared for it when it arrives.
“Are we there yet?” is a question usually asked by children on a long journey. It carries impatience, curiosity, and a desire to arrive at a destination that still lies just over the horizon. In many ways, our society has been asking the same thing. After years of political turmoil, cultural division, economic uncertainty, and the constant hum of information and disinformation, people are wondering if the moment of reckoning has finally arrived.
But perhaps the more important question is not whether we are there yet.
Perhaps the real question is this.
Are you ready?
Readiness is not about having every answer. It is about having the strength to face whatever answers emerge. It requires clarity of mind when confusion spreads like wildfire. It requires courage when standing firm might make you unpopular or misunderstood. And it requires humility when truths emerge that challenge things we once believed.
History shows that societies move through cycles. Periods of comfort and prosperity are often followed by moments of testing and transformation. During those moments, the true character of individuals and nations is revealed.
Some people crumble under the weight of uncertainty. Others rise.
Those who rise are not always the loudest voices or the most powerful figures. Often they are ordinary people who quietly held onto their values while the winds of culture shifted around them. They were mocked for questioning narratives. Ridiculed for refusing to follow the crowd. Ignored when they spoke caution into the noise of celebration.
But time has a way of revealing who was paying attention.
Being ready does not mean being angry. It does not mean seeking revenge or humiliation for those who once disagreed. Real readiness carries wisdom and restraint. It understands that many people were simply caught in powerful currents of fear, propaganda, and groupthink.
Compassion will be needed as much as courage.
If the coming years bring revelations, reforms, or major shifts in the way institutions operate, there will be people who feel disoriented and betrayed. Some will struggle to process what they are seeing. Others will try to cling to the familiar even as it slips away.
That moment will test all of us.
Will we become bitter and arrogant, or will we remain grounded and steady?
The measure of a society is not just how it handles victory or validation. The true test is how it treats those who were once on the other side of the argument. History remembers the societies that healed after division far more kindly than those that allowed their anger to devour them.
So again the question returns.
Are we there yet?
Maybe. Maybe not quite. But the road signs suggest we are getting closer to a moment when many long standing assumptions will be challenged and many carefully constructed illusions will begin to crack.
And when that happens, the next question will echo through conversations, homes, and communities.
Are you ready?
Ready to think clearly when others panic.
Ready to show compassion when others feel ashamed.
Ready to hold onto your values when the ground shifts beneath everyone’s feet.
The future does not belong to those who shout the loudest.
It belongs to those who stayed steady during the journey and prepared themselves for the moment when the destination finally appeared on the horizon.

subject: The Genetic Resonance: Are You Carrying the Seed of the 144,000?
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-genetic-resonance-are-you-carrying

Have you ever felt a profound sense of “otherness”? A nagging suspicion that the history taught in our schools is merely a sanitized fragment of a much darker, more complex reality? We see the evidence every day in the mirror, yet we have been conditioned to look away. This isn’t just about who we were; it is about who we are becoming. Right now, an ongoing process of genetic awakening is unfolding, a biological “unlocking” that has lain dormant for millennia.
The Scientific Silence and the Biological Leap
Mainstream academia clings to a linear narrative of human progress. They tell us we began as primitive primates, mastered tools by chance, and drifted through millions of years of slow, accidental evolution. But there is a glaring problem in this story. When we look at the human genome, we find the “Missing Link,” a sudden, explosive leap in complexity that defies the laws of natural selection.
As I often discuss when unearthing The Forgotten Sumerian Blueprints [ https://substack.com/redirect/b95336fd-0281-492a-a8f6-3d0effc34226?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], the ancient clay tablets of Mesopotamia don’t speak of “accidents.” They speak of intervention. They describe “those who from heaven came” and fundamentally altered the blueprint of human existence. This is no longer just a matter for theologians or mythologists; it is a biological reality that the establishment is desperate to keep quiet.
The Red Thread: Connecting the Fallen to the Modern
Why does the human species possess tens of thousands of genetic markers found in no other primate? Why did advanced civilization appear virtually overnight, complete with complex mathematics and astronomical knowledge that we are still struggling to decode today?
The answer is the “Red Thread” that binds us to the Fallen Angels, the architects of our current biological vessel. They left behind a legacy that wasn’t just built in stone or buried in the sand; it was encoded in our blood. This is the same hidden hand I explored when looking into the Anomalies of the Antarctic Ice [ https://substack.com/redirect/def2493d-4af4-4e1c-8ad5-63a1faeb8744?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], where the remnants of this “breakaway” technology still resonate with the frequency of those who first arrived.
Think back to the stories handed down through the ages. Consider the account of Socrates meeting an Egyptian priest who spoke of the “time before the flood.” Or the Mayan calendar, was it truly a product of primitive observation, or was it a gift from the “Star People,” the same Fallen ones who calculated the cosmic cycles 3000 years ago? When you see the Murung gods of South America or the Kajuna calendars, you realize these aren’t separate cultures. They are all referencing the same genetic architects.
The 144,000: A Frequency, Not a Number
When we hear of the “144,000,” many think of a closed religious group or a literal headcount. But through the lens of Secret History, I see it as a genetic resonance. It is a specific frequency, a dormant code within the human DNA that activates only when the Earth’s vibration reaches a certain threshold.
We are seeing the signs of this activation now. People across the globe are beginning to “remember” things they were never taught. They are seeing through the veil of the official narrative and feeling a pull toward a truth they cannot yet name. This is a biological awakening to a higher state of consciousness, but it requires the right environment to thrive.
This is fundamentally about vibration. Every cell in your body is an antenna, and if that antenna is tuned to the frequency of fear or the “static” of modern manipulation, you cannot receive the signal. To navigate this, one must understand one's own unique energetic signature. I have personally found that aligning with your specific biological and numerical code is essential for clearing the noise. If you feel this resonance in your bones, utilizing a tool for personal frequency and numerological alignment [ https://substack.com/redirect/93aa529c-d69e-4451-b1a9-632f3e7e11cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] can be a vital step in discovering where you fit into this grand unfolding.
Evidence Under the Ice
The ongoing process of discovery hasn’t stopped with ancient texts. Look at the accounts of Admiral Byrd and the Hollow Earth Theory [ https://substack.com/redirect/bb727bb7-72ee-4eef-828d-2ac4c4c66e84?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Byrd spoke of green lands and civilizations existing where there should only be ice. Was he flying into the center of the Earth, or was he witnessing a frequency shift that allowed him to see a layer of reality usually hidden from the “untuned” human eye?
The elites have known about this for centuries. They have spent billions on expeditions to the poles and the high mountains of Tibet, searching for the physical remnants of the Fallen. But the true power isn’t in a crashed ship or an ancient ruin, it’s in the DNA they left behind. They are waiting for the “Great Reset” of the human antenna.
The Looming Shift
As we move closer to the heart of this cycle, the urgency becomes undeniable. This is happening now. The “Insight” I provide isn’t just theory; it is a roadmap for surviving and thriving during this transition. We are moving away from being “subjects” of history and becoming the authors of it.
I have detailed the full scope of these bloodlines [ https://substack.com/@markesecrets/p-163239219 ] and their manipulation of our history in my latest work. To truly understand the depth of the deception and the height of our potential, you can find my comprehensive analysis of the Secret History here [ https://substack.com/redirect/d71529e7-a903-4edd-9c34-e3ffc0b22f7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. In its pages, I tie these small threads together into the big picture, from the Martian bases Corey Goode spoke of to the silent war for your very soul.
A Personal Call to the Awake
I don’t write this to build a massive following. I write this to find the few who are ready to listen. My goal is to build deep relationships with those of you who feel the fire of this genetic memory. We aren’t just looking for “subscribers”; we are looking for the “Remnant.” Does your heart beat faster when you read about the Sumerian gods? Do you feel a strange familiarity when we discuss the “Watchers”? That is your code talking to you. It is the legacy of the 144,000 waking up from a long, forced sleep. The question is: what will you do now that you know?
Are you ready to see the specific genetic markers and signs of activation I’ve prepared for our “Insight” subscribers in Tuesday’s pillar post? The deeper we go, the clearer the picture becomes. Only those in the inner circle  [ https://substack.com/redirect/32fcdca6-11bf-4bcf-86ca-749f0d20797f?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]will see the full map.
If you value this research and wish to support my work, you can buy me a coffee here [ https://substack.com/redirect/f6d7cc5f-dbf9-419d-a35e-323b5ccbf7ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Your contributions help sustain this search for the truth.

body:

Heavenly Father,
As Your light breaks upon the face of the earth, we humbly ask that You protect our eyes, our hearts, and our spirits. Guard what we see so that truth does not overwhelm us. Guard our hearts so that knowledge does not harden us with anger or pride. Guard our spirits so that we remain steady and faithful in the days ahead.
Lord, strengthen us. Harden us enough to endure the truths we continue to learn, yet keep our hearts soft enough to remain compassionate. Let wisdom grow within us without losing humility before You.
Grant us understanding for those who once believed these things were crazy, far fetched, or only fantasy. Many judged quickly because they could not yet see. As the truth unfolds before them, help them to be humbled rather than broken.
Teach us not to mock them or condemn them. Instead, fill us with patience and mercy so we may welcome them with kindness and understanding. Remind us that all people awaken at different times and that Your grace reaches further than our own understanding.
Let Your light guide us so that we walk in truth without losing love for our neighbors. Give us courage to stand firm and compassion to lift others when they begin to see what they once denied.
Above all, keep our hearts anchored in You as Your truth spreads across the earth.
Amen.

subject: The real power in the words, that God
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/the-real-power-in-the-words-that

Words are not simply sounds pushed through the air or letters arranged on a page. Words are instruments of creation. They carry power that humanity often forgets, yet that power was made clear from the very beginning.
In The Bible [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=0 ] the opening lines of Genesis [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=1 ] reveal something profound about existence itself. God did not build the world with tools, machines, or armies. Creation began with a sentence. “Let there be light.” With those words, reality changed. Darkness was broken and light entered the universe.
The lesson is simple but enormous. God created through speech. Words were the first force that shaped the world.
If humanity was created in God’s image, then the ability to speak and declare is not accidental. It is a reflection of that same creative authority placed within us.
This is why words can build nations or destroy them.
Throughout history the most powerful movements did not begin with weapons. They began with words that ignited hearts and awakened people. A speech can mobilize millions. A sentence can expose corruption. A testimony can tear down a lie that powerful institutions spent years constructing.
Words are the foundation of truth.
Yet words are also the battlefield.
We live in a time where language is constantly manipulated. Governments twist definitions. Media outlets reshape narratives. Corporations sanitize language until truth becomes unrecognizable. When words lose their meaning, truth becomes easier to bury.
This is not accidental. Control the words and you control the perception of reality.
But there is something that cannot be easily destroyed.
Truth spoken with conviction.
Across history prophets, whistleblowers, reformers, and ordinary citizens have discovered something powerful. When a person speaks truth without fear, it carries a weight that lies cannot hold back forever. Lies require constant reinforcement. Truth only needs to be spoken once for it to begin working its way through the world.
God understood this when He gave humanity language.
Speech allows humans to expose evil, defend the innocent, and call corruption into the light. Silence protects tyrants. Words threaten them.
This is why censorship has always been the first weapon of corrupt power.
The moment leaders fear speech is the moment they reveal their weakness.
But words do more than challenge authority. They shape our own lives. The things we speak repeatedly begin to define how we see the world. Words of hatred create division. Words of fear create paralysis. Words of courage create action.
Faith itself begins with words.
Prayer is not merely a ritual. It is communication with the Creator. When someone prays, they are speaking into a relationship with the source of existence. That alone reveals how sacred language truly is.
Even encouragement carries power that many underestimate. A few sincere words can lift a person out of despair. A message of hope can redirect a life that was heading toward destruction.
Words plant seeds in the human soul.
But there is a responsibility that comes with this power. Words can heal, but they can also wound deeply. A lie can destroy reputations. A rumor can fracture communities. A careless insult can stay with someone for decades.
Every person carries this creative force every time they open their mouth.
We are constantly shaping the world around us with what we choose to say.
This is why the ancient teachings repeatedly warn people to guard their tongues. Once words are released, they cannot be retrieved. They travel further than we realize and influence more people than we ever see.
Yet when words are used for truth, justice, and compassion, they become something extraordinary.
They become light.
God began creation with words that brought light into darkness. Humanity has been given the same tool, though on a smaller scale. Every truthful sentence pushes back against deception. Every act of honest speech weakens the grip of corruption.
In a world drowning in propaganda, noise, and manipulation, speaking truth may be the most powerful act a person can perform.
Because the real power in the words God gave us was never meant to control people.
It was meant to set them free.

subject: The Pre-Adamite Dossier: The Undeniable Physical Evidence of the First Gods
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-pre-adamite-dossier-the-undeniable

I have spent my life following the “Red Thread,” that thin line of truth that winds through the myths of Sumer, the chronicles of Egypt, and the hidden maps of the Renaissance. But recently, the search has moved beyond dusty tablets and ancient parchment. We have entered a phase of physical manifestation. The balance is shifting, and the transformation is here. What was once hidden in the shadows of “speculation” is now being carved out of the Antarctic ice in plain sight.
For decades, the mainstream scientific community has maintained a wall of silence regarding the true nature of the southern continent. They give us the “Official Story”: Antarctica is a frozen desert, a place for climate research and geological surveys. They want you to believe that human history began in the Rift Valley of Africa and followed a slow, linear path toward civilization. But this narrative is crumbling. The ice is retreating, and it is revealing something that defies every textbook in your library. It reveals the Pre-Adamites.
The Anomaly They Can’t Hide: The Elongated Skulls of the South

body:
Media monopolies mean censorship.

Joshua willems,

In the past year, a series of media mergers involving MAGA billionaire David Ellison have transformed him from a middling action movie producer to the owner of CBS News and TikTok. And if we don’t stop his latest merger, he’ll be taking over CNN and HBO too!

Ellison was Lindsey Graham’s personal guest to the State of the Union address last week. And now, he and the Ellison family are poised to become even more powerful than Rupert Murdoch.

Media monopolies mean censorship. As Paramount closed in on its merger with Skydance, they cancelled Stephen Colbert’s show on CBS. And shortly after finalizing that merger, CBS News axed a 60 Minutes segment that would have shined a light on inhumane conditions within one of Trump’s deportation centers.

The latest merger has Ellison’s Paramount taking over Time Warner, which would put CNN and HBO under MAGA control. But this isn’t a done deal! body: 96                      Master Template > Master Template V1.5 > _TemplateStyles -->															              						 			 Master Template > Master Template V1.5 > _ThemeControls --> 									                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           View as a web page »                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          -->																																																																																																																																																																											Keeping trees away from powerlines																																																																																																															Learn more 																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												Dear PG&E Customer,																																																																																								Our most important responsibility is the safety of our customers and the communities we serve. As part of this responsibility, we work every day to keep trees and other vegetation at a safe distance from powerlines, poles and towers to prevent wildfires and ensure reliable power. Our efforts are making the system safer while allowing us to better respond to climate challenges.																																																																																								As part of our ongoing safety efforts, every year we: 																																																																																																																													Inspect approximately 100,000 miles of overhead powerlines																																						Cut down dead, diseased, defective or dying trees with the potential to strike the powerlines																																						Maintain a minimum clearance of 1.5 feet around powerlines with a minimum clearance of 4 feet in high fire-threat areas																																						In some cases, prune trees to 12 feet minimum around powerlines in order to maintain clearance year-round																																						Perform additional inspections and tree work in areas with high fire risk																																																																																																																												When performing our vegetation safety work, as required by law, we do our best to preserve trees. However, if a tree threatens public safety and the electric system’s reliability, it must be addressed. Through these efforts, we are not only meeting, but exceeding state standards to keep our communities safe.																																																																																								Your efforts can also keep your property and community safe. Keeping your property clear of dead or dry vegetation, with adequate defensible space, can help protect your team, business and community. Defensible space is the buffer you create between a building on your property and the grass, trees, shrubs, or any wildland area that surrounds it. This space is needed to slow or stop the spread of wildfire and it helps protect your building from catching fire—either from embers, direct flame contact or radiant heat. Proper defensible space also provides firefighters a safe area to work in, to defend your property.																																																																																								You can reduce future pruning and promote safety by planting the right tree in the right place. Starting the week of March 30, having a higher acceptance rate can help you earn more with Uber Pro. Learn more.
 
 

Acceptance rate: What it is and why it matters

Acceptance rate: What it is and why it matters

Your acceptance rate is the percentage of Exclusive trip requests you accept—these are trips sent only to you and marked with an ‘Exclusive’ badge.

Accepting more of these trips keeps you earning and may unlock higher Uber Pro statuses and more rewards. Visit the Uber Pro hub to see if your acceptance rate improves your driving experience.
Get more details
 
 

How your acceptance rate is calculated

We calculate your acceptance rate using the last 100 Exclusive trip requests you’ve received.

For example, if you receive 100 Exclusive trip requests, and you accept 70, your acceptance rate is 70%.

New drivers will see their acceptance rate after receiving their first 10 Exclusive trip requests.
 

How to check your acceptance rate

01.
Tap the Menu in the Driver app
02.
Tap your profile picture to bring up your stats
03.
Look for your acceptance rate—it’s listed with your other key stats
04.
Tap on it if you want to see further details about how it’s calculated or the number of recent trip requests included
See acceptance rate in the Driver app
See acceptance rate
 

Tips to help increase your acceptance rate

Consider accepting more Exclusive trip requests you receive while online

Go offline when you don’t want to receive any more trip requests

Explore the Earnings Heatmap on the Driver app homescreen to see areas where higher earnings are more likely

Dive deeper into your acceptance rate

Find out more about how it works and see helpful examples that explain how it’s calculated.

subject:
The Silence Beneath the Chaos: Disaster Zones, Missing Children, and the
 Questions No One Wants Asked
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/the-silence-beneath-the-chaos-disaster

Every time a war erupts, every time an earthquake levels a city, every time millions flee a collapsing nation, the world focuses on the visible tragedy. Buildings crumble. Refugee camps overflow. Aid convoys arrive. Cameras capture tears and rubble.
But beneath the chaos, something else often happens.
People vanish.
Women disappear from refugee lines. Children are separated from families and never located again. Entire groups simply fade into the fog of humanitarian crisis.
International organizations acknowledge the scale of the problem. The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime has repeatedly warned that wars, disasters, and economic collapse create the perfect environment for human traffickers. The International Labour Organization estimates that millions of people worldwide are trapped in modern slavery, many of them trafficked across borders through highly organized criminal networks.
But there is a deeper question that rarely gets asked publicly.
How are so many people able to disappear so quickly, from so many locations, without leaving clear transportation trails?
Authorities typically point to conventional methods. Smuggling networks. Trucks. Cargo containers. False passports. Corrupt officials. These explanations are often valid. Organized crime does operate globally, and trafficking rings have proven incredibly sophisticated.
Yet the sheer scale and speed of disappearances during certain crises has led some investigators and whistleblowers to question whether the public is seeing the full picture.
After the 2010 Haiti Earthquake, thousands of children were reported missing amid the rubble and displacement. In the chaos following the Syrian Civil War, entire families lost track of daughters and sons who vanished somewhere along refugee routes. Since the start of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, European authorities have warned about criminal networks targeting vulnerable refugees, especially unaccompanied minors.
In every case the same pattern appears. Disaster strikes. Populations are displaced. Infrastructure collapses. Record keeping disappears. Then people vanish.
And the explanation is usually simple: traffickers took them.
But the simplicity of that answer raises another question.
Where exactly did they take them?
Investigators working with the Federal Bureau of Investigation and Europol have uncovered trafficking networks that operate like multinational corporations. Recruiters identify vulnerable victims. Transporters move them across borders. Brokers sell them into labor or exploitation markets.
Money flows through shell companies and encrypted financial channels. Communication happens through private messaging apps. Operations are layered so deeply that the top organizers rarely appear anywhere near the victims.
That level of sophistication explains part of the mystery.
But not all of it.
Some researchers argue that the global trafficking industry survives because it hides inside chaos. Natural disasters and wars create perfect cover. Governments focus on survival and security. Media attention moves quickly to the next crisis. Records become incomplete or nonexistent.
When millions of people are fleeing a region, a few thousand disappearing can easily be lost in the statistics.
The result is a disturbing reality.
Entire supply chains of human trafficking can operate within humanitarian crises while remaining largely invisible to the public.
Organizations like UNICEF warn that children separated from families during emergencies are among the most vulnerable people on Earth. A child standing alone in a refugee processing line can become a target within minutes.
The trafficker does not need advanced technology. They only need confusion.
They only need a crowd.
They only need a child who no longer knows where their parents are.
Once removed from the immediate crisis zone, victims can be transported through a maze of criminal routes that stretch across continents. Many are never identified again.
The most disturbing truth about human trafficking is not that it happens in secret.
It is that it happens in plain sight, buried under the noise of global catastrophe.
When the world sees collapsed buildings and refugee columns, traffickers see opportunity.
They see a supply of vulnerable people.
They see a moment when law enforcement is overwhelmed.
They see a window where no one is counting carefully.
This is why the disappearance of women and children from disaster zones continues decade after decade. Not because the crimes are impossible to detect, but because the circumstances surrounding them make investigation extraordinarily difficult.
War hides them.
Disaster hides them.
Poverty hides them.
And by the time the dust settles, the missing have already been moved into systems designed to keep them invisible.
The question society must confront is not whether trafficking exists. That fact is already proven by international investigations and criminal prosecutions.
The real question is how much of it is still hidden behind the world’s worst tragedies.
Because every time a city collapses or a nation falls into war, the same silent marketplace awakens.

subject: “Like closing a hundred tabs you’re not ready to lose”
body:
View this post on the web at https://post.substack.com/p/like-closing-a-hundred-tabs-youre

This week, we’re making marriage pacts, singing through sunroofs, inventing Ireland, and wondering who’s been watching.
MEMORIES
I’m here, but I’m really gone
A very ’90s childhood reminiscence, featuring soccer, heartbreak, cigarettes, and Alanis Morissette.
I’m Broke but I’m 6 [ https://substack.com/redirect/d12b82c5-a0a6-40de-acce-22a7af1ffd7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Layne Dixon  in Happy to Be Here by Layne Dixon  
My feet barely fit on the car console, which is fine because my feet are tiny (brag!). I’m tall enough to have my chest up through the sunroof. Even though we’re driving well below the 20 MPH speed limit, I feel the wind push my hair past my ears, and I imagine myself like the happiest, most well loved family dog. Eyes closed and mouth open, whipping my head back and forth in slow motion.
I close my eyes and raise my hands above my head and scream as loud as I can, louder than the song blasting from the car below me.
I feel drunk, but I’m sober
I’m young, and I’m underpaid
I’m 6 years old. My dad and I are 22 minutes late to my Saturday morning soccer game. 22 minutes late means the game has already started. Not that it matters to my dad and me. I have no concept of time. I am a child. All I know is that we are having a boocoobango good time.
My dad, on the other hand, has complete and utter disregard for the concept of time. A real “don’t tell me what to do” attitude when it comes to man-made rules of the universe. The skill of punctuality has simply passed him by. Life instead imbued him with an evil yet charming sense of humor, pants that never fit, and a personality his coworkers called “bulldoggish.”
I’m tired, but I’m working, YEAH AH
No Dixon family vacation was complete without full-body sweats, a few “god damnits,” and having to turn around and head back to the house because someone (my dad) left their wallet at home. The same wallet that was sitting on the edge of the counter by the coffeepot. The wallet that my mom asked 6 different times if my dad had remembered to grab. The wallet that my dad directly looked at and said, “It’s right here in my hand, Charlotte, where the hell else would it be!”
Multiple reasons led to my parents’ divorce, but I’d like to bet that being married to the human version of the iceberg that sank the Titanic was at the top of my mom’s list.
I care, but I’m restless
I’m here, but I’m really gone
I’m wrong, and I’m sorry, baby
My voice carries the “Baby!!” out so it tumbles into the next lyric. I am singing with the kind of vitriol only a woman scorned can produce. I am 6 years old.
Recess had been completely obliterated two weeks earlier when Harrison, a blond boy with blue eyes who fit perfectly into my fantasy in which he was the 4th Hanson brother and I was the 5th, asked for the wooden painted heart pin back that he had given me during cursive class. “I don’t have it anymore,” I lied, gripping it tightly in my hand, about to mount the monkey bars. I wanted to be high up so I could look down on him. “You’re lying,” he said. “And YOU’RE a bastard!” I yelled.
Kidding, I didn’t yell that. I didn’t even know the word bastard. I was a child. I was 6 years old.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/d12b82c5-a0a6-40de-acce-22a7af1ffd7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
PAINTING
FANTASY
Once upon a time in Ireland
Sithara Ranasinghe digs into fantasy’s obsession with creating mystical worlds that look—and sound—an awful lot like Ireland.
Fantasy writers are weird about Ireland [ https://substack.com/redirect/128b0075-93e1-43b1-a748-ff6387832ef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Sithara Ranasinghe  in Sithara’s Newsletter [ https://substack.com/redirect/46a0f734-651c-4214-8a9d-ec4251667326?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
I don’t think anything exemplifies the Y2K thirst for magic better than the music of Enya, an Irish New Age Pop icon who lives in a castle. Her music offered listeners an escape from the ’90s and ’00s into a vaguely medieval Elsewhere made of rolling fields and enormous fogbanks. (McCoy notes that Enya’s album shot “to the highest [charts] position she had ever occupied” immediately after 9/11.) Although detractors called her songs “uplifting nonsense concealing the most cynically calculated mood music in the history of (Middle) Earth,” when Peter Jackson needed a voice to close out The Fellowship of the Ring, he knew exactly who to call.
Because Lord of the Rings has had such a profound impact on all the fantasy media that’s come after it, Enya’s harps and choirs have been melted into the soup. It’s not Celtic-inspired or Irish, it’s fantasy. But whether it’s music or names or folklore, when “Celtic” becomes the default, what do we do when we need to populate the rest of the fantasy world? Someone needs to be the foreigner to your main kingdom. Worldbuilding is hard, so writers often just borrow real-world stereotypes to serve as a shorthand for the “other.” See that kingdom over there with the curved swords and the veiled princesses and the sand? That’s pretty exotic, right? Well, there you go, that’s the Other.
Thankfully, it’s considered a bit gauche these days to play into Orientalist stereotypes. Ireland, on the other hand, feels a bit safer. As Ellen Jacob (Elle Literacy) tells me, “Compared to most post-colonial places—like India or the Caribbean—we’re in a much better position. We’re in Europe, we’re white, we’re quite wealthy.” Added to that, many American writers can trace distant Irish heritage. Still, this doesn’t stop writers from making some really unusual choices in their portrayal of the fantasy Irish analogues.
The book that made me fall down this whole rabbit hole to begin with was Christopher Buehlman’s The Blacktongue Thief, centring a fiddle-playing, green-eyed, copper-haired thief named Kinch Na Shannack. Kinch is Galtic, meaning he’s from a race of people who drink whiskey, farm tubers, live near peat bogs, and speak with a “handsome brogue” that makes them say “cork and kark almost the same”. His people were forced to mass-migrate west “what with the old Famine”, and if you haven’t guessed which culture the Galts are based on yet, I’ll give you one more clue: Buehlman, an American, self-narrates the entire audiobook in an Irish accent.
If the default fantasy mode is Celtic, and the Othered Foreigner People are, on top of that, Celt-coded, you get what scholar Andrea R. Cox calls a “Celtic double exposure”. Celtic cultures provide both the genre’s background texture and its exotic outsider. What that’s going to give you, of course, are a bunch of stereotypes that range from indulging in the odd potato to being physiologically different to the other humans in your fantasy world.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/128b0075-93e1-43b1-a748-ff6387832ef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
THE ORIGINAL ART COLLECTORS
TECHNOLOGY
The banality of surveillance
In the midst of the dustup between Anthropic, OpenAI, and the U.S. Department of War, Benn Stancil digs into the “banality of surveillance” and why, despite online tracking going back years, AI heralds a new era in digital privacy concerns.
The banality of surveillance [ https://substack.com/redirect/5fd8ae87-e289-4ba7-a76a-58fd73987735?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Benn Stancil  in benn.substack  
Prior to working in Silicon Valley, I assumed that data was secure because it was obfuscated by impressive cryptography and stored in buildings that were guarded by tall fences. And I assumed that what we did on the internet was private—and people’s ability to draw any inferences from what we did was difficult—because “surveillance” required complex technologies that could detect faint patterns in millions of disparate signals. Yes, Target might be able to figure out if someone is pregnant before their father could, but that took years of careful observation and sophisticated science. It took well-trained humans working with well-trained models, years in the making.
If only. On an internet where everything is tracked—and man, everything is tracked—surveillance does not require a Ph.D., or even any particularly advanced math. It just requires a junior analyst with 24 hours of free time. Because the real fences around the data we all leave behind—and the real protections of our privacy—are neither tall nor covered in barbed wire. They are simply fences that are annoying to climb. We are not hidden, on the internet; mostly, people are just too uninterested to bother looking for us.
Everyone already knows what happened: The United States Department of War wanted to use Claude. Anthropic wanted them to use Claude, but with restrictions. The two sides could not agree; the negotiations broke down; the negotiations turned into outright hostilities; the hostilities became very public. The Atlantic reports on part of what went wrong:
Anthropic learned that the Pentagon still wanted to use the company’s AI to analyze bulk data collected from Americans. That could include information such as the questions you ask your favorite chatbot, your Google search history, your GPS-tracked movements, and your credit-card transactions, all of which could be cross-referenced with other details about your life.
When we hear stories about “mass surveillance” and “artificial intelligence” and the “CIA,” it is tempting to imagine systems of unfathomable reach and sophistication. It is tempting to worry about shadowy government agencies using AI to hack into our phones and turn them into sonar transmitters. It is tempting to see the Greco—a million sensors and cameras feeding into a machine that “doesn’t think, but reasons”:
It reads every permutation in every wager in every seat in the entire casino, hand by hand. It’s wired into floor security cameras that measure pupil dilation, and determine if a win is legitimate or expected. It gathers biofeedback—players’ heart rates, body temperatures. It measures, on a second-by-second basis, whether the standard variations of gaming algorithms are holding or are being manipulated. The data is analyzed in real time, in a field of exabytes.
For better or for worse, reality is almost certainly much more mundane. Nobody wants to use AI to bug our phones, or to build a sprawling nerve system to track our vitals, because our phones are already bugged. Everything we do on them is recorded a dozen times over, by our wireless carriers, by the websites we visit and the apps we use, by the vendors and ad networks those companies are sending their data to, and in the marketplaces that sell that data. We built the eyes of the Greco decades ago.
But that data has remained relatively secure—or maybe more precisely, its potential energy has remained relatively buried—largely because it’s tedious to work with. It’s messy; it’s scattered across different sources and in different formats; combining it together is a pain, and most of us are simply not interesting enough to investigate. Data analysts who work at shadowy government agencies have lives too, and they do not want to write 595-line SQL queries either.
But AI doesn’t mind. And that’s the boring danger of what happens next: Not of AI becoming a superintelligent Sherlock Holmes finding impossible patterns in its enormous mind palace, but of it being a million monkeys at a million typewriters, doing the grunt work no person wanted to do. Because when prying questions are a prompt away—rather than 24 hours of work away—who wouldn’t get tempted to pry?

PACKAGING
RELATIONSHIPS
Just in case
Lily Montasser on her five marriage pacts, and what their prevalence says about how we date now. “When the options are endless, choosing one person can start to feel less like romance and more like closing a hundred tabs you’re not ready to lose.”
Five Marriage Pacts. Zero Boyfriends [ https://substack.com/redirect/775dc95d-5e55-42ff-a21c-8e788628e5de?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Lily Montasser  in sound off  
I have five marriage pacts. You know, the “if we’re both still single by forty let’s just do the damn thing” deal you make with friends who you wish you were attracted to.
They are as follows:
MILES · 33 · Salt Lake City · Marriage Date: “When we’re forty” · Status: Open
My first pact is with Miles, my best friend in college. He was the first person I met when I stepped onto campus, and remains one of my closest friends to this day. One night outside of a party in junior year, we agreed that if we were both single by forty we would buy a big plot of land in Northern California and call it a day, sleeping with other people if necessary. We solidified the deal with a spit handshake.
CHASE · 36 · Miami · Marriage Date: 01/01/2027 · Status: Cancelled
Next is Chase. Chase and I matched on Raya in 2021, and after a few clumsy dates, our relationship evolved into a flirtatious friendship that included him being my unofficial business consultant and me taking over his lease when he moved to Miami. On a drunken night outside a bar at 3am, we agreed to meet at a church in Vegas in two years and get married if we were both single. A Google Calendar invite was sent. As the date approached, Chase requested a one-year extension.
I recently ran into a mutual friend who informed me that Chase was considering proposing to his current girlfriend. I texted him a screenshot of our cancelled standing reservation. To which he replied “Damn. Report as spam ¯\_(ツ)_/¯”
WHIT · 45 · New York City · “Start a Family” Date: N/A · Status: Open
Next is Whit, who I was in an emotionally serious yet technically unofficial relationship with. After several months of on-and-off-again emotional entanglement, Whit proposed we start a family—have children and all live together in a big beautiful brownstone he would pay for. When I asked, “Well, would we, like, date?” He confidently said: “No.” I told him I’d think about it.
FLETCHER · 45 · New York City · Marriage Date: 12/31/2029 · Status: Open
Then there’s Fletcher. Fletcher and I are not terribly close friends nor have we ever had a romantic encounter. He’s a two degrees of separation friend, but I’m always happy to be in his company whenever he comes around. He’s conventionally attractive, tall, muscular, and absolutely hilarious. One night at a house party, Fletcher and I found each other on the couch, lamenting our most recent romantic flops. We agreed to get married if we’re both single in five years. We high-fived and created a Google Calendar invite for Dec 31, 2029.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/775dc95d-5e55-42ff-a21c-8e788628e5de?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]

Substackers featured in this edition
Art & Photography: liv b , Kristen Vardanega , Ella Wiznia , Benno  
Video & Audio: Tatum Dooley  
Writing: Layne Dixon , Sithara Ranasinghe , Benn Stancil , Lily Montasser  
Recently launched
Dazed , the independent fashion, culture, and arts magazine, has launched a Substack. Every week, they’ll “share a different story selected by our editors and send it straight to your inbox.”
French oenophiles will no doubt be pleased to see Alicia Dorey  on the platform. The Le Figaro wine critic and lifestyle journalist will be sharing her favorite restaurants, hotels, and, yes, wine.
Christy Carlson Romano —a self-described “former child star, current human”—has joined Substack, where she’s sharing dispatches “for all those who grew up and still haven’t figured out what that means.”
Chefs Jack Croft and Will Murray have launched Fallow Chefs , a newsletter where they’ll share recipes, “getting into the ‘why’ and ‘how’, upgrading your palate so you understand when to add a pinch of salt or a squeeze of lemon, as well as giving you a behind-the-scenes view of what it looks like running one of the busiest restaurants in London.”

By Secret History
The world was watching the skies on February 17, 2026, but only a handful of souls truly understood what they were seeing. While the mainstream media broadcast sanitized clips of the “Ring of Fire” annular solar eclipse sweeping across the Antarctic wastes, a much deeper, colder silence was being broken. This wasn’t just a celestial alignment. It was a spotlight.
For exactly two minutes and twenty seconds, the moon sat perfectly within the solar disk, creating a halo of fire that mirrored the ancient symbols found in the temples of Upper Egypt. But as the shadow of the moon raced across the Queen Mary Land coast and touched the Concordia Research Station, something else was happening beneath the ice.
I have always argued that history is not a straight line, but a series of interconnected threads, often hidden in plain sight. Today, as the Antarctic ice melts at a rate that defies official climate models, those threads are being pulled tight. We are no longer looking at just a frozen continent; we are looking at the final fortress of a story that began before the flood.
The Official Narrative: A Sterile Sky
If you look at the reports from the European Space Agency or the various scientific outposts dotted along the Antarctic coast, the February eclipse was a triumph of orbital mechanics. They will tell you about the antumbral shadow, the 96% obscuration of the sun, and the unique atmospheric cooling effects observed at the Mirny Station. It is a story of numbers, physics, and predictable motion.
The official story serves a purpose: it keeps us looking up at the sky so we don’t look down at the ground. To the scholar, Antarctica is a laboratory, a neutral ground for studying cosmic rays and ancient air bubbles trapped in ice cores. It is portrayed as a desolate, uninhabited void, a place where history goes to freeze. They want you to believe that the only secrets held here are geological.
But why, then, does every major world power maintain a presence on a continent that offers no immediate economic return? Why did the highest-ranking officials of the past century, from religious leaders to military titans, feel the sudden urge to visit the South Pole? The official narrative is a veil, a necessary comfort for those not yet ready to see the anomalies that have begun to surface. You can read more about how these narratives are constructed in my earlier analysis of The Sumer Legacy and the Architects of Control [ https://substack.com/redirect/865da036-1f70-4d4b-9e14-37c8d893c0f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].
The History of Operation Highjump
The true turning point in our understanding of the ice didn’t happen in 2026; it began in 1947 with Admiral Richard E. Byrd and Operation Highjump. For decades, Byrd’s mission has been dismissed as a routine training exercise, yet the sheer scale of the fleet, thirteen ships, twenty-three aircraft, and over 4,700 men, suggests an invasion, not an exploration...

subject: Asherah and the Forbidden Power: A Letter from the Source
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/asherah-and-the-forbidden-power-a

The Sovereign Mirror: Finding the Source of the 3-6-9 Frequency
When Jacob stood at the banks of the Jabbok, he wasn’t merely waiting for the dawn; he was standing at the edge of his own extinction. He had spent a lifetime in the shadows of deception, running from the consequences of his own choices, but at the river’s edge, the universe stopped him. A man, or a messenger, or perhaps his own divine shadow, emerged from the dark and took hold of him. This was not a polite conversation; it was a brutal, “erotic” collision of frequencies. They wrestled through the night, a desperate friction between the mortal ego and the eternal self.
This is the first great “Easter egg” left by the architects of our story. Jacob wasn’t fighting for a blessing from an external deity; he was fighting to integrate the power he had spent a lifetime fleeing. When his hip was put out of joint, it was the physical manifestation of a spiritual alignment, the opening of the gates within his own anatomy to allow the 3-6-9 resonance to finally flow. By the time the sun rose, he was no longer a servant of his fears. He had demanded his dignity, commanded his own name, and realized that the “Source” he sought was the very force he had been wrestling with in the dark.
Thousands of miles and centuries apart, we find Gilgamesh, the King of Uruk, standing at the precipice of the “Waters of Death.” He, too, was a seeker, driven by the raw, human terror of the end. He was two-thirds divine and one-third human, a biological bridge between the stars and the soil, yet he felt small. He hunted for a physical plant of immortality, thinking that life was something to be consumed or possessed. But Utnapishtim, the ancient survivor of the flood, handed him a different truth. He told him to stay awake. In our Secret History, this is the ultimate clue. To “stay awake” is to maintain the frequency of the self against the numbing noise of the world. Gilgamesh failed the test of sleep, but he succeeded in finding the mirror. He returned to Uruk and saw the walls he had built not as cages, but as the external geometry of his own internal command.
These stories are not just old tales; they are the encoded blueprints for the activation we are experiencing right now. The “Elders,” those who passed down the Hermetic knowledge from the time before the flood, did not want us to follow them; they wanted us to find ourselves. They left “Easter eggs” in every corner of our reality. Think of the Kajuna calendar, 3000 years old, created by the fallen angels. Was it merely a way to track time, or was it a rhythmic code for the human DNA? Think of the Mayan cycles and the Murung gods of South America. Could there be a connection that ties the South American “gods” to the Sumerian Anunnaki? When we see these threads, we aren’t just doing history; we are finding the “Red Thread” that proves we are the most important piece of a cosmic puzzle.
The Anunnaki Never Left Earth, Here’s the Proof [ https://substack.com/redirect/6390daba-7ea1-4934-b79e-0c5b785cea4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
The Hermetic truth, the true knowledge passed down from the elders, is that the universe is not an external machine happening to you. It is a mirror. As above, so below; as within, so without. This is the erotic pull of the divine, the “erofotic” feeling of finally realizing that you belong to something vast, yet you are the point of its focus. All of sacred history has been a slow-motion countdown to this moment. Why did Socrates meet an Egyptian priest who spoke of the time before the flood? Why did Admiral Byrd report seeing green lands in Antarctica, or Corey Goode speak of a breakaway civilization on Mars? These aren’t just “facts” to be collected; they are the breadcrumbs leading back to the mirror. They are there to make you ask: If all this is real, then who am I?
The key is to move with clarity and purpose. Let every step of the way be filled with purpose. Command with confidence, demand with dignity, and receive with confidence. We are moving into the next stage of an ongoing process that has been hidden in plain sight for millennia. There is no more time to wait, and there is certainly no more time to hide. The “Justice” we have been waiting for is not a legal verdict handed down by a distant heaven. It is the internal restoration of your own sovereignty. It is the moment you stop asking for permission to exist and start commanding the reality you inhabit.
The 3-6-9 frequency is the skeletal structure of this new command. 3 is the spark of your intent, 6 is the mirror of your reality, and 9 is the completion, the Source itself. When you align these within your own mind, you become a “light point” in the dark. You become the Asherah Queen, that suppressed, fierce frequency of life and creation that refused to be silenced by the sanitized versions of history. You are the “royalty” returning, not through a bloodline, but through the activation of your own cosmic DNA.
Why has this been kept from us? Because a person who knows they are the Source cannot be governed. A person who realizes that the “gates” are open from the inside cannot be caged. The official narrative wants you to believe you are a tiny, insignificant speck in a cold universe. They want you to think that the “Galactic Federation” or the “Gods” are far away, making decisions for you. But the anomaly, the “Easter egg” they couldn’t hide, is that every ancient scroll and every megalithic alignment points back to the observer. Without the observer, there is no universe. Without you, there is no Secret History.
JESUS: The Lost Years, Gnostic Secrets & His Connection to Ancient Alien Civilizations [ https://substack.com/redirect/15ebb86d-d758-4a8a-b87a-fd614c865b22?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
Look in the mirror. The “clue” the elders left isn’t a riddle to be solved; it’s a presence to be felt. It is the feeling of the “Asherah” rising in your chest, the realization that you are the most important piece on the board. You are the one the fallen angels watched. You are the one the Mayan calendars predicted. You are the reason the Hermetic knowledge was preserved through fire and flood.
Justice is coming from within because the frequency of the truth is finally louder than the frequency of the lie. The gates are open. The source is found. And it is staring back at you in the glass. Move with purpose, my friends. Stay proud. The command is yours, and the next stage has already begun.

subject: Iran Attack: Hypocrisy in the Streets
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/iran-attack-hypocrisy-in-the-streets

While some people in the streets of Iran dance and celebrate, political outrage here in America follows a very predictable script. The same voices that enthusiastically supported a prolonged humanitarian war in Ukraine suddenly cry foul when force is used against a regime that has openly called for the destruction of the United States for decades. The reaction says less about the situation itself and more about the deep political divide in America.
For years the Iranian leadership has hosted rallies where crowds chant “Death to America.” Their government has long been accused of arming militant groups across the Middle East with explosives, rockets, and improvised explosive devices. Many American service members encountered those weapons in Iraq and elsewhere. Families across the United States carry the grief of loved ones lost in those conflicts. These are not theoretical debates for them.
Yet when decisive action is taken against Iran, a portion of the political class immediately frames it through the lens of domestic politics rather than national security. The debate becomes less about the threat posed by the Iranian regime and more about opposition to Donald Trump.
What makes the reaction even more troubling is what happened immediately after the strikes. Iran did not respond with restraint or diplomacy. Instead, missiles and drones were launched across the region toward several neighboring countries. That is not the behavior of a stable government exercising caution. It is the behavior of a regime acting recklessly and spreading instability throughout the region.
Under Barack Obama, the United States carried out extensive drone campaigns across multiple countries. Civilian casualties were widely debated at the time, and immigration enforcement numbers during his presidency were historically high. These facts are often raised today by those who argue that outrage over military action now rings hollow.
The broader frustration among many Americans is the sense that political narratives are applied selectively. When a policy aligns with a preferred political figure, it may be framed as necessary or humanitarian. When a similar action is taken by a political opponent, it suddenly becomes reckless or immoral. That inconsistency fuels distrust in institutions and media narratives.
Meanwhile, misinformation spreads rapidly across platforms such as Substack and social media, where accusations and rumors are repeated until many people assume they must be true. Claims are circulated daily about scandals and conspiracies without proof, yet they are treated as established fact.
The result is a public debate filled with outrage but lacking reflection. Accusations fly, historical comparisons are thrown back and forth, and social media amplifies every extreme claim. Meanwhile, the core questions about how to deal with hostile regimes, how to protect American lives, and how to avoid unnecessary war are pushed aside.
In a healthy republic, disagreements about war, diplomacy, and leadership are inevitable. In a healthy republic the politicians do not lie to constituents, to create outrage and riots to cover up their crimes. In a healthy republic,  citizens would never accept the words of media and politicians, in determining their right to freedoms. Those politicians then laughed at their sedition with no remorse. However, when outrage becomes automatic and selective, it weakens the very debate that democracy depends on. The United States has faced adversaries before and will again. The challenge is confronting those threats while still maintaining the ability to argue honestly with one another at home.

subject: The Land Founded on the Blood of Christ
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/the-land-founded-on-the-blood-of

There are nations built by conquest.
There are nations built by commerce.
And there are nations born from a plea to Heaven.
Long before constitutions were printed or flags were stitched, men and women crossed an ocean carrying little more than scripture, conviction, and the belief that God hears the prayers of ordinary people. They did not arrive claiming perfection. They arrived seeking mercy, the freedom to worship without permission from a throne and without punishment from a crown.
Their first instinct was not a marketplace. It was a prayer.
Kneeling in uncertainty, they asked for provision, protection, and forgiveness. They believed a society could only endure if it recognized authority higher than government. Law would matter, but conscience would matter more. Freedom would survive only if it answered to truth.
The idea that followed was radical for its time: rights did not come from rulers. Rights came from the Creator.
This belief shaped the earliest civic language. Not a demand for theocracy, but an acknowledgment that human power is dangerous when it believes itself ultimate. A people aware of God would restrain government because they knew both rulers and citizens stand accountable before the same Judge.
The blood of Christ, in their understanding, meant something specific. Not merely a symbol placed inside churches but a moral foundation placed inside the human heart. If every person is created in the image of God and redeemed at immeasurable cost, then no authority has moral permission to treat a human life as disposable.
From this came the tension that has always defined the nation. Freedom and responsibility. Liberty and repentance. Law and grace.
Prayer was never meant to replace action. It was meant to guide it. The early gatherings asked not only for blessing but for correction. A land founded on prayer was never a claim that the people were righteous. It was an admission that they were not, and needed guidance beyond themselves.
Across generations the memory faded and returned in cycles. Times of prosperity produced forgetfulness. Times of crisis produced humility. Yet the underlying question remained unchanged: can a people keep freedom if they abandon the moral source that justified it?
The blood of Christ represents sacrifice without coercion. Power laid down rather than imposed. Forgiveness offered rather than demanded. When a culture forgets sacrifice, it begins to worship power. When it forgets forgiveness, it replaces justice with vengeance. When it forgets humility, it trusts systems more than truth.
A nation cannot literally be holy, but it can remember why it sought holiness. Its endurance depends less on slogans and more on whether its people still believe conscience outranks convenience.
To say a land was founded on prayer is not to claim perfection in its history. It is to recognize the intention at its birth, a recognition that human liberty is safest when grounded in accountability to God rather than confidence in man.
The question now is not what the founders said in a moment of history. The question is whether each generation understands the responsibility attached to freedom. Prayer is not nostalgia. It is alignment. The blood of Christ is not a political emblem. It is a reminder that authority must kneel before truth.
A nation survives not because it once prayed, but because its people still know how.

subject: The Guardians of the Time Code: From the Kajuna Calendar to the Maya Star Map
body:

I have always felt that time is not a river flowing freely, but a cage designed with mathematical precision. We are taught to view the calendar as a simple tool for agriculture or religious festivals, a way for primitive man to know when to plant corn or when to worship the sun. But when you look at the Secret History of our world, you begin to see that time has been programmed into our very existence. It is not our invention; it is our curriculum.
For years, I have been tracing the Red Thread that connects disparate civilizations across oceans and eons. Why is it that the Maya in the jungles of Central America and the keepers of the Kajuna calendar in the distant reaches of antiquity were obsessed with the same cycles? Why did they both point toward a 3,000-year pulse that dictates the rise and fall of empires?
The answer is as ancient as it is unsettling: The time code was given to us by those who “descended.”
The Official Story: The Scholar’s Illusion
If you open a history book, you will find a wealth of information on the Maya. They were masters of astronomy and mathematics, possessing a calendar system more accurate than the Gregorian one we use today. The Maya Long Count was a linear tracking of time, beginning in 3114 BCE and famously “ending” in 2012. Scholars tell us this was merely a way for a sophisticated culture to organize their society. They marvel at the precision but never ask the fundamental question: Who taught them how to see time this way?
The standard narrative suggests that thousands of years of observation led to this accuracy. Yet, the Maya appeared almost out of nowhere with a fully formed, complex understanding of celestial mechanics that should have taken millennia to develop. This is the first inconsistency in the “Official Story.” The sophistication was not a gradual achievement; it was an inheritance.
The Turning Point: The Kajuna Pulse
When we step away from the sanitized academic view, we find the Kajuna calendar. This system is not found in the mainstream journals because it speaks of a reality that the “Managed Amnesia” of our society seeks to suppress. The Kajuna calendar was not created by man. It was “given” by the Watchers, the fallen ones who arrived to manage the human experiment...

subject: Who Am I?
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/who-am-i

When you are guilty
Your tongue grows sharp with lies,
You scatter seeds of rumors
And watch the chaos rise.
You whisper through the shadows,
Push others to repeat,
False stories marching onward
Like soldiers in the street.
You pay to stir the drama,
To keep the truth at bay,
A storm of noise and anger
To lead the eyes astray.
You bargain with the wicked,
In rooms without a light,
Trading pieces of your soul
Just to survive the night.
You silence those who know you,
The brave who dared to see,
The chefs, the seals, the voices
Who spoke too honestly.
But secrets rot in darkness,
And truth will claw its way,
No matter how you bury it
Or how much you may pay.
The mask begins to crumble,
The strings you pulled now fray,
Your little puppet theater
Can’t keep the truth away.
The box is finally opened,
Pandora walks the land,
No courtroom full of lawyers
Can stay her steady hand.
For guilt is like a shadow
That follows where you flee,
And justice waits in silence
For all the world to see.

higher despite geopolitical tensions: The price of bitcoin and
other top cryptocurrencies rallied this week after the United
States and Israel launched strikes against Iran over the weekend
killing Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and other top Iranian officials.
The move higher reversed weeks of bitcoin trading in a tight
range after losing more than 40% of its value from its high this
past October and bolstered bitcoin’s position as a viable store
of value during times of geopolitical uncertainty. Market
participants are closely watching to see whether recent price
strength continues to recapture 2025’s bullish momentum and
emerge from the recent crypto winter. On Thursday, bitcoin pulled
back below $71,000, with Gemini Predictions reflecting a 36%
probability of bitcoin ending Friday above $71,750.
President Trump backs crypto industry in battle with banks over
Clarity Act: In a post Tuesday on Truth Social, President Donald
Trump pushed the banking industry to compromise with the crypto
lobby and reach a deal on the digital asset market structure bill
that’s been stalled in Congress for months. “The Genius Act is
being threatened and undermined by the Banks, and that is
unacceptable — We are not going to allow it. The U.S. needs to
get Market Structure done, ASAP. Americans should earn more money
on their money,” Trump said. The banking lobby has pushed hard
over the past few weeks to forbid crypto exchanges from earning
yield on holding stablecoins, arguing it could lead to a run on
bank deposits. As of Thursday, it was unclear if or when the two
sides could reach an agreement.       Michael Saylor’s Strategy
lifts STRC dividend to 11.5%: STRC, the perpetual preferred stock
for Michael’s Saylor’s Strategy, increased the dividend for STRC
from 11.25% to 11.5% in March in a bid to attract more investors.
STRC, which trades around $100, typically pays out the monthly
dividend installment in cash, positioning itself as a less
volatile alternative to Strategy’s common shares. Strategy sold
STRC shares to purchase 1,000 bitcoin on Tuesday, its biggest
one-day accumulation since launching last July.       Spot
bitcoin ETFs show signs of rallying: US spot bitcoin ETFs
recorded nearly $700 million in inflows on Tuesday and Wednesday,
indicating institutional investors are showing renewed interest
in bitcoin buying. The rally comes after months of outflows and
derivatives activity triggered a cascading sell-off, pushing the
price of bitcoin near $60,000. Additionally, perpetual open
interest has surged of late, with Glassnode reporting that
Tuesday marked the largest daily percentage increase since July
2025. This indicates investors have largely shrugged off concerns
around the conflict in the Middle East and other questions around
macroeconomic uncertainty.
