subject: The Martian Exodus: Did the Fallen Angels Leave a Footprint on the Red Planet?
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-martian-exodus-did-the-fallen

I have spent the better part of my life tracing the evidence of those who “descended.” In the public sphere, we often treat the Sumerian Anunnaki as a singular group of “gods,” but my research into the Secret History suggests something far more complex and structured. There was a clear hierarchy, a division of labor, and a geographical split that extended far beyond the borders of Mesopotamia.
Some stayed on Earth to rule the “black-headed people,” and then there were the Igigi. In the ancient texts, the Igigi are described as the “Watchers,” the ones stationed in the “heavens.” For too long, we have interpreted “heavens” as a spiritual or metaphorical realm. But if we apply the Red Thread of technological reality, a different picture emerges: The Igigi were the crews of orbital stations and planetary outposts. They were the original breakaway civilization.
When we look at Mars today, we aren’t looking at a dead, barren rock that has always been silent. We are looking at a crime scene.
The Igigi: The Original “Space Force”
The Sumerian texts are remarkably specific about the burdens the Igigi faced. They were the ones tasked with the heavy lifting of maintaining the link between the “home world” and the colony here on Earth. They were the bridge. But as the centuries turned into millennia, the Igigi grew restless. They felt abandoned on their celestial outposts, watching the Earth-bound elite enjoy the fruits of the planet while they endured the harshness of the void.
I often think about the stories Socrates heard from the Egyptian priests. They spoke of a time when the “gods” were physically present, managing the affairs of men with a cold, administrative efficiency. These priests possessed records of the time before the Great Flood, a catastrophe that didn’t just wash away cities, but reset the entire administrative structure of the planet.
Where did the “gods” go when the Earth became unstable? Where did they retreat when the recurring cycles of the Kajuna calendar, that ancient 3,000-year countdown, threatened their infrastructure? They didn’t just vanish into thin air. They retreated to the high ground. In our solar system, the strategic high ground has always been Mars.
The Cydonia-Giza Connection: The Mirror in the Sky
We have been told for decades by space agencies that the “Face on Mars” in the Cydonia region is nothing more than a trick of light and shadow, a psychological phenomenon called pareidolia. But why the obsessive urgency to debunk it? Why the airbrushing of subsequent high-resolution images?...

Hi JOSHUA,

We’re seeing a rise in scams targeting Uber drivers—and most of
them follow a similar pattern.

It often starts with a fake ride request or an unexpected call
that looks like it’s coming from Uber Support. In some cases, the
caller claims there’s been a safety complaint or account issue
and asks you to share your phone number or open a text message
for “verification”.

From there, scammers use urgency, the promise of additional
earnings, or safety warnings to pressure drivers into sharing
verification codes, phone numbers, or moving money.

Here’s the most important rule to remember:
Uber Pro Card Support and Uber will never ask for your passcode,
text verification codes, phone number, or request that you
transfer funds. Ever.

We’ve broken down exactly how this scam works–including the
“fake safety incident” tactic to help you recognize it while it’s
happening—and hopefully stop it before any damage is done.

We are pleased to inform that you that you have been referred to the Probation Department for possible employment as a Group Supervisor I. The current vacancy is at our Evening Center, but the position can be assigned to any of our Divisions (Juvenile Hall, ATD, PSC or Evening Center) upon department discretion.

subject: Registration is open for the Sheet Metal Industry Institutes (SMII) Conference
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/990b3850ec6d/registration-is-open-for-the-sheet-metal-industry-institutes-smii-conference?e=7d68f8c372)

https://www.nemionline.org/

Registration is now open. Join NEMI, ITI, and SMOHIT at the
SMII Conference September 22-24 in Atlanta

In 2026, the sheet metal industry will convene under a new, unified conference model with the launch of the Sheet Metal Industry Institutes (SMII) Conference. For the first time, NEMI, the International Training Institute (ITI), and Sheet Metal Occupational Health Institute Trust (SMOHIT) will come together in a single, coordinated event, replacing the individual conferences previously held by each organization. This new structure reflects a deliberate effort to align education, training, certification, and workforce initiatives while providing industry leadership with a focused forum for collaboration and professional development. Attendees will have the opportunity to earn CEUs through the conference’s educational sessions to be used for the renewal of your ICB Certifications.

In support of this alignment, NEMI is working in coordination with the International Certification Board (ICB) on an updated approach to advanced professional certification delivery.

Beginning in 2026, the ICB NEMI Seminar and Certification Program will transition from a single annual conference‑based model to regionally delivered certification seminars, available to members from across the country. The three initial seminar locations will be intentionally selected in density‑rich markets where certification demand and workforce needs are the greatest. This ensures efficient access while maintaining the integrity and credibility of ICB/TABB credentials nationwide. It also allows members to attend the program location of their choice.

This program will launch the TABB Supervisor Seminar and Certification Exam, a four‑day instructional and examination event designed for experienced testing, adjusting, and balancing professionals who want to advance their supervisory responsibilities. The seminar integrates applied theory and hands‑on lab activities. Additional certification disciplines will be incorporated into the program as participation and industry demand continue to grow.

Stay tuned for additional information to come as the ICB NEMI Seminar and Certification Program schedule is created.

Meanwhile, registration for the SMII Conference  is now open. Join NEMI, ITI, and SMOHIT September 22-24 in Atlanta.
REGISTER NOW (https://www.smiinst.org/conference/)

The Genetic Signature of the Gods: The Amarna Mystery and the Bloodline of the
 Watchers
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-genetic-signature-of-the-gods

The desert has a way of swallowing secrets, keeping them buried under shifting sands until the world is ready, or perhaps, until the “Cycle” demands their return. In 1922, when Howard Carter’s flickering candle first illuminated the treasures of Tutankhamun, the world gasped at the gold. But the gold was a distraction. It was the biological reality of the bodies within the Amarna-era tombs that should have changed everything we know about human history.
I don’t look at Egypt through the lens of a textbook. I look at it as a crime scene, a place where a specific curriculum was being taught, and where a specific bloodline was being managed. This is the first lesson of The School (The Cycle). To understand where we are going, we must understand the “Neteru,” the teachers who never truly left.
The Official Story: The Scholar’s Foundation
The history books tell us that in the 14th Century BCE, a Pharaoh named Amenhotep IV ascended the throne of the world’s greatest superpower. Egypt was at its zenith, a land of ancient traditions and a pantheon of gods that had remained unchanged for millennia. Then, in a move that baffled his contemporaries and continues to frustrate historians today, the King changed his name to Akhenaten and launched a revolution that erased the old gods overnight.
He abolished the priesthood of Amun, abandoned the capital of Thebes, and built a new city in a desolate stretch of the Nile called Amarna. He declared that there was only one god: the Aten, represented by the solar disc with reaching hands. This is often taught as the world’s first experiment with monotheism. The “Scholar’s” narrative portrays Akhenaten as a visionary or a fanatic, a man who broke the status quo to follow a singular, divine light.
But there is a glaring problem with this tidy historical package. It’s the way the King looked. It’s the way his family was depicted. It’s a biological anomaly that mainstream science has spent a century trying to explain away as a list of diseases. They point to the statues of Akhenaten, the dramatically elongated skull, the spindly neck, the prominent breasts on a male frame, and the wide, feminine hips. They call it Marfan’s Syndrome. They call it Frohlich’s Syndrome. They want us to believe the most powerful man on Earth was simply a sickly, deformed man with an eccentric taste in art.
They want us to feel safe. Because if it isn’t a disease, then the story of human evolution is a lie.
The Anomaly: The Turning Point
When you step away from the medical excuses and look at the physical evidence, the “disease” theory crumbles. In 2010, DNA and CT scans were performed on the remains from tomb KV55, believed to be Akhenaten. The results confirmed the iconography: the skull was naturally elongated, and the cranial capacity was significantly larger than any standard human average. More importantly, this wasn’t an isolated case. His daughters, the princesses of Amarna, and his son, Tutankhamun, all carried these same traits. This wasn’t a “syndrome”; it was a lineage.
In the ancient world, these features weren’t seen as deformities. They were the mark of the Neteru. The ancient Egyptians spoke of Zep Tepi, the “First Time” when gods and men walked together. These beings were not spirits in the sky; they were physical teachers. This is where we find our “Red Thread.”
Think back to the stories Socrates was told by the Egyptian priests of Sais, tales of a time before the flood, a time when specific knowledge was handed down from those who “came from the heavens.” If we look at the Sumerian King List, we see the same pattern: kingship was “lowered from heaven,” and these early rulers lived for tens of thousands of years. Were they human? Or were they the “Watchers” described in the Book of Enoch, the “Fallen” who descended to earth and mingled their DNA with the daughters of men?
The Authoritative Synthesis: The Global Signature
I believe Akhenaten wasn’t a religious heretic; he was a restorer. He knew that his blood carried a specific frequency, a biological connection to the architects of The School. He wasn’t worshiping the sun as a ball of fire; he was acknowledging the Aten as a source of energy, a technology of consciousness that the common man had forgotten.
This is where the threads tie together into the big picture. 3,000 years ago, as the Kajuna calendar was being established by the “teachers” in other parts of the world, Akhenaten was trying to force Egypt back into the original curriculum of the Cycle. The “Murung gods” of the South American tribes and the “Annunaki” of Sumer are all different names for the same management team. They are the ones who set the clock.
Is it a coincidence that the same elongated skulls found in Egypt are also found in Paracas, Peru, and in the ancient burial mounds of Russia? Is it a coincidence that the “wings” of the Aten are mirrored in the winged discs of the Persian and Sumerian kings? This is not a cultural exchange. This is a signature. It is the mark of a breakaway civilization that has been managing human DNA for eons. They are the “Neighbors” who live just outside our range of perception, influencing our wars, our religions, and our progress.
When Admiral Byrd flew over the poles and reported green forests where there should have been ice, he wasn’t hallucinating. He was seeing the remnants of the world the Neteru built, a world that exists in parallel to our own, hidden behind the “Cycle.” The “Fallen” didn’t just disappear into myth; they became the architects of our reality, the ones who established the systems of power that persist today.
Secret History
To help me keep this research independent and free from the “Managed Amnesia” censorship, please consider supporting my work. Every contribution allows me to spend more time digging into the archives and bringing these truths to light.
Support the mission and buy me a cup of coffee here [ https://substack.com/redirect/4959bf17-b2fb-4643-8170-94c98836b8d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
The Personal Bridge: The Ongoing Process
Why am I telling you this now? Because the clock is ticking. When you see the numbers, the 1111, the 333, and the 555, you aren’t just seeing coincidences. You are seeing the “operating system” of the School waking up.
The transition Akhenaten attempted was a “Shift” (555). It was an effort to align humanity (333) with a higher frequency before the next reset. We are in a similar window today. The anomalies are appearing everywhere, from the UAP disclosures to the strange data being recovered from ancient sites. The “Discovery” phase is over; we are now in the phase of “Insight.”
Learn More In Our Book The Frozen Origins [ https://substack.com/redirect/910552fb-51fc-45aa-a0f6-5d1bae79837b?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
The bloodline of Amarna didn’t end with the death of Tutankhamun. It merely moved into the shadows. It flowed into the royal houses, into the priesthoods, and into the modern structures of global control. They are still here, and they are still following the script. We are part of an ongoing process, a massive curriculum designed to test our ability to see the truth through the illusions of the “Official Story.”
You are seeing these patterns because you are being called to the forum. You are being asked to look past the gold of the tomb and see the biology of the gods. The truth is moving, and it is moving fast.
I am Secret History, and I am here to help you trace the Red Thread to its source. The School is in session, and the final exam is approaching.

One of the issues frequently raised is concern over aerial spraying in Florida’s skies. Questions have also circulated around the handling of pandemic-era funds tied to COVID-19 [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=3 ] programs. subject: [PODCAST #630] 👉 Does Understanding Personality Makes Things Worse?
body:
Sometimes it can feel like you’re going backward when you grow your personality.
 

Make Your Thinking & Arguments Bulletproof
Antonia's 7-Step System For Airtight Clarity & Thinking
 (Live on Zoom - Sat, 12–3pm ET) — Learn More

 

Hi Joshua,

 

Sometimes personality growth feels like you’re going backward.

 

I think it's because we're finally addressing what we used to ignore or avoid.

 

First, awareness hits, then old patterns surface and your nervous system resists the new responsibility.

 

In this week’s episode we unpack why things often get worse before they get better, how growth feels undignified, and how to tell whether you’re using the right tools.

 

Side note... If you want a practical companion to this episode, we invite you to join Antonia live this Saturday on Zoom for Make Your Arguments Bulletproof... a 3-hour clean-thinking workshop.

 

She is basically going to teach an Introverted Thinking (Ti) "bootcamp" over the course of 3 hours.

 

This is Antonia’s 7-step (Ti) system for building positions that are clean, precise, and airtight, the kind no one can poke holes in your logical argument.

 

If you've ever listened to Antonia clearly explain a concept, land a careful distinction, or lead your mind to an insight about yourself... you will LOVE learning what she'll teach you in this workshop.

 

It's because Antonia uses her powerful Introverted Thinking (Ti) to teach you how to think, not what to think.

 

It's very practical. You’ll bring one strong thought or belief you want to make bulletproof and Antonia will guide you to clarify definitions, surfaces assumptions, and strengthen your reasoning behind it.

 

Clean thinking and strong arguments can support you when life feels chaotic, especially in conflict, relationships, and major life transitions. We would love to have you join us live Saturday.

 

But first... this week's show...
Watch or Listen To The Podcast ⮕
 

In this week's episode, we explore:

  • Why “I feel better” is a bad metric when you’re in the messy middle of growth

  • Personal development defined as accelerated maturity, catching up on lessons you missed

  • The early phases of change: awareness, responsibility, finding tools, implementation

  • Why your environment can push back when you evolve (the “crabs in a bucket” effect)

  • How personality wiring influences what growth asks of you, often in a direction you naturally avoid

👉 We’d love to hear from you: When growth feels like regression, what pattern do you notice yourself repeating most?

<— Hit reply and share your experience with us.

 

We released this podcast in both video and audio this week.
Watch or Listen To The Podcast ⮕
 


Much Love,

Joel Mark Witt & Antonia Dodge
Co-Founders | Personality Hacker
 

PS - Make Your Thinking & Arguments Bulletproof

I sat down with Antonia this week to discuss her entire 7-step process for refining thoughts and beliefs into bulletproof arguments.

 

Related Video: 7-Steps to Make Any Argument Bulletproof

 

In this 20 minute video above Antonia actually teaches all 7-steps that we guide workshop attendees through this Saturday.

 

Antonia is hosting a live workshop this Saturday (Mar 7) teaching her 7-step system to refine any belief or thought to precision.

 

This is the exact (Ti) process she used to reprogram her own mind after leaving a cult.

 

And it's one of the core skills of Introverted Thinking. We would love to have you join us live. We go live in 2 days...

subject: [take action] Tell Congress to support the new“Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair ShareAct”
body:
The American people need a break and Sen. Sanders and Rep. Khanna’s new bill would do just that -- by taxing billionaire wealth.

Joshua willems,

Billionaire wealth is out of control with America’s 935 billionaires seeing their wealth skyrocket by $1.5 trillion last year alone.[1] But, because of our rigged tax system that makes working people pay taxes with every paycheck while leaving billionaire wealth gains untouched, our communities are starved of resources that could make healthcare more affordable or strengthen public education.

To unrig our tax code and invest in working families, Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Ro Khanna have introduced the Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair Share Act -- a wealth tax on billionaires.

Sanders and Khanna’s new bill, introduced this week, would raise an estimated $4.4 TRILLION, just from taxing billionaire wealth. And it would make direct investments in working people.

The Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair Share Act would provide $3,000 stimulus checks to individuals earning under $150,000 a year. It would expand Medicare to include dental, hearing, and vision. It would ensure a minimum $60,000 salary for every public school teacher. It would invest $850 billion in affordable housing to address the homelessness crisis. It would ensure no family needs to spend more than 7% of their income on childcare. And, this bill would reverse Republicans’ $1.1 trillion cut to Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act.

Send a message to your Senators and Representative right now and urge them to support the new Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair Share Act -- and tax billionaire wealth!

SIGN & SEND

Billionaires are using their untaxed wealth to control our democracy and our economy with just 100 billionaire families spending a record $2.6 billion in the 2024 presidential election.[2]

What did they get for their $2.6 billion investment? They convinced congressional Republicans to pass a second Trump tax scam that costs taxpayers more than $4.5 trillion, with millionaires, billionaires, and billion-dollar corporations seeing the biggest rewards.

In fact, the cuts made to the Affordable Care Act in that same bill will wipe out any tax savings that working people might have seen. For example, a 45-year-old earning $62,000 a year is currently paying $1,470 more for health insurance through the Affordable Care Act, wiping out the $1,500 they might have otherwise received in tax savings this year. But a family of four earning $126,000 a year is currently paying $8,400 more out-of-pocket in increased ACA health insurance costs.[3]

The American people need a break and Sen. Sanders and Rep. Khanna’s new bill would do just that -- by taxing billionaire wealth.

Click here to send a message to Congress demanding they support the Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair Share Act to tax billionaire wealth and invest in working people.

Together, we’re demanding an economy that puts our families and communities first, not billionaires and their corporations.

In solidarity,

-Faiz

Faiz Shakir, Co-Founder
More Perfect Union

SUPPORT OUR WORK

[1] U.S. BILLIONAIRES GOT $1.5 TRILLION RICHER IN TRUMP’S FIRST YEAR
[2] Billionaires Buying Elections: They’ve Come to Collect
[3] For Many Families, Trump-GOP Healthcare Premium Hikes Wipe Out Potential Tax Cuts

Quetzalcoatl: The White God Who Came from the Stars
Imagine a beach in Mexico thousands of years ago. The horizon isn’t broken by a simple canoe, but by something that looked like a “serpent ship” gleaming in the sun. A figure steps out who looks like no one locally. He is tall, has pale skin, and bears a beard, a physical trait almost unknown among the indigenous peoples of Mesoamerica at that time. He didn’t come to conquer with a sword, but to build with knowledge.
This isn’t the beginning of a science fiction novel. This is the core of the deepest traditions from the Aztecs, Mayans, and Toltecs. They called him Quetzalcoatl, the feathered serpent. But who was he really? And why do we find his “handprint” on the other side of the globe, in the dusty ruins of ancient Sumer?
The Official Explanation: A Myth or a King?
If you go to a traditional historian, they will tell you that Quetzalcoatl was either a purely symbolic force of nature, a union of earth (the serpent) and sky (the bird), or perhaps a deified ruler from the 10th century. They view the similarities between cultures as “coincidental” or the result of universal human psychology. For academia, the ocean was an insurmountable wall in antiquity. They would have us believe that civilizations arose in isolated bubbles, completely independent of each other.
But this explanation is beginning to crack when we look at the details. Why is this god described as a bringer of civilization who taught the same sciences that we find in Mesopotamia? Law, agriculture, metallurgy, and, perhaps most importantly, an extremely advanced calendar.
The Anomaly: The Serpent That Flies
When we examine the descriptions more closely, questions emerge that official history cannot answer. Why is the “serpent” almost always connected to the ability to fly? In our theory, we don’t look at the serpent as a reptile, but as a symbol of technology or a specific lineage.
Think of Admiral Byrd. When he flew over the poles, he reported green landscapes and a world that didn’t align with our maps. He saw something that shouldn’t be there. Similarly, the ancient texts describe Quetzalcoatl as moving with a speed and insight that defy the primitive tools of the time.
If we look at the symbolism of the feathered serpent, we see a striking similarity to the Sumerian god Enki, or his son Ningishzida. In Sumer, they were often depicted with two intertwined serpents, which we today know as the kerykeion or caduceus, the symbol of medicine and DNA. Is it a coincidence that Quetzalcoatl was also the god of rebirth and life?
Secret History and Our Theory: A Global Administration
This is where the threads come together. In Secret History and Our Theory, we propose that we are not looking at two different gods, but at the same civilization builder who operated on two continents.
Think of the story of Socrates meeting an Egyptian priest. The priest told of a time before the great flood, a time when the world was connected under another rule. If we look at the Anunnaki accounts from Sumer, we learn of a group that divided regions among themselves. Could Quetzalcoatl have been the name the natives in America gave to an Anunnaki architect who was sent to establish a new outpost after the cataclysms?
Think of the Kajuna calendar, which is over 3000 years old. It is said to have been created by the “fallen angels”. Is there a connection here to the Mayan calendar, which possesses an astronomical accuracy we could barely match before modern computers? When we speak of the fallen angels or ‘the Watchers’, we are speaking of the same beings that the Sumerians called Anunnaki. Those who came down and civilized humanity, but also demanded loyalty.
The Architects Behind the Scenes
What really gives me goosebumps is the similarity in the architecture. The pyramids in Mexico and the ziggurats in Mesopotamia are not just tombs or temples. They are astronomical instruments. They are built with a precision that points to a shared curriculum.
Why do stories of ‘white gods’ appear across all of South America, from Viracocha in Peru to Quetzalcoatl in Mexico? All are described as wise men who promised to return. They brought with them a ‘blue copy’ of civilization. When Corey Goode spoke about ‘breakaway civilizations’ and bases under the ice or on Mars, it sounded like fantasy to many. But if we look at the small facts we gather, like Admiral Byrd’s observations or the Sumerian king lists’ immense time spans, we see that there is a common thread.
We are talking about an ongoing process. These beings didn’t just leave; they left behind a system, an infrastructure, and a genetic code that we still live under today.
The Hidden Truth
When we connect Quetzalcoatl to the Anunnaki, we remove the veil of ‘mythology’ and begin to see the red thread from antiquity. It wasn’t ‘magic’. It was science. They weren’t ‘gods’ in a religious sense, but a technologically superior civilization that shaped humanity.
Was Quetzalcoatl an emissary from the same group that built Ur and Babylon? Everything indicates it. The same measurements, the same star constellations, the same obsession with gold and metallurgy. By crowdsourcing the truth and looking beyond the frameworks that traditional education has set for us, we see a picture of a world that was once globalized under the masters of the stars.
The question is no longer if they were here, but when they plan their return. For Quetzalcoatl promised, just as the Sumerian texts suggest about their leaders, that he one day would return from where he came, from the stars.
This isn’t just history; it’s our history. And we are only in the beginning stages of untangling the true timeline.
What do you think? Was Quetzalcoatl a solitary traveler, or part of a global Anunnaki elite? Join the conversation in our forum.

subject: We are Hiring and Preparing for Spring
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/soquelcreekwater/december-2024-news-updates-from-soquel-creek-water-district-4748665?e=39b8992fbf)

March 2026


** Join Our Team!
------------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused professional to join our team as a Customer Service & Billing Technician I/II.

This important role supports our community by providing excellent customer service, ensuring accurate billing, and helping customers navigate their water accounts with confidence. If you are detail-oriented, organized, and enjoy working directly with the public, we encourage you to apply.

In addition to meaningful public service work, we offer a competitive salary and a strong benefits package, including comprehensive health coverage, retirement benefits, paid leave, and opportunities for professional growth. It’s a chance to build a rewarding career while serving your local community.

Learn more and apply today! (https://www.soquelcreekwater.org/Jobs.aspx)


** March is a Big Month for Water
------------------------------------------------------------

March is full of important water moments — and a great reminder of how connected we are to our local groundwater.

🌎 Groundwater Awareness Week (March 8–14)

100% of our drinking water comes from the Santa Cruz Mid-County Groundwater Basin. Through careful management, water quality monitoring, and projects like Pure Water Soquel, we’re working to protect this vital resource for generations to come.

🔧 Fix a Leak Week (March 16–22)

Leaks in homes and businesses can waste nearly a trillion gallons of water each year. Take a few minutes to check faucets, toilets, and irrigation systems — your water bill (and our groundwater basin) will thank you.

💦 World Water Day (March 22)

Water connects us all. World Water Day is a global United Nations observance that highlights the importance of freshwater and advocates for sustainable water management worldwide. Visit the official UN observance (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Water_Day?utm_source=chatgpt.com) to learn more.

This month, we invite you to learn where your water comes from, fix leaks, and explore water-saving rebates.

Together, we can protect our water today and for the future.


** New MGA Website!
------------------------------------------------------------

The Mid-County Groundwater Agency (MGA) has launched a newly redesigned website, making it easier than ever for the community to stay informed about the Santa Cruz Mid-County Groundwater Basin. The refreshed site features improved navigation, updated basin data, clear explanations of groundwater sustainability efforts, and enhanced access to reports, meeting materials, and project updates. As the agency responsible for implementing the Groundwater Sustainability Plan, MGA plays a critical role in protecting our shared water supply for the future. We encourage community members to explore the new site and learn more about ongoing efforts to sustainably manage our local groundwater resources at midcountygroundwater.org (https://www.midcountygroundwater.org/) .


** Upcoming and Recent Project Updates
------------------------------------------------------------

Mooshead Main Replacement (Aptos): The Moosehead Drive Main Replacement Project is nearly complete. Crews replaced 2,420 feet of aging, break-prone pipeline with a new six-inch PVC main, improving reliability for 65 homes and nearby streets. This upgrade reduces leaks, strengthens fire protection, and represents an important investment in the long-term health of our water system. This project represents a proactive investment in the long-term health of our water system, and we appreciate the community’s patience as we wrap up the final touches and restore the area.

Monterey Ave Main Replacement (Capitola): The Monterey Avenue Main Replacement Project in Capitola Village will replace approximately 300 linear feet of 6-inch cast iron main —aging and at-risk for leaks and main breaks—with a new six-inch PVC pipeline. This new water main will reduce the potential for future pipeline failures, improve water reliability, reduce costly leaks, and greatly strengthen fire protection for the neighborhood. Construction will include excavation, pipe laying, testing, backfill, paving, and final striping and is anticipated to begin in mid-April.

Chrome-6 Treatment Project (Aptos): The project is fully designed and currently out to bid.

Keep track of projects in your neighborhood on our website (https://www.soquelcreekwater.org/284/Projects-in-Your-Neighborhood) .


** From Rain to Recharge — Preparing for Spring
------------------------------------------------------------

After a series of winter storms, it’s tempting to think our water supply is set for the year. Creeks are flowing, hills are green, and rain barrels may even be overflowing.

So does all that rain solve our water challenges?

Not quite.

While winter storms are critical for our groundwater basin, not all rain becomes drinking water — and how rain falls matters just as much as how much falls.

Where the Rain Really Goes

The District relies entirely on groundwater from the Santa Cruz Mid-County Groundwater Basin. Unlike communities that can import water from distant reservoirs, our drinking water depends on what seeps into the ground locally.

Continue reading this month’s Water Wisdom Column. (https://www.soquelcreekwater.org/m/NewsFlash/home/detail/242)


** District Events
------------------------------------------------------------

Visit our calendar (https://www.soquelcreekwater.org/calendar.aspx?CID=25,14,23) https://www.soquelcreekwater.org/calendar.aspx?CID=25,14,23for up-to-date information.

March 17: Board Meeting
April 21: Visit our booth at Cabrillo College’s Earth Day Celebration

To mark our 65th anniversary, we’re digging into the archives and sharing historical photos from along the way.

Did you know there used to be an airport (https://www.airfields-freeman.com/CA/Airfields_CA_Monterey.htm#:~:text=so%20it%20was%20no%20longer,the%201940%20USGS%20topo%20map.&text=as%20having%20a%202%2C400'%20unpaved,of%20Route%201%20&%20Park%20Avenue.) in Capitola? It operated from 1926 to 1954.

On the outer edge, we had a production well drilled in 1950, taken out of service in 2004, and then retired from service in 2020.

subject: The Road to the Restored Republic
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/the-road-to-the-restored-republic

The idea of a restored republic is not new. It echoes back to the founding vision of the United States of America [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=0 ], a constitutional system rooted in individual liberty, limited government, and the consent of the governed. For many Americans today, the phrase reflects a belief that the nation has drifted from its constitutional foundations and must find its way back to first principles.
But what does that road actually look like?
A republic cannot function if its citizens do not understand it. The framers of the United States Constitution [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=1 ] expected an informed and engaged population. Civic education, once a pillar of American schooling, has steadily eroded. The road forward begins with renewed emphasis on constitutional education, public understanding of federalism and separation of powers, and respect for the Bill of Rights as a restraint on government. A restored republic starts with citizens who know both their rights and their responsibilities.
Public trust declines when institutions appear unaccountable. The strength of a republic depends on transparency in governance and equal application of the law. Restoration requires clear oversight of federal agencies, stronger anti corruption measures, meaningful ethics reform, and serious debate about term limits. Without accountability, constitutional structure becomes hollow. With it, confidence can be rebuilt.
The founders envisioned a limited federal government with significant authority reserved to the states. Over time, federal power has expanded dramatically. A renewed emphasis on state sovereignty, local governance solutions, and reduced federal overreach could restore balance. Federalism was designed to protect liberty by preventing power from concentrating in one place.
Many who speak of a restored republic tie the concept to economic reform, including balanced budgets, reduced national debt, and monetary stability. Whether through fiscal discipline, tax restructuring, or regulatory reform, economic sovereignty plays a central role in political sovereignty. Debt dependency weakens autonomy. Sustainable fiscal policy strengthens it.
A republic also depends on loyalty to its constitutional order. Treason is not disagreement, nor is it lawful opposition. In a constitutional system, betrayal of the nation is defined by law and addressed through due process. A restored republic must confront corruption and treachery firmly, but lawfully. Those who violate their oath, conspire against the nation, or aid its enemies must be investigated, tried, and judged according to established legal standards. Justice must be decisive, but it must also be constitutional. The rule of law, not vengeance, preserves a republic.
A republic cannot endure in perpetual hostility. Polarization threatens long term stability more than any foreign adversary. Constructive disagreement, rather than ideological warfare, is essential. Restoration requires open debate without dehumanization, media literacy and critical thinking, and a rejection of political violence. Unity does not mean uniformity, but it does require a shared commitment to constitutional order.
The path forward is not mysterious or secretive. It runs through voting in local and national elections, peaceful activism, community involvement, jury duty, and public service. The strength of the American system lies in lawful civic engagement, not in waiting for sudden dramatic upheaval.
A restored republic does not mean dismantling democracy or abandoning constitutional processes. It means recommitting to them. It means applying the Constitution as written, ensuring equal protection under the law, and preserving individual liberties while maintaining ordered governance.
The founders did not design a perfect system. They designed a self correcting one.
The road to restoration is not a single event. It is a continuous process of reform, participation, and vigilance. It is built not on rumor or speculation, but on civic responsibility and constitutional fidelity. If a restored republic is to emerge, it will come not from secrecy or spectacle, but from informed citizens, accountable leaders, and a renewed national commitment to liberty under law.

subject: Tails of Hope Gala Invite for Sponsors!
body: Email from Santa Cruz County Animal Shelter Foundation     Dear Joshua, ﻿We are excited to host the inaugural Tails of Hope Gala on September 26, 5-9PM at the beautiful, historic UCSC Hay Barn. We hope you will support this heartwarming event honoring stories of compassion, community, and the joy of second chances!   Businesses and individuals are invited to become sponsors with benefits of brand exposure and guaranteed event tickets! And of course, all proceeds will go towards caring for the thousands of vulnerable homeless animals coming to our Open Door, Open Heart Shelter every year. It will be an evening of elegance, gratitude and happy tails! We will showcase the work and people behind our mission, celebrate lives transformed, enjoy delicious food and lively entertainment, and come together for an uplifting night of compassion in action. Will you be part of Tails of Hope to help pets heal and find love with their furever families? Your gift will also be presented as a donation match that evening to double the Gala's impact that night! Limited sponsor opportunities available, so reserve your package today or reach out to me with any questions. If you would like to donate special items to the auction, please email Kathy or Lizzy.     Please share this invitation with businesses and friends who may be interested in stepping up to partner with the Santa Cruz County Animal Shelter and receive some creative visibility (including acknowledgement on our van wrap)! We look forward to hearing from you. Gratefully, Nga Trinh-Halperin﻿ ﻿Executive Director Gala Sponsorship Information Connect with us     Santa Cruz County Animal Shelter | 1001 Rodriguez St. | Santa Cruz, CA 95062 US Unsubscribe | Update Profile | Constant Contact Data Notice

subject:
The Akhenaten Mutation: DNA Evidence and the Extraterrestrial Origin of the
 Rebel Pharaoh
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-akhenaten-mutation-dna-evidence

I have spent years tracing what I call the Red Thread, that hidden lineage of influence that connects the megaliths of the Andes to the ziggurats of Sumer. But nowhere is this thread more visible, and more jarring, than in the sands of Amarna.
Imagine a king who inherits the most powerful empire on Earth, only to turn his back on every god, every priest, and every tradition that held his civilization together. He didn’t just change the religion; he changed the very definition of what it meant to be human. For centuries, the name Akhenaten was struck from the king lists, his statues smashed, and his memory cursed.
The official story tells us he was a heretic. Secret History and our theory suggest he was something else entirely: a biological anomaly, a living bridge between humanity and the “Fallen” who once walked among us.
The Silence of Amarna
In the early 20th century, archaeologists began uncovering a city that shouldn’t have existed. Akhetaten, the “Horizon of the Aten.” It was built in a feverish rush, occupied for barely twenty years, and then systematically dismantled. What they found there sent shockwaves through the scientific community.
In the art of this period, the Pharaoh is not the broad-shouldered, idealized warrior we see in the images of Ramses or Thutmose. Instead, we see a figure that defies biological norms: an elongated skull, a spindly neck, feminine hips, a protruding stomach, and spindly limbs. For decades, scholars tried to dismiss this as “artistic expression” or a rare genetic disorder like Marfan Syndrome.
But I ask you: why would the most powerful man on the planet choose to be depicted as a “deformed” individual if he were truly human? Or was he simply demanding that the artists record the truth of his alien physiology?
The Official Story: The Scholar’s Foundation
To understand the magnitude of what Akhenaten did, we must look at the world he stepped into. He began his reign as Amenhotep IV, part of the glorious 18th Dynasty. Egypt was polytheistic, governed by a powerful priesthood of Amun-Ra. Then, in his fifth year, everything changed.
He changed his name to Akhenaten (”Effective for the Aten”). He declared that there was only one god, the Aten, represented by a sun disk with hands reaching down to touch the royal family. He moved the capital to a virgin site in the desert.
The conventional historical narrative suggests this was a political power play to strip the priests of their wealth. It was a “religious revolution” led by a visionary poet. This is the safe, academic explanation. It paints Akhenaten as a misunderstood monotheist, a precursor to Moses. But this explanation ignores the physical evidence and the sheer terror his successors felt toward his legacy.
The Anomaly: The Hybrid in the Mirror
When we look closer at the statues of Akhenaten and his family, including the famous Queen Nefertiti and their daughters, we see the same “mutation.” The elongated skulls are not just present in the Pharaoh; they are present in his children.
Modern DNA testing on the mummy identified as KV55, believed by many to be Akhenaten, has revealed fascinating, yet controversial results. While mainstream Egyptologists focus on confirming parentage, they often gloss over the cranial anomalies. If we look at this through the lens of Secret History and our theory, we see a pattern that matches the descriptions of the “Watchers” or the “Fallen Angels” found in the Book of Enoch and Sumerian texts.
The “Fallen” were said to have “mingled their seed” with the daughters of men. This wasn’t just a metaphor. It was a genetic intervention. Akhenaten’s reign represents a moment in history where this high-level hybridization became visible to the public. He wasn’t hiding his difference; he was flaunting it as proof of his divine right to rule. He claimed he was the only one who could communicate with the Aten.
The Aten itself is often depicted as a sun disk, but look at the descriptions: it is a craft of light, a presence that descends. Was the Aten the “mothership” of the Fallen, and was Akhenaten their designated hybrid representative?
The Authoritative Synthesis: The Genetic Incursion
I believe that Akhenaten was a result of a direct genetic intervention designed to realign human civilization. Throughout Secret History, we see these “pulses” of intervention. Think of the 3,000-year-old calendars created with impossible precision, or the sudden appearance of advanced mathematics in Sumer.
The “Fallen” did not just leave behind stone monuments; they left behind a biological legacy. Akhenaten was an attempt to create a “God-King” who was physically and mentally tuned to a higher frequency, or perhaps a different master’s agenda. This explains his radical departure from traditional Egyptian mysticism. He was trying to bypass the “middlemen” (the priests) and connect directly to the source of his own DNA.
Why did the later Pharaohs like Horemheb and the young Tutankhamun try to erase him? They didn’t just want to restore the old gods; they wanted to hide the evidence of the hybrid program. They saw the “strangeness” of Akhenaten as a threat to the stability of the human world. They were terrified of what he represented: a world where the “Gods” were no longer distant myths, but physical, biological realities that walked among us.
Admiral Byrd spoke of “the center of the great unknown” and civilizations with advanced technology. Corey Goode and others have spoken of “breakaway civilizations.” Could Akhenaten have been an earlier iteration of this? A king who belonged to the stars more than the Earth?
Why This Matters Now
We are living in a time of unprecedented disclosure. The things I am investigating, the DNA anomalies, the erased histories, the “Fallen” intervention, are no longer just stories for the fringe. They are the keys to understanding our own origins.
When I look at the face of Akhenaten, I don’t see a “deformed” man. I see a mirror of a much larger, more complex history that we are finally beginning to piece together. The “ongoing process” of discovery is revealing that we are not the first advanced civilization on this planet, and we certainly weren’t the ones in charge.

subject: [VIDEO] 👉 7-Steps Make Any Argument Bulletproof (Antonia's Ti Frame)
body:
Mar 7... Antonia Teaches Introverted Thinking - Never be caught off guard again.
 

Never be caught off guard again. In this 20-min video Antonia walks through her 7-step process to create bulletproof logic and beliefs.

 

Hi Joshua,

 

I sat down with Antonia this week to discuss her entire 7-step process for refining thoughts and beliefs into bulletproof arguments.

 

This is the same deep Introverted Thinking process she used to rebuild her own mind after leaving a high-demand religious cult.

 

Refining your arguments is critical because most people enter conversations unprepared. You may have strong beliefs and some logic, but haven't reinforced your thinking. 

 

The moment someone asks a challenging question, everything feels harder and could fall apart. The biggest pain is not being wrong, but unprepared.

 

Antonia's been refining her thinking processes for over 15 years of coaching. I would love for you to learn this skill for your own life.
Watch "7-Steps To Bulletproof Arguments" ⮕
 

This Isn't Just About Winning Arguments

 

Honestly, I think this kind of clean, careful thinking might be the most valuable skill you can develop right now.

 

We're living in a world that's constantly trying to hijack our attention and manipulate how we think. If you've spent 5 minutes on social media you know what I'm talking about.

 

The ability to step back and examine your own beliefs without bias or borrowed assumptions is useful for debates, but it's also how you stay clear-headed when everything around you is designed to dysregulate you.

 

In our video, Antonia talks about how we're living in an era of spin,  where every narrative comes with a twist, every piece of information comes packaged with how you're supposed to think about it.

 

Most people don't even realize their assumptions were never theirs. They borrowed them from parents, political parties, communities, and never examined whether they actually hold up.

 

Antonia's Introverted Thinking process teaches you to think cleanly. To examine your own beliefs with the same rigor you'd use on someone else's.
 

Bring One Truth / Belief To The Workshop & Together We'll Make It Bulletproof...

 

That's what this Saturday's workshop is for (March 7).

 

You'll bring one real truth or belief... something you care about defending, something that matters to you... and we'll walk you through this entire 7-step process live.

 

By the end, you'll have:

  • One belief refined to bulletproof precision
  • A repeatable framework to use on any argument
  • The ability to spot dirty thinking instantly (in yourself and others)

Workshop Details

Date: Sat, March 7th, 2026
Time: 12pm - 3pm (Eastern Time USA)
Where: Live on Zoom (recording provided)
What to bring: One belief or truth you want to strengthen
Make Your Arguments Bulletproof ⮕

Here are the 7 steps she breaks down in the video:

  1. Define all your terms - Stop assuming everyone knows what you mean (including yourself)
  2. Unearth your assumptions - Find the borrowed beliefs you never examined
  3. Spot category errors, biases, and distortions - Catch the logical gaps hiding in your reasoning
  4. Test your logic for weaknesses - Find the holes before someone else does
  5. Steelman the opposing view - Strengthen their argument so yours has to hold up against their best case
  6. Ground it in core vs contextual principles - Know if your belief is universal or situational
  7. Remove bias and agenda - Strip it clean using Introverted Thinking

The video is about 20 minutes. If you're short on time, skip to the 7-step breakdown around the 6-minute mark. Worth every minute.

 

Hope to see you at the workshop on Saturday.
 


Much Love,

Joel Mark Witt & Antonia Dodge
Co-Founders | Personality Hacker
 

PS - Make Your Arguments Bulletproof

We're hosting a live workshop on March 7 teaching Antonia's 7-step system to refine any truth or belief to precision. This is the exact process she used to reprogram her own mind after leaving a cult.

And it's one of the core skills of Introverted Thinking (Accuracy).

subject: 145. Maranga Mai! Maranga Ake! (Rise up! Stand up!)
body:
View this post on the web at https://markmcguire.substack.com/p/145-maranga-mai-maranga-ake-rise

February 6 is Waitangi Day in Aotearoa New Zealand — a national holiday marking the signing in 1840 of Te Tiriti o Waitangi (the Treaty of Waitangi) by Indigenous Māori chiefs and representatives of the British Crown. It is the founding document of this Pacific nation and allows Pākehā (non-Polynesian settlers and their descendants) to live alongside tangata whenua (the Indigenous people of the land).
The day is marked by official ceremonies, celebrations, and activations. Although it may look like a protest, with groups marching, assembling, and giving speeches, an activation is not a protest in the conventional sense. Rather than expressing opposition to something, it is a proud declaration of Māori identity, strength, and self-determination. An activation is a collective awakening — a call for connection and upward movement: physical, political, spiritual, and communal. The aim is to activate people — to bring them into alignment with kaupapa (shared cause, values, and intent), whakapapa (genealogy, lineage, and relational connections), and whenua (the land).
Thanks for reading Street Photography! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
Like a choir or a barn-raising, it brings people with a shared sense of purpose together to create something greater than what is possible for individuals acting alone. People who stand together stay together, bound to one another like flax woven into a kete (a basket or bag traditionally made from harakeke, New Zealand flax) to hold collective knowledge, shared resources, contributions, and gifts.
You can see all the full-resolution photos I shared of this event here [ https://substack.com/redirect/f05a00ca-0b41-49b1-a342-1aaa00e8fccc?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].
And yet, while people gather here to stand up for justice and self-determination, powerful nations elsewhere are doing the opposite.
Spotlight
I am writing this on the fifth day of the illegal war of choice launched against Iran by the United States and Israel.
Somewhere between 555–780 people have been killed in Iran so far — including up to 168 people at the Shajareh Tayyebeh School in Minab, mostly young girls who were victims of the initial attack. Dozens more have been killed in other countries, including Lebanon, Israel, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman.
Not Rising, Not Standing Up
Most nations around the world have failed to stand up for the United Nations Charter, the international rules-based order, and the importance of negotiations that had been ongoing. At a moment that calls for nations to rise up and stand up, most have chosen instead to look away.
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said:
Australia supports the United States acting to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and to prevent Iran from continuing to threaten international peace [and] security. 
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and France’s President Emmanuel Macron expressed similar “the end justifies the means” positions. Germany and the UK were more cautious, refusing to support or denounce the strikes while remaining silent on the issue of legality. 
Perhaps the most disappointing reaction came from Christopher Luxon, the Prime Minister of New Zealand, who, with Foreign Minister Winston Peters, issued a formal statement that “acknowledged” the war without expressing support or opposition: 
…we acknowledge that the actions taken overnight by the US and Israel were designed to prevent Iran from continuing to threaten international peace and security.
— Statement by Luxon & Peters [ https://substack.com/redirect/887d3e93-c0c6-44de-a5db-e1115ab83b94?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] (1 March 2026) [ https://substack.com/redirect/887d3e93-c0c6-44de-a5db-e1115ab83b94?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
Luxon later made it clear that it was up to the United States and Israel to say whether their war on Iran was legal, and New Zealand would not be demanding evidence of legal justification from them:
Issues of legality [are] for Israel and the US to talk to because we're not party to that information or that intelligence they may have.
— Christopher Luxon [ https://substack.com/redirect/428af20f-5232-48e4-9800-4230a003f7e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] (2 March 2026) [ https://substack.com/redirect/428af20f-5232-48e4-9800-4230a003f7e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
Rather than rising to the occasion and standing up for international law — on which small countries like New Zealand depend for their safety — Prime Minister Christopher Luxon chose to step back and effectively remove himself from the international stage.
Chris Hedges and The Chris Hedges Report Substack [ https://substack.com/@chrishedges ]
Photographers understand the usefulness of trying different perspectives and points of view when grappling with a complex scene; the same strategy can help us come to terms with the complexity of current events. Chris Hedges is one of the many experienced, well-respected, independent journalists on Substack who can help us make sense of what is going on in this increasingly unstable world. I have linked to two of his recent posts below.
Resistance101: Forging a New Movement for Palestine in Italy DOCUMENTARY [ https://substack.com/redirect/1d4e1b5b-e1db-4f73-a1cd-1e6a71698470?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
As the genocide in Gaza has continued for almost three years, Italian dockworkers have risen up to do what our governments and international institutions refuse to.
Check out The Chris Hedges Report Substack [ https://substack.com/@chrishedges ] and support his independent journalism. You can follow The Chris Hedges Report on social media using these links [ https://substack.com/redirect/bfacee5b-f627-4e33-ba3a-a631a780b70c?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. 
If activation means rising together in support of our shared values, strongly held principles, and a sense of justice, then perhaps it is not only something for Waitangi Day.

The official line from Cairo and Munich is that these are “construction voids” or “structural reliefs” designed to manage the weight of the stone. Simultaneously, in the hills of Turkey, the excavations at Karahantepe have reached a fever pitch. Archeologists have uncovered an “amphitheater” and T-shaped pillars featuring hauntingly realistic human faces, dated to 9,000 BCE, long before the official dawn of agriculture. The academic world is “baffled.” They call it a mystery, a riddle of “hunter-gatherers” who somehow decided to build a massive stone complex for no apparent reason. This is the narrative they feed the masses: a series of disconnected, ancient “mysteries” that bear no relation to our modern world. But the official story is full of holes.
The Anomaly: The Red Thread of 2026
Why is this happening now? Why are the pyramids “opening” to our scanners at the same moment that Karahantepe is being unearthed? To find the answer, we have to look at the pulse of the planet itself.
Earth’s magnetic North Pole is currently racing toward Siberia at a speed of over 50 kilometers per year. The South Atlantic Anomaly, the “weak spot” in our planet’s magnetic shield, has officially begun to split in two. Science calls these “regional fluctuations.” I call them the opening of the gates.
Historical records from Sumer and Egypt describe a time when the “Heavens” and the “Earth” were connected by a bridge. In the Secret History tradition, we understand that these “gods,” the Fallen, or The Neighbors, didn’t just build monuments; they built a global frequency network.

This brings us back to Admiral Byrd. In 1947, Byrd reported seeing “land beyond the poles” and craft that could move from space to the ocean in an instant. He was silenced, but the data remained. Today, as the Antarctic ice shelf thins at an unprecedented rate, military sensors are picking up “non-human infrastructure” deep beneath the ice. This isn’t just rock and frozen water. subject: Field Guide to the Everyday
body:
View this post on the web at https://robwalker.substack.com/p/field-guide-to-the-everyday

One of the more challenging prompts in The Art of Noticing  [ https://substack.com/redirect/64d25d01-b4cb-4431-a3a3-7cfc8c426bce?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]book [ https://substack.com/redirect/64d25d01-b4cb-4431-a3a3-7cfc8c426bce?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] is the suggestion to “make a field guide.” The easiest way to explain what I mean by that is with an example, and I am delighted to share a great one today.
For several years now, author and friend of TAoN Anne Gisleson [ https://substack.com/redirect/9ee09208-40d4-4bf6-90cb-b6435ae4c5b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] has graciously invited me to her creative writing class at the New Orleans Center for Creative Arts [ https://substack.com/redirect/f3bf2676-289f-412b-bba7-2756ef6eaeee?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], a public arts high school here. These visits are always a blast. 
Among other things, the students pick one of the exercises in the book to inspire a creative noticing project — a zine, videos, interviews, whatever they wish — and it’s invariably impressive and fun and impressively fun. This year’s class made a “Field Guide To Area Kitchens.” 
Even before I saw what they’d done, I loved this idea — mostly we think of a “field guide” as a tool to help identify birds or plants or somesuch, but why not apply it to the domestic sphere? Isn’t the territory of the home worth systematically exploring and noticing and categorizing, too? 
The key to an engaging and illuminating field guide is coming up with good categories that balance comprehensiveness with idiosyncrasy. So in this case, we get a floor plan, a photograph, and appliance ratings, as well as individual notes that leave room for personality and individuality. It’s a model of the form!
It’s also — and I don’t think the students will mind this judgment — pleasingly silly. At first glance, at least, it seems almost absurd to give this much thought to your own kitchen. In this way it’s a classic “pointless” project [ https://substack.com/redirect/4a574403-60fe-482f-9611-660370184723?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. (That’s a good thing.)
But dig a little deeper and the field guide is quietly revealing, offering little glimpses of day-to-day life — giving a considered look at spaces we take for granted, and discovering what that inspires. 
The 24-page zine they created also includes some amusing and insightful bonus findings — discovering that every stove seems to have a most-popular burner, for instance — and the “group bio” exercise from the book. 
Bravo!
What’s your favorite field guide? If you had to make one, what subject would you choose? What if you were to collaborate on a field guide, with a class, family, or a group of friends? 
My deepest thanks to Anne [ https://substack.com/redirect/9ee09208-40d4-4bf6-90cb-b6435ae4c5b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] and her students — from past years, too! It’s always a thrill to know the book helps inspire such lovely creativity. 
Noticing is about other people, too. The Icebreaker series aims to help with that. There’s a central collection spot for all the icebreakers to date, here [ https://substack.com/redirect/4d0d220c-5f2d-4372-9147-699721cd7fb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].
Today’s Icebreaker comes from The Guardian [ https://substack.com/redirect/48d7bf35-486e-449c-8ae0-227b6ca29db0?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]:
“What’s the nicest thing a stranger has done for you?”
This question is the basis of Guardian series on “the kindness of strangers [ https://substack.com/redirect/4188e898-9bc1-4716-89f5-21b3060a3d88?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].” 
Please send your favorite icebreaker (whether you made it up or found it elsewhere) to consumed@robwalker.net [ mailto:consumed@robwalker.net ].
SUPPORT TAoN
If you enjoy TAoN, please become a paid supporter [ https://substack.com/redirect/a407dbbd-6e8e-446e-9f36-4a82a4f9e48e?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. You’ll get access to the full archives as well as supporter-only bonus posts and discussion threads. Your support makes this newsletter possible. Thank you!
IN OTHER NEWS
Fantastic post [ https://substack.com/redirect/680022be-c7ee-4252-b184-203bd0bf9333?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] by Mark Frauenfelder on how one little shift in attention/perception can lead to all sorts of noticing discoveries.
Museum-worthy display cases [ https://substack.com/redirect/b92dbe8b-72b7-44b0-9c5c-f65cee1fd201?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Can we get an exhibition of display objects? That would be amazing!
“Liminalism (if we can christen this as a movement, and we should).” My two cents is that this (generally good) essay [ https://substack.com/redirect/b9aa2420-4639-4fbc-81f6-61e51660b4db?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] ends up treating “liminal” as mostly a particular and very identifiable visual/architectural aesthetic. I think “liminal space [ https://substack.com/redirect/27c676f0-8d42-4018-b66b-89f13fd2bd43?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]” can be a much more interesting idea, for better and worse. Still, worth reading. I think this A24  [ https://substack.com/redirect/c6030c73-6795-4f9b-907f-d18a9ed6fca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]Backrooms [ https://substack.com/redirect/c6030c73-6795-4f9b-907f-d18a9ed6fca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] movie [ https://substack.com/redirect/c6030c73-6795-4f9b-907f-d18a9ed6fca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] is going to be a big branding moment for “liminalism.” (Thx Stacy!)
Field Guide to Dollar Tree Trees [ https://substack.com/redirect/c303d922-6075-47ed-9fd9-0b064828b2a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. “A collection of images of trees at Dollar Tree store locations across the United States.” (Via Kottke [ https://substack.com/redirect/84b8d42d-396f-406c-a04c-c3cd1925f6f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].)
Crisp packet design [ https://substack.com/redirect/b714924b-25eb-49a4-bebc-bd0327fc8c3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].
People [ https://substack.com/redirect/d3e384ef-ba31-4156-a1b4-0d342a88f714?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] standing on one leg.
Staff at the Lincoln Center keeps a list of botched movie titles from ticket-buyers (Upside Down, Anyways for Everything Everywhere All at Once, etc.). The Times shares a bunch of examples [ https://substack.com/redirect/3a6c28fa-308a-49a2-8de1-cf6fc369811e?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], and includes wrong-title “posters” created by Tala Safié [ https://substack.com/redirect/6fd6d090-9086-4208-a3ff-bf96c9ce68f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Brilliant! 
Walking Tour for Anywhere [ https://substack.com/redirect/cf3a1b4a-16ec-4c40-865f-886c6adb7325?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Interesting audio piece by Matt Bunk [ https://substack.com/redirect/7d182560-3c0e-4db0-ba93-cafb62720bee?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. 
Endorse [ https://substack.com/redirect/0449c610-78c1-4531-99de-e73376c30934?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]:
OKAY THAT’S IT!
As always, I value your feedback (suggestions, critiques, positive reinforcement, constructive insults directed at me, not at anyone else, etc.), as well as your tips or stories or personal noticing rituals, things we need a word for, and of course your icebreakers [ https://substack.com/redirect/f72ddcc9-459e-4871-bf42-7fd98102eb9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]: consumed@robwalker.net. Or use the comments.
—> Or just click the heart symbol. That always makes my day.
And thanks for reading …

subject: Family-Friendly Passover Seder Sun 3/29, ADHD Guest Speaker Sun 3/8, more!
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/tlc/twin-lakes-kids-thisweek-6429708?e=7d63af6d69)
https://tlc.org

Parenting & the Nervous System

What an incredibly rich parenting seminar this past Sunday!! Lacy Warne, LMFT, brought us tons of wisdom and practical tools for how to better understand ourselves, so we can be more present and available for our kids.

She covered the different zones of regulation (green, red, yellow) (https://mcusercontent.com/1abe188c7cc5e4aa6b0f74d9a/files/5450f2e1-67d0-58da-41b4-1b6e19ae6424/parenting_seminar_HANDOUT.pdf) and how that affects our responses to our kids during stressful times; the way our own story and triggers affect those zone & tools to help us “stay in the green.”

We also discussed what it means to help our kids build secure attachment, and the hope that “the best predictor of your child’s secure attachment is not whether you had a good childhood. It’s whether you’ve made honest sense of your own.”

Missed out or want to listen again? Check out…
* Lacy’s seminar recording here (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1v6OKUBLJzq5NIA_nR3AL1g-ycLF2ofqr/view?usp=sharing)
* Lacy’s seminar Powerpoint here (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zlmzwWB70AIPQ-VF-nRa7L8OE1kWICtI/view?usp=sharing)


March 2026 (+ looking ahead to Summer)
* TLK Teaching: “The Great Love Race” (https://mcusercontent.com/1abe188c7cc5e4aa6b0f74d9a/files/c999d170-979c-f470-58c6-e7d684265d48/family_resource_mar_2026_1_.pdf)
* Sat Mar 7: The Word (https://www.tlc.org/studies/the-word) Bible Conference
* Sun Mar 8: ADHD Support Group (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/1785/responses/new) (@ TLC) - Guest Speaker Martina Schilling, ADHD/Life Coach
* Mon Mar 9: Parent of Neurodivergent Kids (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScGcJVqG-d64jADebgXBbUaedBYI6BlotqTJs3JwPlzaTAKqw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=118172295908730725544) Support Group (Zoom)
* Sun Mar 15: “Better Together”: Parenting Seminars (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2051/responses/new) (two options)
+ Marriage Tools for Connection in Chaos
+ Single Parenting in Community
* Sun Mar 29:
+ “Finding Balance in Connection” (http://tlc.org/parentadventure) Parenting Seminar @ 11am
+ TLC Passover Seder (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2042/responses/new) (family-friendly!) @ 5pm
* SUMMER
+ June + July: Kruz Kidz @ TLC - register now! (https://kruzkidz.com/)
+ June 15-18: TLC Pre-school Vacation Bible School (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2025/responses/new) @ TLC
+ July 15 -18: Mother/Daughters Ranch Camp (https://www.mounthermon.org/events/kc-moms-daughters-ranch) @ Kidder Creek


https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2051/responses/new

Better Together:

"Marriage Tools for Connection in the Chaos"

Join Suzi & Jim Josselyn—parents of three grown kids—as they share insights from 33 years of marriage. Discover practical, Christ-centered tools that have helped them stay intentionally connected through the busyness of life, the challenges of raising kids, and the call to follow Jesus faithfully.

Better Together:

"Single Parenting in Community"

Connect with Yolanda Beaudoin, a single mom with 4 grown children + TLK's Children's Ministry Director, who will lead a discussion to help connect and encourage single parents!

RSVP for “BETTER TOGETHER” (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2051/responses/new)

https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2042/responses/new

A Seder is the traditional Passover celebration meal; Jesus hosted a Seder with his disciples before his crucifixion and resurrection.

TLC is excited to host a Passover Seder meal (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2042/responses/new) , an interactive experience featuring speaker Josh Sofaer with Jews for Jesus. Josh will explain the significance for Christians of the Passover dinner, which has been celebrated for over 4,000 years.

Sunday Mar 29, 5-7pm is an all-ages are welcome (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2042/responses/new) , and we encourage you to bring your children to this family-friendly event.  Age appropriate activities for younger children will be provided.

Want to serve with your kids to help make the Seder happen?! Contact maryjo@tlc.org for more info!
Register for Sun 3/29 Seder Experience (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2042/responses/new)

https://mcusercontent.com/1abe188c7cc5e4aa6b0f74d9a/files/671d5f71-16c9-b136-dba1-ba1d46a2ad3c/family_resource_jan_2026.pdf

TLK Teaching Theme: Jesus LOVES

Throughout our stories this month, the love of Jesus shines bright. Jesus’ unconditional love reaches beyond all boundaries. Jesus knew the suffering ahead, yet His love compelled Him to move forward for our sake. Even in the pain of betrayal, Jesus remained faithful—His love never wavered. Through every act, Jesus showed us a love that is constant, sacrificial, and beyond measure.

Elementary Memory Verse:

As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Abide in My love. (John 15:9)

Early Childhood Memory Verse:

Abide in my Love. (John 15:9)
Family Resource PDF for “JESUS LOVES” (https://mcusercontent.com/1abe188c7cc5e4aa6b0f74d9a/files/c999d170-979c-f470-58c6-e7d684265d48/family_resource_mar_2026_1_.pdf)

https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/1785/responses/new

* MONDAYS 3/9, 4/13, 5/11, 6/8
* Zoom
* Sign up for more info here! (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScGcJVqG-d64jADebgXBbUaedBYI6BlotqTJs3JwPlzaTAKqw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=118172295908730725544)

ADHD PARENT SUPPORT GROUP

This Sun 3/8, guest speaker Martina Schilling (local certified ADHD coach and facilitator), will share local resources and speak on current ADHD topics such managing technology, RSD (rejection sensitive dysphoria) and much more!
* In-person @ TLC, in Monschke Hall @ 11am
* SUNDAYS 3/8, 4/19, 5/10
* More info here (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/1785/responses/new)


https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2039/responses/new
Register for Divorce Care 4 Kids (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2039/responses/new)

Divorce Care 4 Kids is a 13-week program for children ages 5–12 whose parents are in a separation or divorce. It’s filled with activities, games, music, and crafts that help kids process their feelings and communicate with their parents. The children learn that they are loved, they will be okay, and God’s love will strengthen them.
* Sundays for 13 weeks starting April 12
* 12:45- 2:00pm
* Cost is $15


https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2025/responses/new
Register for Pre-K VBS Summer 2026 (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2025/responses/new)

Illumination Station VBS will teach kids that Jesus isn't just a person from history, a good man, or a wise teacher—but He is much more than that! Kids will be challenged to answer Jesus’ important question to His disciples, “Who do you say that I am?” They will discover Jesus is the perfect, proven, and powerful Son of God.
* For ages 3, 4 or entering Kinder in the fall
* June 15-18 (Monday-Thursday); 9am-12pm
* $100 for 4 days which includes a healthy snack every day, a craft and tons of fun!


http://kruzkidz.com
Register for KRUZ KIDZ 2026 (https://kruzkidz.com)

Kruz Kidz Summer 2026 Registration NOW OPEN

This summer, we will offer a wide variety of camps including soccer, lego robotics, nature camp, line dancing camp, art, science, and so much more! From high-energy camp wide team competitions to diving into God's word, there’s something for every child to explore, learn, and enjoy.

Visit kruzkidz.com for registration details and information about the scholarships we offer.

Moms & Daughters Ranch Camp

@ Kidder Creek, July 15-18

Alongside your daughter, enjoy daily trail rides, basic vaulting (gymnastics on horseback!), horse science, arena games, devotions, pond time, songs, skits, and campfires. subject: Springtime with Foothill - De Anza!
body:
Springtime with Foothill-De Anza Foundation Banner

A Taste of History Banner

Movements Without Borders: Expanding the Story of Belonging

Saturday, March 21, 2026 | 4:00 pm California History Center @ De Anza College

Join us to the 16th annual A Taste of History on March 21st, which will explore how the commitment to freedom, dignity, and the value of every voice strengthens democracy and communities.

Enjoy readings by Claudia Melendez Salinas, award winning journalist, poet, and author, and by Joseph LaCour, a Filipino and French Creole spoken word poet and hip-hop artist. In addition, entertainment will be provided by student drumming group Foothill Beats, who will bring you a wide range of styles from West Africa and the African diaspora.

Enjoy catering from local restaurants and wines from Silver Mountain Vineyards, Kings Mountain Vineyards, House Family Winery, Farm Day Family Winery and Cooper Garrod Vineyards.

$95 per person; ticket packages available

Proceeds support De Anza student multimedia and archival projects that preserve and share our local history.

Rotary Club of Los Altos: Pasta for Vets

Pasta for Vets!

Student Veterans in front of flags

Since 2012, the Rotary Club of Los Altos has been generously supporting Foothill College student veterans with academic scholarships, and grants for books and emergency housing, as well as weekly lunches, meaningful camaraderie, and mentoring.

Please consider purchasing a ticket or a table for The Rotary Club of Los Altos Annual "Pasta for Vets" on March 27 at the Los Altos Community Center.

Proceeds benefit Foothill's student veterans.

Purchase tickets at the button below. If you are unable to attend, please consider making a donation to support the event and our students. This annual event does sell out!


[if mso]> <![endif] (https://t.e2ma.net/click/srxzbj/wqrlpyye/40cj4v)




A Moment of Remembrance

We want to take a moment to honor Dick Henning, a longtime friend of the Foothill-De Anza community and our foundation, who passed away in February. His amazing presence and contributions have touched so many lives.

Dick was a professor, dean and adminstrator at Foothill College. Many may know Dick as the founder of the Foothill College Celebrity Forum, which for 50 years brought remarkable voices and ideas to our campuses. Others know him through his leadership with the Rotary Club of Los Altos where he championed student success. Dick brought curiosity, generosity, and a memorable spark to every room he entered.

We are grateful for Dick's lasting impact on our campuses and community, and we hold his family, friends, and loved ones in our thoughts.

Dick Henning Obituary Picture



Foothill College Day on the Hill

Explore Foothill College!

Come see what Foothill College is all about! Join us for an open house on Saturday, May 2, from 9 a.m. to 1:30pm to meet students, faculty and staff. Take a campus tour, explore majors and clubs, and get help with registration and financial aid applications.
