subject: Inside: Your Guide to Getting Outdoors ⛰️
body:
Discover All to Do Near Youhttps://www.recreation.gov 

This year is for Outdoor at the Core, and whether you're looking for outings close to home or want to try something new, Recreation.gov is here to help you find the right outdoor experience for you! Discover all the ways you can explore your public lands below and start planning today.

BRING HOME A STORY https://www.recreation.gov

https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=camping&use_location=true&clear=true 

Whether it's tent or RV camping, use filters to find campsites with amenities like waterfront views, shade, bathrooms, electricity hookups and more!

EXPLORE CAMPSITES https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=camping&use_location=true&clear=true

https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=tickets+%26+tours&user_location=true&clear=true 

Add a unique experience to your trip with a guided tour of cultural and historic sites. You might even explore an underground cave!

FIND TICKETS & TOURS https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=tickets+%26+tours&user_location=true&clear=true

https://www.recreation.gov/pass/#site-specific-digital-passes 

Save time when you arrive. Site passes cover entrance or standard amenity (day-use) fees at a single location and are available immediately for download on your mobile phone.

BUY A SITE PASS https://www.recreation.gov/pass/#site-specific-digital-passes

https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=activity+pass&user_location=true&clear=true 

Arrive ready for your trip. Activity passes cover fees for off-highway vehicle areas, boat ramps, fishing and more!

BROWSE ACTIVITIES https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=activity+pass&user_location=true&clear=true

https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=permits&user_location=true&clear=true 

Find options across the country for special opportunities like backcountry camping, popular hikes, whitewater rafting and more.

DISCOVER PERMITS https://www.recreation.gov/search?inventory_type=permits&user_location=true&clear=true

**GUIDE TIP**

****Keep these tips in mind for successful trips across your public lands and waters this year:

✅ 

**Know Before You Go:** Check the facility and agency pages of the location you’re planning to visit for any updates that may impact your trip.

🗑️ 

**Leave No Trace:**Dispose of your waste properly, come prepared with the gear and equipment you need, and make sure to leave only footprints behind.

🌎 

**Recreate Responsibly:**Stay on trails, follow the rules of the location you plan to visit, and respect wildlife by maintaining a safe distance.

subject: the worlds are splitting...TODAY!
body:
I've been fasting and praying for days.

Watching what's happening in Iran. Watching the news that nobody can quite make sense of anymore. And something kept rising in my spirit that I couldn't shake:

The world as we knew it is gone.

Not going. Gone.

And I think you feel it too — not just in the headlines but in your own life. There are people you've loved for years, maybe decades, who you can't even have a conversation with anymore. Something has shifted. The gap keeps widening. It's not just political. It's spiritual.

Two worlds are forming. Babylon and the Kingdom. And everyone is choosing — consciously or not.

Scripture says without vision the people perish. And you don't put new wine into old wineskins.

That's what today is about.

The old structures — the LLCs, the 501(c)(3)s, the estate plans built inside a system that is visibly crumbling — those are old wineskins. And what God is pouring right now is new wine.

Today at noon Central, Bradley Logan and I are going live for the Divine Law Masterclass. Bradley spent 33 years as a licensed attorney. He knows both worlds. And he's going to show you what it looks like to build inside the right one.

Lawfully. Biblically. For the generation that comes after you.

Register here → www.DivineLawMasterclass.com

Noon Central. Today. The Cost Has Been Covered For You. Just Show Up.

The worlds are splitting. Know where you're building.
— Jonathan

P.S. This isn't for the casually curious. It's for the ones who already feel the weight of this moment and want to do something about it.

subject: The Anak Gene: The Biological Blueprint of the Intruders
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-anak-gene-the-biological-blueprint

The scouts stood on the ridge, their breath catching in the dry heat of the Canaanite wilderness. They had been sent to survey the land, to see if it was as fertile as promised. But what they saw through the shimmering haze didn’t just frighten them; it broke their understanding of reality.
When they returned to Moses, their report was chilling: “The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size... We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them.”
They were talking about the Anakim.
For generations, we have dismissed these accounts as the exaggerations of a desert tribe, the “Tall Tales” of a Bronze Age civilization. But as I’ve followed the “Red Thread” across continents and through dusty museum basements, I’ve realized that the Anakim weren’t a metaphor. They were a biological reality. They were the living, breathing evidence of a planetary intervention that the official history books are desperate to ignore.
The Official Story: The Scholar’s Comfort Zone
If you open a standard archaeological textbook, you will find a very comfortable explanation for “giants.” Scholars will tell you that the Anakim, the Rephaim, and the Nephilim were literary devices used by ancient authors to emphasize the power of their god by making their enemies seem insurmountable. They point to the “Enuma Elish” or the “Epic of Gilgamesh” and say, “See? Everyone had myths about giants. It’s just cultural flavor.”
The academic community is terrified of the word “Biology.” They are fine with “Myth,” but as soon as you suggest that these entities had a specific genetic makeup that differed from Homo sapiens, you are crossing a line into what they call “pseudo-history.” They want us to believe that the physical world has always been a linear progression of smaller, simpler beings evolving into us.
But the official story has a massive problem. It can’t explain the “Hardware” left behind.
The Turning Point: The Execration of Truth
The anomaly that breaks the mainstream narrative isn’t found in a storybook, but in the pottery of Ancient Egypt. Around 1800 BC, the Egyptians practiced a ritual of “Execration.” They would write the names of their enemies on clay bowls or figurines and smash them to magically curse them.
Among these “Execration Texts,” we find something startling: the names of the leaders of the Anakim. These weren’t mythological figures to the Egyptians; they were specific, terrifying political leaders in the Levant that had to be dealt with through state-level sorcery. They were real enough to fear.
But it goes deeper. When we look at the megalithic architecture of the region, structures like Gilgal Refaim (The Wheel of the Giants), we find stone circles that align with the stars, built with blocks so massive they defy the tools of the era. Why do these sites always correlate with the biblical “Land of the Giants”?
This is the “Biological Proof.” We are looking at a lineage that possessed a different physical capacity. This isn’t just about height; it’s about a different density of bone, a different neurological connection, and, most importantly, a different origin. Socrates once recounted a story of an Egyptian priest who spoke of the time “before the flood,” a time when the “gods” walked openly and shared their “School” with humanity. What if the Anakim were the remnants of that school’s darker side? What if they were the “Intruders’” attempt to maintain a physical presence on Earth through a hybrid gene?
The Authoritative Synthesis: The Genetic Hijack
In my work with “Secret History,” I’ve identified what I call “The Hijack.” This was the moment when “The Neighbors,” those entities who have monitored us since the beginning, decided to intervene directly in our genetic development. The Anakim were the biological “Pillars” of this intervention.
Think of it this way: 3,000 years ago, the Kajuna calendar was being meticulously maintained by those who understood the cycles of the stars. Could this be the same knowledge used by the Maya or the builders of the Sumerian ziggurats? The Anakim were the “administrators” on the ground. They weren’t just big; they were designed for dominance. They were the physical “Hardware” used by “The Intruders” to enforce their will before the next “Frozen Cycle” reset the board.
We see this pattern repeated in the legends of the South American gods, like the Murung gods, or the stories Corey Goode brought to Gaia about “breakaway civilizations.” These aren’t isolated incidents. They are the same “Red Thread” being pulled through different cultures. The Anakim were the enforcers of the “Intruders,” a specific biological lineage meant to keep humanity in a state of “The Hijack” controlled, fearful, and productive.
Admiral Byrd, during his flights over the poles, registered green lands where there should have been ice. He spoke of a “breakaway” presence. Is it possible that the Anak gene didn’t die out in the desert of Canaan? Is it possible that the “Neighbors” simply moved their biological assets to the “Polar Nexus” to wait out the current cycle?
The Personal Bridge: Owning the Truth
Why does this matter to you? Because the “Anak Gene” represents the part of our history that was stolen. We have been taught to feel like “grasshoppers” in the face of authority, in the face of science, and in the face of our own past.
When you look at the evidence, the Execration Texts, the megalithic wheels, the consistent biological anomalies across all cultures, you realize that you aren’t living in a world of accidents. You are living in a world of design. The Anakim were the proof that “The Intruders” can manifest physically. They are the side-proof for my theory of the Polar Nexus: that our world is managed by those who possess a different biological and technological “Hardware.”
But here is the secret: If they had to use “Giants” to control us, it’s because the human soul is inherently difficult to suppress. They needed a physical “Hijack” because our spiritual “Software” is far more powerful than we realize. By acknowledging the reality of the Anakim, we stop being the grasshoppers. We start seeing the administrators for what they are: residents of the same cycle, desperately trying to maintain control of a school they no longer lead.
Secret History

subject: Yahweh: The Administrator of the Smoke and Gold
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/yahweh-the-administrator-of-the-smoke

Imagine standing in the heart of a scorching desert. Before you stands a structure that defies the nomad’s logic. It is wrapped in acacia wood plated with pure gold, shimmering under a sun that feels closer than it should. The air isn’t filled with the scent of peace; it is thick with a very specific, pungent blend of resinous incense and the heavy, metallic smell of sacrificial blood and burning fat. There is a low-frequency hum in the air, a vibration that makes the hair on your arms stand up.
You aren’t at a place of worship. You are at a technical installation. You are standing before the Tabernacle.
For millennia, we have been told that this was the dwelling place of the Infinite Creator of the Universe. But when I look at the instructions given to Moses with the eyes of a researcher rather than a devotee, I don’t see the requirements of an omnipotent, spiritual consciousness. I see the technical specifications of a physical habitation, and the desperate needs of a biological entity operating within our dense, physical reality.
The Official Story: The Scholar’s Foundation
Traditional theology paints a grand portrait of Yahweh as the monotheistic source of all life. He is the “I Am,” the boundless, righteous, and all-knowing God who led the Israelites out of Egyptian bondage. We have been conditioned to interpret his fierce demands for loyalty, his strict dietary laws, and his minute instructions for sacrifice as symbolic tests of faith or early moral frameworks for a primitive people.
Biblical scholars have long wrestled with the “personality” of Yahweh. In one chapter, he is a protective father; in the next, he is a vengeful warlord commanding the total extermination of neighboring tribes. This jarring inconsistency is usually waved away as “divine mystery” or the evolving human understanding of God. But as I’ve dug deeper into the ancient records, the official story begins to feel like a veil, a beautiful tapestry hung to hide a much darker, much more physical reality.
The Turning Point: The Hardware of a God
When I study the oldest texts, one thing becomes undeniably clear: Yahweh had physical needs. He didn’t just want “prayer”; he wanted logistics.
In Exodus 30, we see a recipe for a very specific holy oil and incense. These weren’t just for “smelling nice.” The ingredients, liquid myrrh, sweet cinnamon, and cassia, are compounds that have specific chemical and antiseptic properties. Why would an infinite spirit require a specific chemical environment? Why was the Tabernacle lined with gold, the most efficient conductor of electricity, and a shield against radiation?
When we compare Yahweh’s demands to the Sumerian texts regarding Enlil, the Anunnaki leader and “Lord of the Command,” the parallels are chilling. Both functioned as regional administrators. Both were obsessed with order, resource collection, and ensuring their biological needs were met in a planetary environment that was not their original home.
The Gnostics, those ancient keepers of the hidden flame, understood this two thousand years ago. They didn’t call him the Ultimate Source. They called him the Demiurge, a lower, descended deity who had become so lost in the density of the material world that he actually believed he was the only God. They saw him as a “descended” administrator, a being of great power but limited wisdom, trapped by his own ego and the need to control the human “garden.”
The Authoritative Synthesis: The Hijack of History
What I am seeing in my research is that Yahweh represents a specific, aggressive phase of “The Hijack.” He wasn’t the creator of the human soul; he was the entity that took over the management of a specific genetic lineage during a time when “The School” of human consciousness was being systematically infiltrated.
His authority was not based on spiritual truth, but on technological dominance. The “Pillar of Cloud” by day and the “Pillar of Fire” by night were not metaphors. They were aerial phenomena, physical craft that monitored and directed the movements of a captive population. Yahweh was an “Intruder” administrator, a representative of “The Neighbors” who realized that by controlling the narrative of “God,” they could control the trajectory of human history for thousands of years.
This is why the oldest Hebrew texts use the word Elohim, a plural noun. Yahweh was one of many. He was a regional governor fighting for his territory in an ongoing cosmic conflict. When he shouts, “You shall have no other gods before me,” he isn’t claiming to be the only power in the universe; he is issuing a non-compete clause. He is an administrator terrified that his workforce will defect to a rival manager.
Reclaiming Your Sovereignty
Why does this matter to you today? Why go back thousands of years to dissect the nature of an ancient desert deity?
Because as long as we believe that our ultimate authority comes from an external, demanding, and judgmental god, we remain in a state of spiritual infancy. We remain “subjects” rather than “sovereigns.” By recognizing Yahweh for what he truly was, a descended administrator, we finally strip away the false ceiling of our potential.
We are not “sinners” in the hands of an angry god. We are powerful, multidimensional beings who have been tricked into believing we are small. We have been managed, monitored, and manipulated by “The Neighbors” for eons. The “Secret History” I am uncovering isn’t just about the past; it’s about the present. It’s about realizing that the walls of the cage are made of stories we’ve been told to never question.
The administrator of smoke and gold is no longer in charge. It is time for us to remember who we were before the hijack began.

Sea the Future:

A Climate Dance Party




 Dance, drink, and help us protect the ocean!

Monterey Bay Aquarium
Ages: 18 and older
Tickets: $150 general admission, $135 members


https://click.email.montereybayaquarium.org/?%3D%3D

Marine biologist and New York Times bestselling author Ayana Elizabeth Johnson will be our special guest, mingling with attendees and signing copies of her book, What If We Get It Right? Visions of Climate Futures.

Welcome to Meditation Mondays! Every Monday, we will be uploading recordings from The Mind Body Spirit Institute’s free virtual meditation series: The Power of Community [ https://substack.com/redirect/35fa6892-557c-4452-aa11-39a4ac29ca57?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Each week, a different MBSI instructor leads a guided 15-45 minute meditation via Zoom.
This week, Tom Cole holds the space for us to sit in a brief silent meditation, aimed to help us ground and center ourselves through introspection and quiet reflection.
Register for The Power of Community (Spring 2026) [ https://substack.com/redirect/52141d71-595c-487c-8a4a-2b101638e37b?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] today, and check out our full event calendar here [ https://substack.com/redirect/33b41a4f-386e-4635-904b-b67dd1bd9391?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], now with our spring schedule! This program is virtual, so you can join us for FREE from anywhere in the world.
If you enjoyed this meditation, please consider donating to The Mind Body Spirit Institute. Your generous contributions allow us to continue meeting our community's rising need for mental health support by funding MBSI's public programming [ https://substack.com/redirect/86bd6bf6-8ef0-4a02-b06e-7ac2fd15f884?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] and consulting services [ https://substack.com/redirect/1bd68deb-f645-465a-a85b-9803ddfcdba0?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Thank you!
Claire Villarreal, PhD, received her doctorate from Rice University’s Department of Religion. She has taught academic courses at Rice and UH Clear Lake, and has led meditation sessions at Dawn Mountain, The Jung Center, Discovery Green, and various other settings in Houston and Fort Worth. She now adapts traditional Buddhist wisdom for online and in-person spiritual instruction.
For more from The Jung Center, follow us on social media or sign up for our weekly newsletter for updates!

subject: MANIFESTATION WITH RESONANT FREQUENCY High-Intensity Alignment Protocol
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/manifestation-with-resonant-frequency

This is not soft visualization.
This is not passive wishing.
This is identity warfare.
Resonant manifestation at high intensity means you eliminate internal contradiction and become a coherent force moving in one direction.
When thought, emotion, language, and action lock into alignment, momentum becomes unavoidable.
Here is the aggressive protocol.
PHASE 1: DECISION
No vibration shifts without decision.
Not “I hope.”
Not “I’ll try.”
Decision sounds like:
“This changes now.”
“I am done tolerating this.”
“I am becoming this version of myself.”
Write the outcome.
Define the timeline.
Sign your name under it.
Burn the bridge to retreat.
PHASE 2: IDENTITY INSTALLATION
Your current results reflect your current identity.
If you want different results, you must install a different self-concept.
Close your eyes and ask:
Who is the version of me that already has this?
How does that person move?
How do they speak?
What do they tolerate?
What do they refuse?
This mirrors the philosophy found in Think and Grow Rich by Napoleon Hill**, where belief fused with action creates transformation.
You are not waiting to become that person.
You become them first.
PHASE 3: EMOTIONAL IGNITION
Emotion is voltage.
Without emotional charge, your signal is weak.
Stand up.
Breathe deeply.
Visualize the outcome as DONE.
Feel the relief.
Feel the power.
Feel the certainty.
This aligns with the principle taught by Neville Goddard — assume the feeling of the wish fulfilled.
Not hopeful.
Not tentative.
Certain.
Do this daily until doubt feels foreign.
PHASE 4: LANGUAGE DOMINANCE
Your words either reinforce power or sabotage it.
Eliminate:
“I can’t.”
“This always happens to me.”
“I’m stuck.”
Replace with:
“I adapt.”
“I solve.”
“I rise.”
Language trains your nervous system.
Your nervous system dictates performance.
Control your words. Control your frequency.
PHASE 5: DAILY AGGRESSIVE ACTION
Intensity requires movement.
Every single day:
Do one thing that scares you slightly.
Take one step that moves income, health, or growth forward.
Remove one behavior that weakens you.
No zero days.
Momentum compounds faster than motivation.
PHASE 6: CUT INTERFERENCE
You cannot resonate power while entertaining weakness.
Cut:
Toxic conversations.
Endless scrolling.
Chronic complainers.
Self-pity narratives.
Silence the noise.
Protect your internal signal.
High resonance requires clean circuitry.
PHASE 7: EMBODIED CERTAINTY
Stop checking for proof.
Stop asking, “Is it working?”
Operate as if alignment is inevitable.
Walk differently.
Speak differently.
Decide faster.
The world responds to certainty.
Not arrogance.
Certainty.
PHASE 8: STRESS TRANSMUTATION
Pressure will rise when you elevate.
When obstacles appear:
Do not retreat.
Do not interpret resistance as failure.
Do not collapse emotionally.
Pressure is expansion attempting to break through your old ceiling.
Stand firm.
THE CORE LAW
Weak intention creates scattered action.
Scattered action creates inconsistent results.
Focused identity
Regulated emotion
Dominant language
Daily disciplined execution
= Resonant amplification

subject: The Judas Code: Villain, or the Only One Who Understood the Plan?
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/the-judas-code-villain-or-the-only

The moon hung low over the Garden of Gethsemane, casting long, twisted shadows through the olive trees. In the distance, the clatter of Roman armor and the flickering of torches signaled the end of an era. We all know what happens next. A man steps forward, leans in, and places a kiss on the cheek of his teacher. It is the most famous act of treachery in human history. For thirty pieces of silver, Judas Iscariot handed over the Son of God to his executioners.
Or did he?
For two thousand years, the name Judas has been a curse. He is the archetype of the snake in the grass, the man who sold his soul for a handful of coins. But as I’ve delved into the archives, the ones the Church tried to burn and the sands of Egypt tried to hide, a different story emerges. A story that doesn’t just change who Judas was, but changes the very nature of the reality we inhabit.
The Official Story: The Scholar’s Foundation
The traditional narrative is simple, linear, and serves a very specific purpose. In the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, and Luke, Judas is the treasurer of the disciples who let greed and, eventually, Satan enter his heart. His role is that of the necessary villain. Without his betrayal, there is no crucifixion; without the crucifixion, there is no resurrection. In this version, Judas is a tragic, pathetic figure who ends his own life in a field of blood, forever damned.
This story has been the bedrock of Western morality. It teaches us about loyalty, the dangers of avarice, and the inevitability of divine justice. But for the “Scholar” in me, there have always been holes in this plot. Why would a man who had seen water turn to wine and the dead rise sell it all for the price of a slave? Why did Jesus, who knew the hearts of all men, choose a “devil” to be his close companion and trust him with the group’s finances?
The official story tells us what happened, but it fails to explain why it happened in a way that makes logical sense.
The Gospel of the Anomaly
In 1978, a leather-bound papyrus codex was discovered in a cave in Middle Egypt. It sat in the hands of antiquities dealers for decades before finally being translated. It was the Gospel of Judas. This wasn’t a late forgery; it was a text mentioned by the early Church Father Irenaeus as early as 180 AD, a text he desperately wanted to suppress.
When you read this text, the entire “Hardware” of the crucifixion changes. In this version, Judas isn’t the traitor; he is the confidant. While the other disciples are busy arguing about who will be greatest in the “Kingdom of Heaven,” a physical kingdom they expect Jesus to build on Earth, Judas is the only one who understands that Jesus isn’t here to save the physical world. He is here to help us escape it.
The text describes Jesus laughing at the other disciples as they pray to a god they think is the Creator. He tells them, “None of you will understand the truth.” Only Judas stands up and says, “I know who you are and where you have come from. You are from the immortal realm of Barbelo.” This is the turning point. Judas wasn’t betraying Jesus to the Romans; he was helping Jesus “sacrifice the man that clothes me.” He was the only one brave enough to take on the role of the villain so that the “Great Hijack” of the human soul could be exposed.
The Authoritative Synthesis: Breaking the Cycle
This is where the threads of “Secret History” tie into the big picture. We have talked about the “Cycle,” the “Intruders,” and the “Neighbors.” To understand the Judas Code, we have to understand the Gnostic view of the world: that this physical reality is a “school” that has been turned into a “prison” by the Demiurge, a lower administrator who mimics the true Source.
In this context, the crucifixion wasn’t a “blood sacrifice” to appease an angry God (Yahweh). It was a demonstration of the soul’s ability to transcend the physical matrix. Jesus needed to exit the physical “Hardware” to show that the “Software” of the soul is immortal. But he couldn’t do it alone. He needed a “fixer.” He needed someone to handle the logistics of his departure.
Judas was that fixer. He was the one who understood that the “Kingdom of Heaven” isn’t a place you go to after you die; it’s a state of being you reclaim while you are alive. He wasn’t chasing silver; he was chasing the end of the Cycle. The “betrayal” was a scripted event, a “Red Thread” woven into history to signal that the time of the old gods, the Intruders who demand blood and gold, was coming to an end.
Think about it: Why did the early Church work so hard to erase this version? Because a humanity that understands its own sovereignty and its ability to exit the Cycle is a humanity that cannot be controlled. If Judas is a hero who helped Christ escape the Demiurge’s trap, then the entire structure of “Church authority” based on fear and sin collapses.
Your Exit Strategy
Why does this matter to you, right now, in 2026? Because we are currently in a period of intense “Discovery.” The old systems are cracking, and the truths that were buried in the sand for two millennia are resurfacing.
The story of Judas is the story of us. We have all been told we are “sinners,” that we are “broken,” and that we must follow the rules of the administrators to find peace. We have been taught to fear the “betrayer” within us. But what if that part of you, the part that questions the official story, the part that feels like an outsider, the part that knows this world isn’t quite right, is actually the part that understands the plan?
The Judas Code is a call to look past the surface of history. It’s an invitation to see that the “villains” of the old world are often the “librarians” of the new one. You aren’t here to serve the Cycle; you are here to break it.
We are moving into a time where the “Secret History” will no longer be secret. Every pillar we examine, from the Polar Nexus to the Gospel of Judas, is a side-proof of the same reality: You are more than the physical shell you inhabit. It is time to stop playing the role the administrators assigned to you and start understanding the plan.

subject: Why “Great Art” Is No Longer Enough: The 2026 Strategy for Artistic Sustainability
body:
View this post on the web at https://artmeetsculture.substack.com/p/why-great-art-is-no-longer-enough

Talent is no longer the differentiator.
That’s a tough pill for the studio purists, but it’s the reality of 2026.
For decades, we’ve been fed the Romantic Lie: the idea that if the work is deep enough and honest enough, the world will eventually find it. We were told that obscurity is just a temporary phase for the misunderstood genius.
But quiet discovery is dead.
We’re currently navigating a collision economy, a cultural landscape where images don’t just exist; they fight. It’s a space where aesthetics are flattened into five-second fragments, and visibility isn’t earned, it’s contested. In this climate, “great art” is just the baseline. Quality doesn’t create contact.
Contact requires a strategy.
The question for visual artists today isn’t just about making better work. It’s about creating cultural permanence in a system built for disposability.
The 50/50 Rule: Don’t Leave the Invitation to Chance
For too long, artists have treated their presentation like an afterthought, something for the gallery or the assistant to figure out. The studio was “sacred,” and the rollout was “secondary.”
That mindset is a career-killer.
In 2026, the energy you put into the Invitation has to match the energy you put into the work. We aren’t talking about hype for the sake of hype. We’re talking about the architecture of how your work hits the street. The framing, the narrative tension, the context, these aren’t cosmetic “marketing” moves. They are structural.
Art doesn’t exist in a vacuum. The Invitation is the bridge. Without it, your masterpiece is effectively invisible.
There’s a misconception that visibility ruins purity. In reality, invisibility ruins relevance. This isn’t about gaming an algorithm; it’s about building deliberate entry points. Whether it’s documenting the raw weight of the marble before the first cut or revealing the philosophical glitch in your code, the Invitation is where you give the work its meaning.
When you split your focus 50/50 between making the work and making the meaning, the work starts to move.
The “Paused in Action” Flex
In a digital world, perfection is boring.
A finished canvas on a white wall, perfectly lit, feels closed. It’s a period at the end of a sentence. It doesn’t breathe. What actually hits in 2026 is the unresolved moment, the work paused in action.
This isn’t about being messy; it’s about Narrative Tension. The charcoal line mid-gesture. The sculpture before the final polish. The audience doesn’t just want to see the result; they want to sense the motion.
In a culture drowning in finality, the “unfinished” feels like an insider moment. It shows the artist is still in the trenches with the work. It makes the audience more than just spectators; it makes them witnesses. And witnesses are the ones who buy in for the long haul.
The Virtue of Contradiction: Interrupt the Pattern
If attention is the new currency, contradiction is the hack.
The artists dominating right now aren’t always the ones with the most technical skill; they’re the ones creating pattern interrupts. They’re creating visual friction that forces the scroll to stop.
The Mix: Classical oil techniques meet street-level iconography.
The Clash: Heavy bronze sculpture distorted by digital glitches.
The Contrast: Minimalist forms hit with maximalist colour.
Friction generates curiosity. Opposition is oxygen. But it has to be intentional. True contradiction comes from your own internal logic, not a trending sound. When you pair opposites authentically, tradition vs. disruption, beauty vs. discomfort, you signal a level of intellectual maturity that the market can’t ignore.
Sustainability isn’t about repeating your hits. It’s about evolving the tension.
Sustainable Evolution: Mediums Change, the Spine Stays
There’s a trap in the collision economy: stagnation disguised as “branding.”
When an artist gets known for one “look,” the pressure to stay in that box is massive. But familiarity without evolution is just a slow death. The legends who stay relevant for decades don’t stay fixed in one medium. They keep a philosophical spine while taking massive swings in form.
The painter tries sculpture. The digital artist goes analogue. These aren’t identity crises, they’re expansions.
As long as the core inquiry, memory, power, materiality, stays intact, the medium is just a vehicle. Evolution takes courage. It might confuse a few collectors or shake up your gallery, but it proves you’re serious. Your audience doesn’t want a repeat; they want to see you grow.
Killing the Romantic Lie
The idea that discovery is organic is a fantasy. In 2026, discovery is engineered through tension and invitation.
This doesn’t make the art less “pure.” It makes the artist more responsible. You have to think in two dimensions: Depth and Distribution. Craft and Contact. Work and World.
The artists who master this dual-threat awareness aren’t just going to survive the Collision Economy, they’re going to run it.
Cultural Permanence is never an accident. It’s built through disciplined making, aggressive framing, and the refusal to be invisible. Great art matters, but great art that understands its moment is what stays.
The future doesn’t belong to the most talented. It belongs to the most intentional.

View this post on the web at https://robwalker.substack.com/p/savor-of-the-month-15

Once again it’s time for Savor of the Month!  
For newcomers: 
At the start of every month I announce one specific thing or theme to look out for, pay attention to, appreciate. The idea is to convert something everyday and taken for granted into something we might, yes, savor. 
And every month I create a chat thread where you can share what you are noticing, or enjoy what others have noticed. You can post pictures, drawings, written observations [ https://substack.com/redirect/7ddbc733-e7c0-4125-bb7a-aeed27039839?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], whatever works for you. “IN THE FURY OF HIS POWER…DANIEL 8:5” OPERATION EPIC FURY COMMENCES!
==========

“IN THE FURY OF HIS POWER…DANIEL 8:5” OPERATION EPIC FURY COMMENCES!

As you may have heard the USA Empire attacked Iran (Persia) today in Operation “Epic Fury” ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5141?id=364707.693.1.4aed127ed3f8d6e5c51c85f26e76841f ). The Ayatollah is dead.

What you may not recall is the prophecy from Daniel 8…

Daniel 8:5, “And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes. 6 And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and **ran unto him in the fury of his power**.

Coincidence? If you have been reading my newsletter for the past two years you would know it is not a coincidence. This prophecy is for the time of “the End”…right before the rising of the 4th Beast that wars with the Saints. Daniel 8 says it three times that this prophecy is for “the End”.

Notice the He Goat comes from “the west” and doesn’t touch the ground…it comes via sea and air. Its victory is complete…and it attacks with “Fury”.

Some will try and convince you this is referring to “Javan” or Turkey. But remember your history: Javan is the region where the Greece Empire was based. It was the original “West”.

That general area gave you the Roman Empire as well…just another version of Greece. If you look at our state and municipal buildings you will see Greek and Roman architecture. It is called Western Culture!

The mascot of the U.S. Navy is a… “Goat” ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5141?id=364707.694.1.a4a441e61c5784f0a0fcf39e8358fd93 ).

What you need to be aware of is what happens to this “Western Empire” after that great victory over Iran (Persia). It will become great for a time…but within the lifetime of that “great horn” …its power will be broken and that post WW2 USA Empire will be broken into 4 lesser powers. It doesn’t say how. But it does come next.

Daniel 8:7, And I saw him come close unto the ram, and **he was moved with choler against him** , and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand. 8 Therefore the **he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven**. 9 And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land. 10 And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them. 11 Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and **by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of the sanctuary was cast down**.

For those who say this He Goat must be Turkey, they are missing the hints that this is a global empire. The four horns that come up with less power are to all four directions… “four winds of heaven”. You won’t see this happen if it is Turkey. It is not geographically possible.

But one of the lesser horns that comes up… likely Turkey (Restored Ottoman Empire), which is currently a part of the post WW2 USA Empire through its NATO membership, will try to attempt to dominate the Middle East when it is no longer constrained by the USA Empire.

That horn will move to “the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land”.

It will fight with Israel for 42 months before the False Prophet (Antichrist) appears on the scene. Turkey is obsessed with Israel re-instituting the Temple Sacrifices, which will likely occur after the fall of Persia (Iran).

Revelation 13:1, And I stood upon the sand of the sea, **and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy**. 2 And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority. 3 And **I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed** : and all the world wondered after the beast. 4 And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him? 5 And **there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months. 6 And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle** , and them that dwell in heaven. 7 And **it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them** : and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

This deadly wound that is healed is the restoration of the Ottoman Empire. Remember the Beasts are empires…not people. Turkey will focus on restoring the Ottoman Empire now that Persia (Iran) is no longer an obstacle and the great He Goat (USA Empire) is broken into four lesser powers. NATO and the USA are already wanting to split. The UK no longer acts like an ally of the USA. It will split. Turkey, no longer dominated by a powerful USA led NATO, will move to dominate the Middle East…to the South, East, and the Pleasant Land (Israel).

This requires a weakened and broken post WW2 USA Empire. How that happens after we become great from the victory over Iran is not mentioned. But this is what is happening RIGHT NOW.

Is it a coincidence that the USA operation against Iran is called “Epic Fury”?

Daniel 8:6, And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

Why is this prophecy so important that I’ve ignored most everything else going on in the world? Because Daniel 8 is a Nexus Prophecy. It indicates when this event happens, what comes next is the rise of the Fourth Terrible Beast and the Time of the End.

subject: Barabbas and the Ballot The Crowd Always Chooses
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/barabbas-and-the-ballot-the-crowd

In one of the most revealing moments in Scripture, the people were given a choice: Jesus or Barabbas. They chose the condemned man. They chose the criminal. They rejected the innocent.
That moment was not just history. It was a warning about human nature. Crowds can be manipulated. Power structures can sway opinion. Truth can stand in front of people and still be rejected.
Many Americans see that same pattern surrounding Donald Trump [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=0 ].
For nearly a decade, he has been investigated, accused, indicted, attacked, and politically targeted. Yet again and again, narratives collapse, accusations weaken, and claims once mocked later prove grounded in reality. Concerns about foreign influence in 2020 were ridiculed, yet intelligence agencies acknowledged that foreign actors did attempt to influence American public opinion. The interference was real. The debate was not imaginary.
He enforced immigration law and was branded extreme. He moved to remove those who entered the country illegally and was called cruel. Yet the enforcement of immigration law did not begin with him. Under Barack Obama [ chatgpt://generic-entity?number=1 ], deportations and removals reached historic highs. More individuals were removed during parts of Obama’s presidency than during Trump’s first term. The difference was not enforcement. The difference was narrative.
When Trump speaks about protecting children from trafficking and exploitation, he is mocked by some as dramatic. Yet child trafficking is real. Exploitation is real. Networks have been exposed. Arrests have been made. The moral crisis is not theoretical.
The pattern is unmistakable to his supporters. When he challenges entrenched institutions, those institutions mobilize. When he questions powerful interests, investigations follow. When he pushes border enforcement, he is labeled heartless. When he exposes corruption, he is called divisive.
The contrast is stark. Policies similar in effect are praised under one administration and condemned under another. Enforcement under one leader is called responsible. Enforcement under Trump is called authoritarian. The same act receives a different headline.
This is why the Barabbas moment resonates. It is not about equating any modern figure with Christ. It is about recognizing how public sentiment can be steered. It is about how authority, media influence, and political machinery can shape perception until millions cheer for the very forces that undermine them.
Crowds do not always choose wisely. They often choose what they are told is safe. They choose what is packaged as acceptable. They choose what protects the system they have been conditioned to trust.
Yet history has a way of revealing what was true all along.
The question facing America is not simply about one man. It is about whether truth is determined by institutions or by evidence. It is about whether enforcement of law is justice or oppression depending on who enforces it. It is about whether protecting borders and children is radical or responsible.
The crowd once chose Barabbas.
The lesson is not about ancient Rome. It is about every generation that must decide whether it will follow headlines or facts, pressure or principle, comfort or conviction.
History watches.

subject: “An extravagant, delightful, ridiculous, and wholly unnecessary gimmick”
body:
View this post on the web at https://post.substack.com/p/an-extravagant-delightful-ridiculous

This week, we’re terraforming the desert, sniffing Oreos, and attempting to capture a person’s essence in a photograph.
THE DISCOURSE
Briefly noted
Citrini moves markets: Despite a caveat at the top of The 2028 Global Intelligence Crisis [ https://substack.com/redirect/06f71c6e-de6f-4dbe-9279-6f224c81c311?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] by Citrini  and Alap Shah  that what followed was an imagined scenario, many in the tech and finance sectors viewed the doomer vision of AI-driven economic collapse as if it were news from the future. And the market took notice: the post was cited as a reason the stock market plunged earlier this week. Michael Burry  described it as a “brilliant, gut-wrenching approach [ https://substack.com/@michaeljburry/note/c-218550753?utm_source=notes-share-action&r=48ea6r ]” to predicting AI futures, while Noah Smith  described it as “just a scary bedtime story [ https://substack.com/redirect/c5da713a-61b0-4ac8-8b85-e4acddd4b0e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].” Regardless of the accuracy of the narrative itself, it’s hard not to notice when a work of speculative fiction can move very real markets (and inspire financial firms to publish rebuttals [ https://substack.com/redirect/7cd01d34-d054-4175-944c-eab3a7ad0eb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]).
Anthropic vs the Pentagon: The federal government and the AI company Anthropic clashed this week over the company’s hard limits on the use of its technology for mass surveillance or lethal autonomous weapons without human oversight. As of Friday evening [ https://substack.com/redirect/d2cd5437-7bc1-4ac6-b6a6-7db3c7c7994d?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], the Trump administration seemed ready to make good on its threat to designate Anthropic a “supply chain risk,” which would bar government contractors from using its products and could, per Scott Alexander , be fatal to the company’s business [ https://substack.com/redirect/afd79c36-2543-4ca3-9125-7d6b1bd3d876?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Employees at OpenAI and Google have signed open letters urging their own leaders to back Anthropic and commit to the same stances. Meanwhile, San Francisco’s hippy history and its tech present collided on Hippy Hill, where a “Peace Claude” rally [ https://substack.com/redirect/21a52dc6-52cd-4c64-8daf-7d69a18d018e?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] took place.
CBK dominates fashion discourse (again): Ryan Murphy’s show chronicling the love story of JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette Kennedy has led to a new generation’s obsession with her ’90s minimalism. anastasiacng  writes about CBK’s discernment [ https://substack.com/redirect/7733b5f6-b22a-4a3a-a35a-9015ab41929b?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] as the real reason behind her enduring popularity, while Viv Chen  reports that a “CBK tax” on vintage basics [ https://substack.com/redirect/ae3d84f0-dc70-4888-9ce3-d3ff5ec19a9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] has hit eBay and laura reilly  lists the (many) brands trying to capitalize on the moment [ https://substack.com/@magasin/note/c-220350911?r=48ea6r&utm_medium=ios&utm_source=notes-share-action ]. Allison Bornstein  reminds us that CBK’s consistent sense of style [ https://substack.com/@allisonbornstein/note/c-220099624?utm_source=notes-share-action&r=48ea6r ] reflects the fact that she spent only a few years in the public eye before her tragic death. And for those ready to move on from CBK but perhaps not from the ’90s, Cartoons Hate Her  has a broad list of icons to pick from [ https://substack.com/redirect/9f0ebbb1-b45a-4076-b43f-b1f086257a40?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], including Margaret Thatcher, Al Gore, and Geraldo Rivera.
PORTRAITURE
On photography
Dina Litovsky on the ethics of portrait photography, and why making someone look good isn’t the same as making a good photograph.
What Does a Photographer Owe the Portrait Subject? [ https://substack.com/redirect/c76d18bf-bc5d-49da-9335-25b8ab2122f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Dina Litovsky  in In the Flash  
During any portrait session, my mind engages in a constant negotiation between the sitter’s preferred version of themselves and my own interpretation of them. The balance is not symmetrical, because no matter how formidable the person in front of me, the photographer always has more power. Every decision, from what to emphasize or conceal to what expression to tease out, adds up to a representation that is outside the subject’s control. This delicate dance comes with a sense of responsibility to ensure that the final portrait is, at the very least, non-manipulative. What makes the process trickier is that no matter who my subject is, my secret desire is that they, if not love, at least don’t hate the final portrait. That is often a tall order.
While [Michael] Heizer laid out his terms up front, many other subjects are less forthright and leave the photographer with more room for interpretation and guesswork. To find the subject’s baseline, I like to ask the person if there are any portraits of them that they love. This gives me a reference point for how they see themselves at their best. In most cases, the image that I’m shown, regardless of the age or sex of the subject, is an idealized representation, but one that is rarely interesting as a photograph. The exercise reveals that while it’s easy to appreciate the artistic merits of someone else’s portrait, when it comes to your own likeness, what matters most is whether the image is flattering.
This is where the struggle comes in. One of my hidden photography superpowers has always been understanding how a person likes to be perceived and what their best angles are. I can make people look good, but that doesn’t necessarily add up to a portrait that goes beyond the superficial and holds enough tension to make it interesting. There are requests that I honor, whether it’s avoiding the “bad side” or concealing sensitive areas like a bald patch. But when it comes to framing and emotion, I often end up at odds with the subject, and the tighter their control over their self-presentation, the more I want to break through that facade and catch them outside their comfort zone.
There are two genres where the complex calculations of how to best represent the subject are reduced to extreme dead ends—celebrity and political portraiture. Celebrity portraits most often cater to the subject (and their PR), with the intention to flatter and beautify the individual. The portraits employ soft light, neutral expressions, fan-blown hair, heroic poses, and airbrushing to achieve the desired effect. The portraits are pleasing to the eye but forgettable, because a pandering representation will always lack the necessary bite to cut through the noise.
On the opposite end of the spectrum is political portraiture, which carries an expectation that a photographer should be critical and harsh when working with an unpopular politician. A few years ago, a magazine put a controversial Republican on the cover with unforgiving light beams that exaggerated the facial pores and made the skin texture look like a volcanic field. I was no more a fan of the politician than most readers of the publication, but I thought the choice of the photo was unethical. Besides taking advantage of the trust between the sitter and the photographer, such an approach, relying on technical cheap shots, lacks the depth and complexity necessary for the image to survive past the immediate cultural moment.
The sweet spot between celebrity and political extremes is where most powerful portraits exist. Viewers are more perceptive than we sometimes give them credit for, and a portrait that’s too flattering or too grotesque won’t land the same way as a more nuanced representation. An insightful portrait reflects the sitter’s personality through clues, colors, and positioning, rather than the brute force of technical decisions.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/c76d18bf-bc5d-49da-9335-25b8ab2122f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
PAINTING
FRAGRANCE
The best-smelling kid at the playground
Anna Dorn and Crissy Milazzo interviewed writer Emily Gould’s 10-year-old son to get the lowdown on Gen Alpha’s perfume preferences. Read on for some excellent mom shade, a review of perfumes that smell like Oreos, and the age-old question: does this smell good, or am I just hungry?
Smells like Gen Alpha 🍪🍦🍫 [ https://substack.com/redirect/81abafdf-7930-45d2-983e-70f7e732d112?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—anna dorn  and Crissy Milazzo  in Sample Sluts  
Do you remember the first fragrance you ever smelled? What was it?
Well, my mom used to really just dive into bottles of perfume (not anymore, she has learned how much she should put on now), and when I was much younger, whenever she would be going to a party or a formal occasion she would have perfume on, and a lot of it, too. The only one I can remember that she wore before recent years was a strong sweet-and-sour plum perfume, which she reminded me the name of which was Umé by Keiko Mecheri, which smells great but not in the amount my mom wore, which would never fail to make my nose hurt with how much she wore.
What is your favorite fragrance right now?
Phlur Vanilla Skin. I really like the strong-at-first, smooth vanilla, or even Oreo (as people have told me) scent, because Oreos are peak.
What does your mom smell like?
My mom wears a great-smelling apple pie-scented perfume called Angels’ Share, and she wears Replica “By the Fireplace” perfume, and they both smell great and she finally knows how much to put on.
You live in Brooklyn: what does it smell like?
Just kidding (kinda), but it can smell good, like passing by someone with great perfume, or it can smell absolutely disgusting, such as being on any train station in all of Brooklyn, nobody’s safe.
Do your friends at school like to wear fragrance? If so, what do they wear?
I don’t really know tbh. One of my friends is always like “What’s the point of wearing deodorant or perfume, we’re just 10” (I mean that’s one friend), but when we’re playing sports or having PE, you will not catch more than 1 person within a 3-foot radius of him.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/81abafdf-7930-45d2-983e-70f7e732d112?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
WINTER BLUES
POETRY
Coming
—By Philip Larkin, shared by James Marriott [ https://substack.com/@jamesmarriott716869/note/c-219926827?utm_source=notes-share-action&r=1cer5b ]
On longer evenings,
Light, chill and yellow,
Bathes the serene
Foreheads of houses.
A thrush sings,
Laurel-surrounded
In the deep bare garden,
Its fresh-peeled voice
Astonishing the brickwork.

It will be spring soon,
It will be spring soon —
And I, whose childhood
Is a forgotten boredom,
Feel like a child
Who comes on a scene
Of adult reconciling,
And can understand nothing
But the unusual laughter,
And starts to be happy.
CITY PLANNING
London Bridge, Arizona
In an ode to idealized cities, Naomi Xu Elegant looks at the “kooky midcentury American businessman” who bought the London Bridge, shipped it to the Arizona desert, and built a Disneyfied English village around it.
The ideal city [ https://substack.com/redirect/67046332-9e5f-4b40-ad2a-b5e7292fb2c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Naomi Xu Elegant  in luanqibazao  
Only about 60,000 people live in Lake Havasu City, Arizona, one of four towns in the southwest founded by Robert P. McCulloch, a land developer, oil, gas and geothermal energy speculator, and purveyor of lawnmowers, garden tractors, car, boat and airplane engines, and, in 1949, the world’s first one-man chainsaw.
McCulloch was a man of gorgeously midcentury dreams. He founded and ran six eponymous companies before he died in 1977. With the money he inherited from his father and made from his own superchargers, motor engines, oil exploration, and real estate deals, McCulloch produced a working prototype of a steam-powered coupé (1953), manufactured a fleet of two-seat gyrocopters (a strange cousin of the heli) that he hoped would one day sit in every driveway beside the family car (1969), and launched a passenger airline to ferry prospective residents to the various cities he was spawning in the desert (1970). His California home appeared on the cover of Life Magazine in 1956, billed as a “push-button paradise” of futuristic contraptions: rotating sunbeds, self-heating barbecues, automatic whiskey dispensers, and buttons for drawing curtains and turning on the lights.
The doohickey house was located in Palm Springs, about three hours’ drive from Lake Havasu City. McCulloch purchased the land for the city after flying his prop plane over near the border of California and Arizona, scouting for opportunity, and spotting Havasu Lake (actually a reservoir) in the middle of the desert. He enlisted C.V. Wood, the chief designer of Disneyland in Anaheim—which had opened 15 years earlier, in 1955—to design a new town.
Lake Havasu City is the site of McCulloch’s most famous shenanigan: in 1968, he purchased the London Bridge from the City of London. McCulloch did not, as is often repeated, believe he was buying the more distinctive Tower Bridge, nor is his exploit the origin of the phrase “I have a bridge to sell you.” The man knew what he was doing!
The bridge, too weak to support the increasingly heavy vehicles of the modern world, was sinking into the Thames. Rather than demolishing it to build a new one, the city government thought to save some money by seeing if anyone would want to buy it. McCulloch did.
Slab by slab, he had 10,000 tons of 19th-century granite shipped from the UK to an unpopulated patch of desert in Arizona, where he did not even have a river for the bridge to cross.
The plan was to reassemble the bridge on dry ground, laying the arches over the sand dunes and then digging the sand out and rerouting a section of the Colorado River to run underneath it. After their permit to do this was denied, Wood, the Disney designer, pulled strings to get an audience with President Lyndon B. Johnson himself, whom he somehow convinced to let them build the bridge and carry out the minor terraforming work necessary for it to actually function as such.
It took three years and seven million dollars, thrice as much as it cost McCulloch to purchase all the land that would make up Lake Havasu City. It was an extravagant, delightful, ridiculous, and wholly unnecessary gimmick: what could be more American?
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/67046332-9e5f-4b40-ad2a-b5e7292fb2c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
PHOTOGRAPHY
MUSIC
Notes from the road
There’s a lot of beauty in Damien Jurado’s dispatch from the road: from the fall of snow to the feeling of history in a venue, from conversations about God with his brother to a live recording of “After Hours Mr. Rogers” by St. Yuma during a soundcheck.
Behold, I say unto you. [ https://substack.com/redirect/e103b112-181d-41a4-a4ab-0c42ecdd7668?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Damien Jurado  in Damien Jurado [ https://substack.com/redirect/773510fa-0138-4192-bbfc-3dd3b6eeb536?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
We sailed across the frozen tundra of Wyoming yesterday, through high winds and snow. It was terrifying.
We got word of a pileup that had happened just the night before involving twenty semi-trucks and twelve cars. In total, there were two fatalities and countless injuries. The wait for ambulances must have felt like an eternity in the winter storm.
There is nothing—no civilization between towns. If you have ever driven on Interstate 80 between Utah and Colorado, you will know what I’m talking about. It’s almost haunting, no matter what the season.
The shows have been memorable. After Baker City, Oregon, we were on to Boise, Idaho. We played at a venue I’d never been to before: Shrine Social Club. It was beautiful.
You feel the history immediately when entering the building. Just beautiful. All wood. Chairs that have most likely been there since the opening line the outer parameters of the walls. I kept imagining the countless dances that took place there. Cigarette smoke ages a place—in a cool way. At times, I swear I could smell it still lingering.
My older brother, who lives in Boise, came out to the show. I have a strong bond with him—one that is spiritual. A devout Mormon whose belief is so real, so deep, that you feel its presence as you stand beside him. I’ve only known a few people like this. It goes without saying just how much I love and deeply admire him. He’s the real deal.
We talked for what felt like hours about Jesus and the beliefs pertaining to the Latter-day Saints Church. When he spoke, explaining the answers to my questions, I hung on his every word. When he gave pause while thinking about how to respond to something, it seemed to last an eternity.
He would sometimes pause mid-thought, staring into the atmosphere as if he were fishing or cloud-watching, and say, “You know what? That is a great question. I don’t have the answer to that right now. But if you give me some time to think more about it, and perhaps consult the scriptures, I will have an answer for you.”
I really respected that. Too many people pretend to know when they don’t. There is a certain beauty in not knowing the answers. It’s human.
I walked away challenged, as always after talking with him. I hope to see him again soon.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/e103b112-181d-41a4-a4ab-0c42ecdd7668?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]

Video & Audio: Damien Jurado  
Writing: Dina Litovsky , anna dorn , Crissy Milazzo , James Marriott , Naomi Xu Elegant  
Recently launched
Hot off hosting Substack’s inaugural Spelling Bee [ https://substack.com/@substack/note/c-219809890?utm_source=notes-share-action&r=48ea6r ], the writer, comedian, and actress Cazzie David  has launched a Substack. In her first post, she asks that you think of it as an [ https://substack.com/redirect/30efb6c3-dbcc-4c30-bd4a-7f62c4fb438d?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] “ongoing performance art piece about… being irrelevant.”
Ray Dalio  has launched Principled Perspectives [ https://substack.com/redirect/6e7dafe4-aab1-4a03-9161-26cc712c1306?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ], where the global macro investor and writer will be sharing articles [ https://substack.com/@raydalio/note/c-219018784 ] about “principles, tools, and what’s going on with life, work, economics, markets, politics, the changing world order, AI, the Big Cycle, and other such things.”

ALL the details for our Sun 3/1 Parenting Seminar!

WHAT IS THE TOPIC?

“Parenting & the Nervous System:

Building a Stable Family Environment Rooted in God’s Peace”

Being a steady, grounded parent starts with understanding your own story. In this workshop, guest speaker Lacy Warne, MFT, will blend mental health insights with compassionate guidance on how your past, your nervous system, and your presence shape the emotional climate of your home. You’ll walk away with tools for leading your family with calm and connection.

About Lacy Warne

Lacy Warne is a Licensed Therapist (https://www.lacywarne.com/) with over 14 years of experience and a thriving private practice in Santa Cruz, CA, specializing in anxiety disorders and EMDR to help clients find deep, lasting relief. She is a wife and momma to two wonderful littles.


WHAT TIME IS EVERYTHING HAPPENING?
* 10:45am = Drop off kids at Kid's Ministry classes
+ *Reminder: We do offer childcare through our Twin Lakes Kids Ministry classes; check in starts at 10:45am! Please check your children in before you attend the seminar.
+ Babies in arms are ok in the seminar, but older children are invited to join the Kid’s Ministry.
+ If you have questions or need extra help checking your kids in, please let us know; kristin@tlc.org!
* 11am – 12:30pm =
+ Seminar in main room at Monschke Hall (follow signs)
+ **We meet in a different room within Monschke Hall this week; follow the sign to room 7103 when you enter Monschke Hall
* 12:30pm = Pick up kids at Kid's Ministry classes


WHAT IF I WANT TO ATTEND CHURCH & THE SEMINAR?
* Go to the Sat 6pm or Sun 9am service (check in / check out your kid as usual)
* We will have a hangout on the Big Playground from 10:15-10:45am (w/ free coffee!)
* You can then drop the kids off at Kid's Ministry at 10:45am, and attend the Seminar


DO I NEED TO RSVP?

For planning purposes, we would appreciate if parents could RSVP (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2037/responses/new) — but an RSVP is not required to attend!
RSVP for Mar 1 Seminar (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2037/responses/new)

subject: Time to Pray
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/time-to-pray

The sirens echo over distant lands
Borders tremble under restless hands
Airports crowded, oceans crossed
Counting what is left, and what is lost
Headlines burn like midnight flame
Every nation feels the same
Whispers rise from fear and pain
Is this the calm before the rain
Cities empty, skies unsure
Hearts grow weary, faith the cure
When power fails and leaders sway
There is still one higher way
When the world stands on the brink
And courage fades faster than we think
When plans collapse and walls decay
It is time to kneel
It is time to pray

Though kingdoms rise and kingdoms fall

So when the earth begins to shake
And hearts begin to break
Lift your voice, do not delay
This is the hour
Time to pray.

subject: Do You Feel Important?
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/do-you-feel-important

Do you feel important?
It is a simple question, but in moments of crisis it becomes deeply personal. When your home is damaged, when your roof is torn off by wind, when your streets are flooded and your life is reduced to debris on the curb, importance is no longer theoretical. It is measured by response. It is measured by who shows up and how much help arrives.
Recently, reports and public debate have centered around the Federal Emergency Management Agency and claims that millions of dollars were allocated for housing assistance connected to migrants, while some American citizens in storm ravaged states reported receiving only six hundred dollars in initial aid. The numbers are being argued across news panels and social media feeds. Behind the arguments are real people asking a real question: Where do we stand?
For families in states hit by hurricanes, tornadoes, and flooding, six hundred dollars does not rebuild a roof. It does not replace a vehicle swept away in rising water. It does not restore a refrigerator full of food lost during days without power. For many, that payment represented immediate emergency relief, not the total amount available. Yet perception matters. When citizens see headlines about millions spent elsewhere while they struggle to recover, it feels personal.
Disaster assistance is complex. Funding flows through different programs authorized by Congress, some for emergency housing, some for long term recovery, and some administered directly while others operate through state partnerships. There are also separate federal programs addressing migrant shelter and humanitarian needs that are not always drawn from the same disaster relief accounts. In the public eye, nuance is often drowned out by emotion.
Emotion is understandable.
When a mother stands in line for supplies in a flooded town, when a father looks at the skeletal remains of what was once his home, when children sleep on cots in a gymnasium, they are not thinking about budget categories. They are thinking about whether their government sees them.
Importance is not just about money. It is about trust. It is about transparency. It is about believing that when disaster strikes your community, you will not be an afterthought.
The debate over federal spending, border policy, and disaster relief will continue. Lawmakers will defend allocations. Critics will question priorities. Analysts will cite statutes and appropriations bills. At the ground level, the question remains deeply human.
Do you feel important?
Do citizens in storm battered towns feel that their suffering carries weight? Do they feel heard when they say six hundred dollars is not enough to begin again? Do they believe the system values them as much as any other group receiving assistance?
A nation’s strength is tested not only by how it responds to crises abroad or at its borders, but by how it restores its own communities when wind and water leave devastation behind. Accountability matters. Clear communication matters. Equal compassion matters.
If people feel overlooked, the solution is not louder outrage. It is clearer answers. It is transparent accounting. It is policy that can be explained plainly and defended honestly.
In the end, importance is not declared in press conferences. It is demonstrated in action.
Every citizen, especially in their darkest hour, deserves to feel that they matter.

subject: Looking for Green Team Members
body:
Hello!

We are looking for people to help Phyllis and our fabulous (but very small) Green Team on a regular basis.  We specifically need help with string trimming (week wacking) the animal yards - the foxtails are coming!  Ideally, you would be available for a few hours every week or if we have enough interest and can spread the work out, every two weeks.  The string trimmer is on the heavier side and as you might imagine it's noisy, dusty work but it's a really important.  If you are interested in learning more or want to help, please email me at leslie.haddad@santacruzcountyca.gov.

Thank you!

Leslie

Leslie Haddad, RVT

Volunteer Coordinator

SANTA CRUZ COUNTY ANIMAL SHELTER

1001 Rodriguez Street, Santa Cruz, CA 95060 (831) 454-7209

subject: What Will It Take?
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/what-will-it-take-59b

What will it take for adults to start acting like adults?
Even now, with doors opening and records connected to Jeffrey Epstein being discussed again, people rise up. But they do not rise to defend children. They rise to defend reputations. They rise to protect their political comfort. They rise to call it false, exaggerated, or a distraction.
Why?
We are talking about innocent children. God’s little ones.
If it were your brother abusing children, you would not wait for a file to open.
If it were your sister, you would not need a court document to tell you how to feel.
If it were your mother or father, you would not hesitate to demand the truth.
You would not defend them blindly. You would not attack the victims. You would not accuse survivors of having hidden motives. You would not twist yourself into knots to protect your worldview.
And that is why this is personal.
Some of us were those children.
So when people say our motivation is political, they are wrong. When they imply that speaking up is about party lines, influence, or scoring points, they are wrong. This is not about left or right. It is about right and wrong.
When you have lived it, you do not see headlines the same way. You do not see powerful names the same way. You do not shrug and scroll. You recognize patterns. You recognize the silence. You recognize the reflex to protect the powerful instead of the powerless.
That is what hurts.
Not that someone disagrees politically. Not that people have different opinions. What hurts is watching grown adults bend over backward to protect status, power, and personalities while children are reduced to talking points.
If your own family member had harmed a child, you would not say, “Let’s wait and see if this damages our reputation.”
You would say, “Where is the child? Are they safe? What happened?”
So why does that instinct disappear when the accused wears a suit, holds office, or aligns with your beliefs?
Do not accuse survivors of being political when they are being honest. Do not pretend their pain is strategy. For some of us, this is not theory. It is memory.
What will it take for adults to start adulting?
To stop dividing into camps and attacking one another while the real issue sits untouched?
To stop typing rage at strangers while ignoring the moral rot that should unite us?
All that arguing solves nothing. There are no winners, only losers.
What would be effective is unity. Not unity behind a party, but unity behind children.
Imagine Americans from every walk of life standing together and saying:
Where are the children?
Who harmed them?
Who protected the abusers?
Where did the money go?
Not asking softly. Demanding answers.
Until protecting children becomes more important than protecting egos, this will continue. Until survivors are heard instead of questioned, this will continue. Until adults choose integrity over identity, this will continue.
What will it take?

subject: Make your arguments bulletproof  👉 Live workshop March 7
body:
New workshop (Mar 7) - Argue clean, win clear
 
 

Hi Joshua,

 

You're invited to join me live on March 7 for a new workshop "Make Your Arguments Bulletproof."

Have you ever been in an argument where you KNOW you're right... but you can't quite articulate why?

 

Or watched two people you care about locked in a debate, and you can SEE the truth they're both missing... if they could just hear each other clearly?

 

Or posted something online and had it completely misunderstood?

 

It is frustrating to deal with other people who can't track with your reasoning.

 

Clean thinking means:

  • Every term is defined (so no one can move the goalposts)
  • Every assumption is surfaced (so your foundation is solid)
  • Every logical step is tested (so there are no weak points)
  • The principle underneath is universal (so it works in ANY context)

When your thinking is clean, your arguments become bulletproof.

People can disagree with you, but they can't dismantle your logic and key points.

 

That's what I'm teaching on March 7th.

 

This is a live, 3-hour workshop where you'll take one belief you actually hold... something you care about defending... and refine it to precision.

 

This is the same 7-step process I've used for over 15 years in my coaching and client work. It's one of the core skills of my (Ti) Introverted Thinking.

 

If you've listened to the podcast for any length of time, you've heard it in action while I'm in conversation with Joel.

 

I learned this in a very unique way. After leaving a high-demand religius cult in my youth, I was shunned and I lost connection with everyone I'd ever known.

 

But if I'm honest, the deeper suffering I felt was the scaffolding of my mind losing a belief system. Every thought I'd ever had was attached to that belief system.

 

When my faith fell away, there was no infrastructure left for my mind to attach to.

 

Most people quickly attach to another belief model, I chose to reprogram my mind from first principles instead.

 

I want to teach you the exact 7-step process I used to reprogram my mind.

 

Thought by thought.
Line by line.
Stripping away what isn't true.
Keeping what is.

 

The are the methods I used to reprogram my own mind and build a life based on truth instead of inherited belief.

 

Here's how the workshop works:

 

You'll bring one real belief, something you care about, something you want to defend.

 

I'll walk you through the 7-step refinement process:

  1. Define every term (so no one can misinterpret you)
  2. Surface all assumptions (in your reasoning and theirs)
  3. Test for coherence (so there are no weak points)
  4. Steelman the opposing view (so you're arguing against their BEST case)
  5. Extract underlying principles (so your logic is universal)
  6. Find the core truth (so your position is unshakeable)
  7. Write it clean (stripped of bias, emotion, persuasion)

By the end, you'll have:

  • One belief refined to bulletproof precision
  • A repeatable process to do this with ANY argument
  • The ability to spot dirty thinking in seconds (in yourself and others)

Workshop Details:

When: Saturday, March 7th, 2025 | 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM ET
Where: Live on Zoom (recording provided)
Tuition: $127 $97 (early registration)

This is the one skill that can't be faked, and once you have it, you'll never unsee it.

 

Hope to see you there live.
Make Your Arguments Bulletproof ⮕
 


Much Love,

Joel Mark Witt & Antonia Dodge
Co-Founders | Personality Hacker
 

PS - Make Your Arguments Bulletproof

I'm hosting a live workshop on March 7th teaching my 7-step system to refine any belief to precision. This is the exact process I used to reprogram my own mind after leaving a cult.

And it's one of the core skills of Introverted Thinking (Accuracy).
