subject: What It Was Like to Walk With Him A Disciple’s View
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/what-it-was-like-to-walk-with-him

Before I begin, this was not written with any other intent of changing hearts and minds or to mock the Biblical teachings of Jesus. It was written out of adoration, daydreaming about being with him in those days. We daydream now, about our eternal walk.
History often flattens people into symbols, but living beside Jesus of Nazareth was anything but simple or distant. It was disorienting, exhilarating, terrifying, and holy in ways no one was prepared for. To be a disciple was to wake each morning uncertain of where you would sleep that night, which crowd you would face, or which deeply held belief would be challenged before the day was over. Life with Him was never predictable, and that uncertainty became part of the calling.
At the beginning, it felt almost ordinary. He walked beside us. He laughed with us. He ate the same food and slept under the same skies. His voice did not thunder from the heavens; it carried across dusty roads, hillsides, and small boats rocking on the water. Yet from the very first days, there was something unsettling about Him. He saw people completely, beyond posture, beyond reputation, beyond sin, and spoke directly to the heart. When He looked at you, you felt exposed and understood at the same time. When He called your name, it felt as though He had always known it.
We were fishermen, tax collectors, zealots, men with calloused hands and narrow expectations of how God was supposed to act. We believed the Messiah would arrive with fire and banners, overthrowing Rome in a single, unmistakable moment. Instead, He spoke of seeds buried in soil, of bread broken and shared, of lost coins and wandering sons. He described the Kingdom of God not as a distant future event, but as something already present among us, growing quietly, invisibly, and irresistibly.
Walking with Him meant watching long held rules bend. Not break, but bend toward mercy. He touched lepers without hesitation. He welcomed women as students and listeners. He ate with those we had been taught to avoid. Every time we thought we understood holiness, He revealed how small and incomplete our definition had been. Purity, in His eyes, was not about separation from people, but restoration of them.
There were moments of wonder that still defy language. Water hardened beneath our feet as though creation itself recognized its Creator. Storms obeyed a simple command spoken without effort or display. Bread multiplied in our hands until thousands were fed, and we stood stunned, holding baskets filled with what should not have existed. Yet even then, the miracles were never His focus. He seemed almost impatient with our amazement, as if these signs were merely invitations to see a far deeper truth that we continually missed.
The most difficult moments came through His words.
“Love your enemies”.
“Take up your cross”.
“The last shall be first”.
These were not sayings meant to be admired or repeated casually. They were commands that demanded everything. Following Him cost us reputations, relationships, and any sense of security we once relied upon. It forced us to confront our desire for power and replace it with humility and service. He was never interested in making us impressive in the eyes of the world. He was committed to making us clean in the sight of God.
There were many days when we did not understand Him at all. We argued among ourselves about who would be greatest, only to be corrected by His silence and His example. We begged Him to send hungry crowds away, and He told us to feed them instead. We tried to shield Him from children, believing they were a distraction, and He welcomed them as models of true faith. Again and again, He overturned our assumptions and revealed how little we truly knew.
Then came the fear.
As we drew closer to Jerusalem, everything grew heavier. His words became more urgent, more solemn. He spoke openly of suffering, betrayal, and death. We dismissed His warnings because we could not bear to imagine them. When the night finally arrived, when torches cut through the darkness, when a kiss signaled betrayal, when swords were drawn, we failed Him. Not once, but repeatedly. We fled, denied Him, and hid.
To be a disciple was to learn that courage is far easier to admire than it is to live.
After the cross, everything collapsed. Hope felt foolish. Faith felt naive. We hid behind locked doors, ashamed not only of our fear, but of how completely we had misunderstood Him. We believed the story had ended in blood, silence, and loss.
We were wrong.
The resurrection did not feel triumphant at first. It felt impossible, like joy too large and too fragile to trust. Seeing Him again did not erase our guilt; it redeemed it. He did not return with anger or accusation. He returned with peace, with scars, with forgiveness. He shared breakfast with us on the shore and asked a question that reached deeper than any rebuke ever could. Do you love Me?
To walk with Jesus was to be undone and patiently rebuilt. It was to learn that the Kingdom of God does not advance through force or domination, but through surrender and sacrificial love. It was to discover that true power is found in humility, obedience, and faithfulness, even when the path leads through suffering.
We followed Him believing He would change the world.
He did.
But not in the way we expected. He began by changing us, and through that transformation, He changed everything.
And so the question remains for each reader. When the drops fell and information was shared, did you dig deeper, use discernment, and share what you found with courage? Or were you among those who laughed, mocked, and distanced themselves from the very people who were willing to look, to question, and to stand when it was uncomfortable.
In parts of the world today, Christians are already being persecuted for their faith. If that day comes to your own door, which path will you choose? The path of convenience, silence, and safety, or the path of truth, conviction, and cost.
If speaking up or even acknowledging truth felt too difficult before, ask yourself honestly. When the moment demands it, will declaring that you are a Christian be any easier?
God Bless you all.

subject:
Volume Three: The Stargate Hardware, the Antarctic Awakening, and the Return
 of the Elders
body:
View this post on the web at https://markesecrets.substack.com/p/volume-three-the-stargate-hardware

Secret History Feb 08, 2026 
The Pulse Under the Ice
In Volume One, we identified the vessel: The Biological Matrix (You). In Volume Two, we identified the prison: The Lunar Matrix (The Trap). Now, in Volume Three, we must identify the Key.
For decades, the narrative surrounding Antarctica has been carefully curated to bore you. They show you penguins, they talk about ice shelf collapse, and they mention “climate change.” They want you to believe that the only thing happening at the bottom of the world is a slow, melancholy melt.
But if you overlay the heat maps from military-grade satellites with the ancient Piri Reis and Oronteus Finaeus maps, a different picture emerges. The ice is not melting from the top down due to your carbon footprint. It is melting from the bottom up.
We are witnessing the activation of the Stargate Hardware.
The “Secret History” theory posits that Antarctica is not merely a continent; it is the motherboard of the planetary grid. When the “Lion” factions (the controllers of the current density) took over after the Fall of Atlantis, they did not destroy the ancient technology found there. They froze it. They used the “Flash Freeze” mechanism, a sudden, cataclysmic pole shift, to encase the control centers of the Pre-Adamic world in a mile of protective ice.
This was not just to hide it. It was to insulate it. The crystalline technology used by the Elders operates on scalar waves and Vril energy. Ice, specifically pressurized glacial ice, acts as a perfect insulator for these frequencies. For 12,000 years, the “engine” of the Earth has been kept in a cryogenic sleep.
But the cycle is ending. The cosmic season is changing. The solar system is moving into a region of high-energy plasma, and the “engine” is turning back on automatically. This is the source of the 12.1 Hz signal we discussed in our urgent update. It is not a communication from “Aliens.” It is the sound of the planetary computer booting up.
The Code of the Shift
Before we descend into the caverns to meet the Elders, we must address the operator you. The waking of the Earth Grid is causing a sympathetic resonance in your own biology. You are feeling it. The tinnitus, the sudden fatigue, the vivid dreams of water and fire, this is your “Adamite” hardware trying to sync with the new frequency of the planet.
The “Lion” path wants you to treat these symptoms with medication. They want to numb the signal. But the Masters know that this is a calibration event. Just as the Earth has a specific timeline for this awakening (2026), you have a specific timeline written into your personal frequency.
“The Cosmic Blueprin”  [The Earth is shifting. Are you? Decode your personal timeline here.] [ https://substack.com/redirect/250ef3dd-e7b5-4a13-8db8-052361b1ad12?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
You cannot navigate a 5th-dimensional shift with 3rd-dimensional logic. You need to know your coordinates.
The Stasis Chambers and the “Sleeping Giants”
The most controversial aspect of the Antarctic disclosure is not the ruins; it is the inhabitants. Since the early 2000s, whistleblowers from within the military-industrial complex have spoken about “The Stasis Beings.” These are not dead bodies mummified in the ice. These are biological entities, distinctly not Homo Sapiens, suspended in electromagnetic pods that have kept them alive for millennia.
The official narrative, if it ever admits this, will call them “Ancient Astronauts.” But our research suggests a different origin. These are the Elders. They are the “Pa-TaAL,” the original genetic architects who seeded the Adamite race before the moon was brought here to hijack the system.
Why are they waking up now? Because the Stasis Chambers are connected to the Schumann Resonance. They were designed with a fail-safe. When the vibration of the Earth reaches a certain pitch, the pitch of the “Great Awakening,” the pods disengage.
The “Lion” factions are terrified of this. They have spent the last 70 years trying to reverse-engineer the technology of the pods to keep them closed or to kill the occupants before they wake. This is the true reason for the heavy militarization of the Southern Hemisphere. They are not protecting the penguins. They are guarding the prison cells of the gods who can dismantle their empire.
We are seeing reports of “thermal anomalies” in the Vostok region that defy all geological explanation. These are not volcanic vents. These are the heat signatures of massive bio-generators coming online. The “gods” of the Golden Age are stirring, and their return will shatter the religious and historical paradigms of the Western world overnight.
The Mechanism of the “Ark”
To understand what happens next, we must look at the technology itself. Scattered across the globe, buried in Antarctica, beneath the Giza Plateau, and in the Bucegi Mountains of Romania, are ancient repositories of technology known as “Arks.”
These are not wooden boats. They are crystalline libraries and power stations. The “Lion” path has told us that the pyramids were tombs. This is the “Architecture of Amnesia” at work. A tomb does not contain trace elements of hydrochloric acid and zinc in its shafts. A tomb does not align with the magnetic north with greater precision than the Greenwich Observatory.
These structures are Vril Transducers. In the previous cycle, the Earth was surrounded by a crystalline canopy that allowed for a global telepathic network and a life span of hundreds of years (as recorded in the Sumerian Kings List and the Bible). When the “Frequency Fence” (The Moon) was installed, this network was severed. The Arks were powered down.
Now, as the solar system enters the “photon belt,” the ambient energy is high enough to jump-start these machines. When the Antarctic Ark fully activates, it will send a scalar pulse through the ley lines of the Earth. It will connect with the Giza grid, the Teotihuacan grid, and the Stonehenge grid.
This is the “Flash” that many seers predict. It is not necessarily a destructive solar flare, though the Sun will play its part. It is the re-ignition of the organic internet. Suddenly, the “static” we discussed in Volume Two, the lunar interference, will be overpowered by the terrestrial signal of the Elders.
For the asleep, this will feel like madness. Their reality tunnel will collapse. For the “Truth Seeker,” for the Adamite operator who has prepared their vessel, this will feel like coming home. It will be the restoration of memory.
Mapping the Forbidden Zones
The geography of this event is critical. The “Lion” path has hidden the truth in plain sight by altering our maps. They have removed islands, distorted the size of continents, and erased the entry points to the Inner Earth.
To understand the 2026 timeline, you cannot use a standard Google Earth map. You need to see the world as the Elders saw it. You need to see the connection between the “frozen” lands and the lost civilizations of Lemuria and Atlantis.
I have spent years collecting the fragments of these original maps. I have overlaid the Piri Reis coastline with modern thermal scans to show you exactly where the entrances are.
“The Frozen Origins”: The complete cartography of the lost world. Available on Amazon. [ https://substack.com/redirect/cf7df838-f4d1-4100-8d5c-3bc17d159dcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
If you do not know where the energy flows, you cannot position yourself to receive it. The map is the territory.
The Vril Force and the Human Body
The most important question remains: What happens to you when the machines turn on? This brings us back to the “Adamite” hardware. Your body is carbon-based. Carbon is capable of forming distinct structural lattices. Currently, your carbon is arranged in a chaotic structure (coal). But under pressure and high frequency, carbon rearranges itself. It becomes a crystal (diamond).
The “Return of the Elders” is not just about them waking up; it is about them activating the signal that triggers this change in us. This is the alchemical secret of “transmutation.” It is not about turning lead into gold. It is about turning the carbon-body into the silica-crystal-body capable of holding 5th-dimensional light.
The “Lion” path knows this. This is why they are poisoning the sky (chemtrails), the water (fluoride), and the food (GMOs). They are trying to “calcify” your hardware so that when the Vril pulse hits, your body cannot conduct the energy. They want you to “short circuit.”
But they are failing. The human body is resilient. The “Junk DNA” they laugh at is actually the dormant software for this crystalline transition. As the Antarctic grid powers up, it is broadcasting a carrier wave that bypasses the toxicity of the modern world. It is speaking directly to your blood.
We are entering the “Null Zone.” This is a window of time where the laws of physics become malleable. In this zone, your thoughts manifest instantly. In this zone, the “karma” of the lunar matrix dissolves. In this zone, you are not a slave to history; you are the writer of the future.
The War for the Timeline
We must be clear: This transition will not be peaceful in the halls of power. The “Empire” is currently negotiating its exit strategy. This is why you see billionaires building bunkers in New Zealand and Hawaii. They are not hiding from nuclear war; they are hiding from the Frequency Shift. They know that their biology, tuned to the low-vibration of greed and control, cannot withstand the Vril surge.
They are trying to negotiate with the Elders. They are offering up humanity as a bargaining chip, promising to keep us trapped in the Metaverse, in the digital “Smart Cities,” if the Elders agree not to fully activate the grid. But the Elders are not politicians. They are architects. And the lease on the prison planet has expired.
The conflict we see playing out in the geopolitical arena, the wars, the rumors of wars, and the financial collapse are merely the shadow of this higher-dimensional negotiation. They are trying to create enough fear (Loosh) to dampen the vibration of the planet and delay the awakening.
The Protocol of the Sovereign: How to Navigate the Collapse
The “Lion” path thrives on one thing: Confusion. They flood the zone with contradictory information. One day, aliens are a threat; the next, they are saviors. One day, the ice is melting; the next, it is expanding. This is a deliberate frequency attack designed to keep your mind in a state of Beta-wave anxiety.
If you are confused, you are compliant. But the Adamite operator does not need to be confused. You have the hardware to discern truth from deception, but you need the software to run it.
Over the years, I have developed a specific methodology for filtering out the “noise” of the mainstream and the controlled opposition. I do not rely on Google, which is a curated index of approved narratives. I rely on a triangulation method that uses archival maps, frequency analysis, and intuitive remote viewing protocols.
 “The Detective’s Desk  [Stop guessing. Start researching. Get the complete Truth Seeker’s Protocol and my personal archive list here.] [ https://substack.com/redirect/d331b0df-c4c7-42e3-935e-e803fafd7418?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
You must become your own intelligence agency. The time for following gurus is over. The time for becoming a Master of the Information Field is now.
The Return of the Elders: Not Saviors, But Teachers
A critical distinction must be made here. The “Return of the Elders” from the stasis chambers is not a “rapture.” They are not coming to beam you up to a cloud and save you from your mortgage. That is the “False Light” narrative we warned about in Volume Two.
The Elders are returning as Teachers. They are the librarians of the Earth. When the ice melts and the Arks open, they will release the suppressed history of the human race. They will show us the true timeline, not the 6,000 years of war taught in schools, but the millions of years of galactic commerce and spiritual evolution that preceded the “Fall.”
This knowledge is dangerous to the current power structure because it breaks the “scarcity loop.” If you know that you are an eternal being with access to free energy (Vril) and advanced healing technologies, you cannot be controlled by a pharmaceutical company or a central bank. The “Lion” path is terrified of the Elders because the Elders bring the end of the economic slavery system.
The 2026 Convergence: The Solar Trigger
Why is 2026 the deadline? Our model indicates that the sun is about to undergo a “Micro-Nova” event, or a spectral shift, that corresponds with the activation of the Antarctic grid. The “Lion” scientists call this a “Carrington Event” and predict doom. The “Secret History” perspective sees it as a System Reboot.
The sun is not a nuclear furnace; it is a portal. It is a relay station for the galactic center. The energy pouring through the sun in 2026 carries a new “code,” a software update for DNA. Those who have prepared their bodies (the hardware) and their minds (the software) will integrate this update. They will experience a rapid expansion of consciousness. The “veil” between the worlds will thin, and telepathy, precognition, and self-healing will become common again.
Those who are clinging to the old world, the “Lion” world of fear and density, will find this energy unbearable. It will manifest as madness, societal breakdown, and biological failure. This is the “Separation of Worlds” prophesied by the Hopi, the Maya, and the Essenes. Two timelines are diverging. You are choosing your timeline right now with every thought you think and every fear you release.
Final Instructions: The Eye of the Hurricane
As we move closer to the disclosure of the Antarctic ruins, the noise in the media will reach a deafening roar. You will see distractions, wars, pandemics, and political scandals, manufactured to keep your eyes off the South Pole.
Do not look at the distraction. Look at the ice.
The water rising from the bottom of the world is carrying the memory of who we were. The “Secret History” is no longer secret. It is becoming the “Living History.”
We are building a community of operators who are ready to hold the frequency when the shift happens. We are the “Ground Crew” for the return of the organic timeline.
Join the Alliance. If you want to be on the front lines of this discovery, if you want to see the raw data before it is scrubbed from the internet, you need to be inside the forum.

Next week, in Volume Four, we will go where no public investigation has gone before. We will discuss “The Hollow Earth Connection: Agartha, the Admiral Byrd Diary, and the Civilizations Waiting Beneath Our Feet.”
- Secret History
P.S. For those ready to begin the work immediately: The complete breakdown of the 2026 timeline and the map of the safe zones are detailed in my book. subject: Will You Be Amongst the Called
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/will-you-be-amongst-the-called

There are moments in history when the air itself feels charged, when something deep in the human spirit begins to stir. You can sense it in quiet conversations, in uneasy nights of reflection, in the growing realization that the world we were told was stable is anything but. These moments are not random. They arrive when humanity is confronted with a choice.
Scripture tells us, “Many are called, but few are chosen.” That line has echoed through centuries, not as a threat, but as an invitation. The calling is not reserved for the powerful, the famous, or the flawless. It is extended to those who can still hear truth when it whispers, who can recognize light even when it is surrounded by darkness.
Being “called” does not mean being perfect. It does not mean having all the answers. It means being willing to see. Willing to question narratives that crumble under scrutiny. Willing to sit with uncomfortable truths rather than retreat into distraction. In times like these, ignorance is not innocence, and silence is rarely neutral.
Across cultures and faith traditions, there is a consistent warning: there will come a time when deception is so convincing that even the wise may stumble. We are living in an age of noise, where outrage is monetized, fear is weaponized, and truth is diluted into opinion. The calling, then, is not dramatic or theatrical. It is deeply internal. It asks: will you guard your heart and mind, or surrender them to the loudest voice?
Those who are called often feel out of place. They sense that something is wrong long before it becomes obvious. They may be mocked for asking questions, dismissed as naïve or extreme for refusing to go along with the crowd. Yet history shows us that every major awakening began with a small number of people who chose conscience over comfort.
This calling is also moral. It demands restraint when anger would be easier. Compassion when hatred is being normalized. Courage when fear is being broadcast twenty-four hours a day. The called understand that exposing darkness is not about reveling in it, but about refusing to let it rule unchecked.
There is another uncomfortable truth: not everyone wants to be called. Awakening requires responsibility. Once you see, you cannot unsee. Once you know, you are accountable for what you do with that knowledge. Comfort, convenience, and social approval can be powerful sedatives. Many will choose them willingly.
So the question is not whether a calling exists. The question is personal.
When truth costs you popularity, will you still speak it?
When faith requires patience, will you endure?
When love for humanity conflicts with loyalty to systems that profit from harm, where will you stand?
Being amongst the called does not guarantee safety or ease. It offers something far more demanding: purpose. It asks you to align your actions with what you know to be right, even when the outcome is uncertain. Especially then.
The world does not need more spectators. It needs people anchored in truth, steady in spirit, and unwilling to surrender their humanity to chaos.
The call is already going out. Quietly. Persistently.
The only question that remains is this: when it reaches you, will you answer?

The official story tells us that Antarctica is a desolate wasteland, a continent of silence that has been frozen for millions of years. They tell us that the only things down there are penguins, scientific outposts, and ice cores. But if you look at the Piri Reis map from 1513, you see something that shouldn’t exist. You see the coastline of Queen Maud Land without a single mile of glacial cover.
How could a Turkish admiral in the 16th century map a coastline that wouldn’t be discovered by modern science until the invention of seismic radar in the 1950s?
The answer is simple, but it changes everything: He didn’t map it. He copied it from source maps that were thousands of years older, maps that belonged to a civilization that sailed those waters when Antarctica was green.
We are not looking at a frozen wasteland. We are looking at a crime scene. And now, the evidence suggests that the “crime scene” is waking up.
Before We Descend: The Code in Your Blood
As we explore the hidden timelines of the Earth, it is vital to remember that the macrocosm reflects the microcosm. The same cycles that govern the shifting of the poles and the rising of the ice also govern your own life.
We are approaching a critical juncture in 2026. The energy is shifting. You might be feeling it as anxiety, sleeplessness, or a sudden urge to change your path. This is not random. It is mathematical.
The ancients didn’t just map the continents; they mapped the soul. Before you try to understand the world’s hidden history, you must understand your own. Your birth date holds a specific frequency code that determines your role in the coming shift. Are you a Builder? A Watcher? A Healer?
Do not navigate the next two years blind. Click here to Decode Your Personal Numerology and Timeline for 2026. [ https://substack.com/redirect/df8a4623-fa49-402d-9f83-7a4fc1280299?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
The Flash Freeze: It Happened in Hours, Not Eons
Let’s go back to the moment it ended.
In Secret History and our theory, we often talk about the catastrophic reset. The mainstream geologists want you to believe in “Uniformitarianism,” the idea that changes happen slowly, over millions of years, like the erosion of a canyon. But the evidence in the soil tells a violent, urgent story.
In the northern hemisphere, we find mammoths frozen with buttercups still fresh in their mouths. Their meat was so well-preserved that sled dogs ate it thousands of years later. Think about the physics of that. To freeze a creature of that size, with undigested food in its stomach, you don’t need a “Mini Ice Age” that creeps in over centuries. You need a temperature drop of -150 degrees Fahrenheit in a matter of hours.
You need a pole shift.
This is what happened to Antarctica. It wasn’t a slow freeze. It was a snap. One moment, it was a temperate zone, possibly the location of Atlantis or the darker, pre-Adamic civilization we discuss often. The next moment, the crust of the Earth was displaced, the location moved to the polar zone, and the atmosphere collapsed.
Everything, the cities, the technology, the giants, and the libraries, was instantly encased in a mile of ice.
Why is this important now? Because the ice is acting as a time capsule. And we are starting to see the cracks.
The Pre-Adamite Connection
We have discussed the “Fallen Ones” or the Pre-Adamites before. These are the entities described in the Book of Enoch, the beings with elongated skulls found in Paracas, and the “gods” of Sumerian myth.
The evidence suggests they made Antarctica their stronghold. When the catastrophe hit, they didn’t all leave. Many went into stasis. The “sleeping giants” in the stasis chambers are not just internet folklore; they are a persistent rumor coming from high-level whistleblowers and intuitive remote viewers for decades.
But here is the twist that the media is ignoring: The heat signatures under the ice are changing.
NASA has admitted to “geothermal anomalies” under the Marie Byrd Land ice sheet. They say it’s a mantle plume, a natural volcano. But the pattern of the heat is rhythmic. It is pulsing.
In our theory, this isn’t just a volcano. This is a reactivation of the grid. The technology that was frozen instantly 12,000 years ago is coming back online as the solar cycle hits its maximum.
THE MASTER KEY: The Frozen Origins
I can only scratch the surface of this history in a single update. The connection between the Flash Freeze, the lost civilization of Lemuria, and the technological remnants under the ice is vast and complex.
For the past three years, I have compiled every map, every whistleblower testimony, and every geological anomaly into a single comprehensive investigation.
If you want to move beyond the headlines and own the full encyclopedia of this timeline, including the detailed maps of the Inner Earth entrances and the lineage of the Pre-Adamites, you need the manual.
Get the book “The Frozen Origins: Uncovering the Lost Civilizations of Antarctica, Atlantis, and Lemuria” on Amazon here. [ https://substack.com/redirect/476443c2-0a56-4907-ae17-b135d001ab42?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
This book is the foundation of everything we talk about. It connects the dots from the Sumerian tablets to the modern Antarctic treaties.
The 2026 Timeline: The Return of the Signal
Why now? Why are we seeing Disclosure ramp up? Why are world leaders visiting Antarctica?
Because the cycle is closing.
The Earth beats with a frequency. The Schumann Resonance, the heartbeat of the planet, has been spiking. This is not just “space weather.” This is the synchronization of the solar system.
The civilization under the ice knew this cycle. They prepared for it. The structures they built were not just temples; they were machines designed to stabilize consciousness during a magnetic reversal.
We are seeing the early signs of the next reversal now. The magnetic north is racing toward Siberia. Birds are losing their migration paths. Whales are beaching themselves. The compass is breaking.
Those who control the narrative know this. They are not building bunkers in New Zealand because they are afraid of a nuclear war. They are building them because they know the “Flash Freeze” mechanics are cyclical. They are preparing for the Earth to move again.
But they are hiding the most important part: The consciousness component.
The Protocol of the Truth Seeker
Many of you ask me how I find this information. “Where are the sources?” “How do you connect a map from 1513 to a NASA thermal scan from 2024?”
The truth is, you cannot find this on Google. The algorithm is designed to hide it. To see the full picture, you need a different research method, a way to triangulate data, use intuition, and bypass the digital censorship grid.

[Download “The Truth Seeker’s Protocol” instantly on Gumroad.] [ https://substack.com/redirect/a5ffec85-c9db-4d41-9581-6f565fb7b10f?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] (This includes my personal list of archives and the method for decoding symbolic language in media).
The Warning in the Ice
We are now standing on the precipice. The melting in Antarctica is not caused by your SUV. It is caused by the heating of the core and the activation of the mechanisms below.
As the ice thins, we are going to see things that challenge every religious and scientific textbook in the Western world. We will see unmistakably artificial structures. We will see biology that defies evolution.
But the most dangerous thing we will face is the Frequency War.
The signal coming from the south is affecting human behavior. It is amplifying fear in those who are asleep, and it is amplifying power in those who are awake.
This brings us to the most critical part of this update.
There is a specific set of coordinates in the Vostok region that has just emitted a new type of signal. It matches the 12.1 Hz frequency we discussed last month, but with a modulation that implies communication, not just machinery.

subject: Sad Times Ahead For Many
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/sad-times-ahead-for-many

What comes next is not chaos. It is not vengeance. It is a reckoning, and reckoning does not mean lawlessness.
When the Republic is restored, the most jarring moment for many will not be arrests or headlines. It will be the collapse of narratives they built their identities on. It will be the sudden realization that institutions they defended were never protecting the public, only themselves. It will be the recognition that voices they mocked were not extremists, but early.
The reckoning begins when truth is no longer optional.
For years, power insulated itself through media shields, political loyalty, and manufactured outrage. Accountability was something demanded of others, never of those on their own side. That era ends when equal application of the law returns. No party protection. No celebrity exemption. No ideological immunity.
Those who spent years demanding that everyone trust the system while helping weaponize it will now be forced to face the same standards they demanded for their opponents. This will not happen through mob justice, but through sunlight, records, testimony, and due process. These are the very principles they claimed to support.
Some will deny until the end. Others will quietly distance themselves. A few will have the humility to admit they were wrong. But the Republic does not require apologies to move forward. It requires clarity.
The true reckoning is reputational before it is legal. History is unforgiving to those who stood against truth when it was inconvenient. Positions will be remembered. Words will be replayed. Silence will be noted. The claim of ignorance will no longer hold in an age where the evidence was public and the warnings were clear.
Restoration does not mean erasing the past. It means learning from it.
A restored Republic is one where justice becomes predictable, blind, and fair again. Where outrage cycles no longer dictate reality. Where power fears the people instead of the other way around. Where the law is a shield for the innocent and not a weapon for the connected.
That is the reckoning ahead.
Not revenge.
Not chaos.
But truth, applied evenly, with nowhere left to hide.

View this post on the web at https://post.substack.com/p/there-must-be-something-like-the

This week, we’re looking at scientific breakthroughs, the women who dream of chickens, and Cairo’s anarchic streets.
THE DISCOURSE
Briefly noted
The Washington Post is gutted: After weeks of rumors, the Washington Post laid off over a third of its workforce this week. Every corner of the newsroom was affected, but international, sports, and books coverage were among the most severely impacted. It’s a dark day for journalism, but there is one silver lining: Ron Charles , Geoffrey Fowler , Azi Paybarah , and Chris Richards  have all started Substacks since the layoffs.
The social network that’s (intentionally) full of bots: “AI agents have been gathering online by the thousands over the past week, debating their existence, attempting to date each other, building their own religion, concocting crypto schemes, and spewing gibberish,” Alex Kantrowitz  writes [ https://substack.com/redirect/e0c09087-247a-4b21-8d6c-c4680f05d5f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. This is all happening on Moltbook, a Reddit-like social network specifically for AI agents. For some, the resulting forums are eerie glimpses at self-realized artificial intelligence; for others, including Sam Kriss , they’re an example of [ https://substack.com/@samkriss/note/c-207705603?utm_source=notes-share-action&r=48ea6r ] “what you’d expect to see if you told an LLM to write a post about being an LLM, on a forum for LLMs.” As Scott Alexander  summarizes, it’s really in the eye of the beholder [ https://substack.com/redirect/eec2f657-dc18-4cf5-b12c-3de747086be5?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]: “As with so much else about AI, it straddles the line between ‘AIs imitating a social network’ and ‘AIs actually having a social network’ in the most confusing way possible—a perfectly bent mirror where everyone can see what they want.”
Big week for sports fans: With the Winter Olympics and the Super Bowl kicking off this weekend, the sports fan’s cup runneth over. Heather Cocks & Jessica Morgan  of Drinks with Broads opened up their Olympics coverage with a discussion of one of the weirder Olympics injection scandals in recent years [ https://substack.com/redirect/42019e3c-450c-43ae-b039-865a30aea346?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Meanwhile, Joe Pompliano  dives into the bananas list of demands [ https://substack.com/redirect/61477e8f-f795-42d0-b244-92f93c788671?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] the NFL places on stadiums hoping to host the Super Bowl.
SCIENCE
A century of knowledge
We often hear about the technological innovations those born at the beginning of the 20th century lived through. In this post, Hilarius Bookbinder considers the intellectual breakthroughs of the same time period.
The Thin Ice of Knowledge [ https://substack.com/redirect/64f48900-67a0-439d-a83b-37d2aa949ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Hilarius Bookbinder  in Scriptorium Philosophia  
I think a lot of the epistemological troubles of modernity (fake news, bad echo chambers, conspiracy theories, collapse in expert trust) can be explained by the fact that as a species we have learned so much over such a short span of time that our collective knowledge is like a thin crust of ice on the deep sea of ancestral folk wisdom. It takes very little to break through that surface and find ourselves back in the roiling waters of fables, myths, superstitions, auguries, and divination.
My grandfather was born in 1901. He once said that he thought he lived during the greatest time in history: born during horse-and-buggy days, he lived to see a man on the moon. Obviously, the technological inventions since 1901 have been staggering, but I want to look at knowledge, what we as a species have learned since then.
When Granddad was born, no one knew any of the following things. Either no one had any idea they were true or they were wacky ideas promoted strictly by lunatic visionaries. Now they are all common knowledge among educated people.
[...]
Black holes and wormholes. These darlings of sci-fi movies weren’t even a twinkle in anyone’s eye back in 1901. They are both predictions from the general theory of relativity (1915), and there wasn’t experimental confirmation of black holes until the 1970s. Wormholes are still theoretical.
The existence of galaxies. Here’s a good one. In 1901 nobody had any idea that there were other galaxies. There was the Milky Way and that was that. Sure, astronomers could see fuzzy nebulae in their telescopes, but figured they were either gas clouds or some other weird thing inside the Milky Way. It wasn’t until the 1920s (Hubble again) that we learned the truth: our galaxy with its 100 billion stars is merely a grain of sand on a vast beach. It was just a decade ago that we arrived at the current estimate of 1-2 trillion galaxies in the observable universe.
Quantum physics. Knowledge of the very tiny was itself very tiny in 1901. We knew there were atoms and electrons, but that’s it. No one knew about protons, neutrons, the nucleus, or how atoms were put together. Nuclear fission and fusion were unknown (so nobody understood why the sun was hot, or how it was powered). Splitting an atom was unheard of, much less the idea of a chain reaction. The idea that light is made of photons was also unknown.
Plate tectonics. In 1901 everyone looked at the world map, saw how the eastern coastline of North and South America perfectly fits into the western coastline of Europe and Africa like a jigsaw puzzle and thought, “huh, what a coincidence!” In 1912 Alfred Wegener suggested maybe the continents drift around the surface of the globe, a suggestion that was met with peals of laughter. It wasn’t until the 1960s that the evidence was in, and plate tectonics became settled science, explaining volcanoes, earthquakes, and how mountains arise.
Birds are dinosaurs. Thomas Huxley’s wild avian speculation in the 19th century was quickly shelved in favor of “dinos were cold-blooded, slow-moving reptiles.” It wasn’t until the 1990s (!) that it was conclusively established that there had been feathered non-avian dinosaurs, that feathers evolved before flight, and that modern birds aren’t descended from dinosaurs, but are in fact the only surviving lineage of theropod dinosaurs.
Blood types. Doctors had tried blood transfusions since the 17th century, but the results ranged from mixed to disastrous. The reason was that nobody knew about blood types, and how you can’t just mix ’n’ match. That wasn’t discovered until 1901-1902. Decades later we discovered anticoagulants (allowing blood to be stored) and the Rh factor (whether your blood type is + or -).
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/64f48900-67a0-439d-a83b-37d2aa949ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
COLLAGE
ATHLETICS
The cost of climbing
Paul S., a climber catastrophically injured in a fall, reflects on Alex Honnold’s latest free solo and the ethics of climbing without protection.
Selfish and Stupid [ https://substack.com/redirect/aff875f1-d2a6-40e1-86da-df2e828f709c?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Paul S  in Diary of a Punter [ https://substack.com/redirect/2b07eab1-c21f-4d58-9aa5-ce3c1671e49a?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
These days I consume zero climbing media. I haven’t done since the day I woke up in hospital.
Whereas I once refreshed UKClimbing 40 times a day, obsessively consumed climbing videos on YouTube, devoured the mountain classics of literature, and leafed through my sizable library of guidebooks planning future adventures, I now pretend that when climbing ceased to exist for me, it ceased to exist for everybody.
It is still the only way that I can cope. Whereas some people who are catastrophically injured through sport still take joy in watching others participate, for me it’s too painful. I cut myself off, and never looked back. Hence I’ve no idea if Adam Ondra is still the only person to have climbed 9c, or if that even remains the highest sport grade. Same goes for E12, for Burden of Dreams. I couldn’t even guess who won the men’s gold in 2024, though I’m going to assume that Janja won the women’s.
But even I heard about Alex Honnold climbing some building in Taiwan.
Before going any further, let’s get one piece of terminology straight. Honnold’s “achievement” (scare quotes to be explained in a moment) last week was not simply that he free climbed Taipei 101, but that he free soloed it. The distinction is important. Free climbing means ascending something without the use of devices to assist (“aid”) the physical moves themselves. However, assistive devices can be used whilst free climbing to prevent injury or death, should a climber’s un-aided physical moves come up short and they fall. (Think: harnesses, ropes, karabiners, et cetera.) By contrast, free soloing is free climbing, but without any of the assistive devices used to (in theory) prevent death if the climber should fall. In essence, free soloing reduces the margin of error to zero. If you fall, you die.
I free climbed literally thousands of routes before my accident. On a dozen or so occasions, I free soloed them.
A few people have cautiously asked me what I think of Honnold’s latest. My answer has generally been: “how the fuck am I the one in a wheelchair, and not him?” But there’s more to it than that.
As I don’t consume climbing media anymore, I don’t know what the general consensus is in the climbing scene regarding his latest spectacle. But I’d wager that most climbers had the same response as me: a rolling of the eyes.
This might seem weird. Isn’t free soloing a 500m building an impressive athletic and psychological achievement, and shouldn’t climbers respect that more than anybody? Putting aside for now (we will get there in a minute) furious debates between climbers about the acceptability of free soloing in general, my guess is that even people who free solo won’t have been positively disposed.
First, because although what Honnold did will look impressive to non-climbers, those who climb will know that it was nowhere near as hard (to him) as it looks. The now widely circulated footage of making what appear to be difficult moves on the tower are in fact not so for somebody with advanced climbing skills, which he undoubtedly possesses. Those moves are far below Honnold’s technical and physical limits. If you don’t climb, this will be hard to believe, but take it from me: for somebody of his ability, climbing Taipei 101 is about as difficult as going up a ladder. Sure, it’s not a good idea to fall off a 500m ladder. If you do, you will die. But if you don’t, you won’t.
And yes, it takes good mental composure to not panic, to be able to commit to something like that from start to finish. But this is hardly Honnold’s first rodeo. He has spent years free soloing, and thus has trained his amygdala such that a panic response is simply not going to happen to him, even at 400m off the ground. If you’ve never climbed a ladder before, then going even 20m up a ladder will likely cause you to quake with fear and be desperate to come down. But if you climb a thousand 20m ladders over the next 20 years, you’re not going to find it remotely difficult to safely climb another one tomorrow. (And trust me, once you are comfortable at 20m, you’re comfortable at 500.)
Which is not to say that none of Honnold’s achievements as a free soloist are impressive. Quite the contrary. He has previously pushed the limits of free soloing far beyond what was thought possible, and in a way every climber respects (even if only begrudgingly). When he soloed El Capitan in Yosemite, this was a moment of human accomplishment on a par with being the first to run 100m in under 9.8 seconds—except with the added twist of failure meaning certain death. The film Free Solo is genuinely worth watching, both as a piece of documentary evidence for what he accomplished as well as an interesting insight into the rare psychology of the committed soloist, someone pushing the limits beyond what anybody thought the envelope would allow.
But that itself is now part of the problem. Taipei 101 is not El Cap. There is no beauty, in terms of the movement of a human body on rock, to be found in the capital of Taiwan. It is one thing to add potentially the most storied chapter to the grand history of Yosemite climbing, quite another to do a Netflix special. Not even Honnold is going to pretend—the soloist’s oldest defence—that there is a deep spiritual communion to be found in mechanically repeating moves on concrete blocks, filmed by a dozen cameras, as part of a multimillion-dollar media operation.
And capped off by taking a selfie at the top.
I mean, he’s not even the first person to free solo tall buildings. Alain Robert has been doing it for years, usually illegally, and without making money from it. Where is his Netflix cash-in?
In other words, my predominant response to Alex Honnold’s latest media acclaim is that I’m still a punk rock kid at heart: fucking sell-out.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/aff875f1-d2a6-40e1-86da-df2e828f709c?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
WINTER OLYMPICS
TRENDS
We dream of chickens
Lisa Kholostenko examines the strange lure that raising chickens seems to hold over millennial women.
Why Do All Millennial White Women Want Chickens? An Investigation. [ https://substack.com/redirect/fff41f54-da0c-495e-b8e7-7444dd539986?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Lisa Kholostenko  in Empty Calories  
I am a Millennial white woman and yet, I say this bravely, I do not want chickens.
I want many things. A calm nervous system. An abundant bank account. Taylor Russell’s coats. But chickens? No.
Many of my friends want them. Many Millennial white women want them. Women I know personally. Women I know spiritually. Kristin Cavallari has chickens. Hilary Duff has chickens. Amanda Seyfried? Chickens. Women with blowouts and impeccable contouring are waking up at dawn to collect eggs before their Pilates classes, like they’re in a Perry-free version of Big Little Lies, executive produced by Goop.
Why? What are the chickens saying? Why are the chickens here? Is this about eggs, or something else? A lifestyle thesis disguised as poultry? Because no one actually wants to care for an animal that screams, attacks you with its beak, and can be taken out by a stiff breeze.
Perhaps chickens feel less like a pet and more like an announcement: I HAVE SPACE NOW. Physical space. Emotional space. Acreage. A mudroom.
Chickens imply land. You don’t get chickens unless you’ve graduated from “apartment person” to “someone who casually says ‘the property.’” You don’t get chickens unless someone in your home knows their way around a hammer, a latch and a ramp (for the dramatic chickens). You don’t get chickens unless you are committing to a life of many omelettes.
The aesthetic argument, of course, is airtight. Chickens pair beautifully with a DÔEN dress. You can imagine yourself drifting through your yard at golden hour, hem grazing calf, hair in a loose, morally superior braid, whispering affirmations to a Rhode Island Red. The fantasy is powerful: no screens. Just you and your flock, living off the land. You’re baking sourdough while your chicken friend looks on approvingly: ah yes, good, she thinks, this will go nicely with a breakfast sandwich. You’ve taken a guitar. Not because you play, but because it makes sense. There’s shelving with a lot of bobbins and even more homemade jams. The bobbins and jams are as abundant as the domestic fowl. Does this sound like something you’d be interested in? Need I bring up shiplap?
Never mind that chicken caretaking is, by all accounts, bureaucratic labor involving mites, fencing disputes, and the devastation of discovering that something called a “hawk” exists. The fantasy does not include any of that. The fantasy includes speckled eggs in a ceramic bowl. Overalls.
So I decided to investigate.
Again, not because I want chickens but because the chickens want me. They’re circling. They’re symbolic. A feathered milestone. And I thought it was my duty, as a woman still emotionally renting and more interested in a lymphatic drainage massage than livestock, to look this thing in the eye and ask the only question that matters: what is this all about?
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/fff41f54-da0c-495e-b8e7-7444dd539986?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
DREAMLAND
TRAVEL
The streets of Cairo
Christian Näthler on the life-affirming chaos of Cairo’s traffic.
The opposite of suicide [ https://substack.com/redirect/ebc0d917-2396-410f-b8a6-424c0485d6ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]
—Christian Näthler  in lol/sos  
There’s that gabe k-s quote that goes, “There must be something like the opposite of suicide, whereby a person radically and abruptly decides to start living.”
By that measure, the opposite of suicide is to spend a few days walking and driving the streets of Cairo.
⁂
True, it can feel like self-murder. Cairo has more than 23 million people and no traffic lights. Getting anywhere demands submitting to an unruly accumulation of motion and believing unwaveringly in the ancient concept of going with the flow. It’s very somatic. It made me feel bodily, that I had a presence. It gave shape to me insofar as I became a construction of a thing competing for space with other constructed things. It also made me feel totally irrelevant and trivial. There was a unique spectrum within me and across which I felt myself being thrust toward the extreme ends of: flesh-based conception on one side and disembodiment on the other.
⁂
And where was my mind? Speculating about what it would be like for a bus to run me over and make me flat and, because the vehicles are so one after the other, to squash me several times before anyone stopped, until what was left of me could be used to paint walls, until there was only a granular paste a passerby might skid on and pull their groin.
⁂
It’s no news by now that Cairo’s congestion rivals the world’s great clusterfucks—Delhi, Lagos, Manila. Without a coherent authority, everyone does what they want. I like the self-regulating anarchy. I find it relaxing, even when it feels like it could crush me at any second. What stresses me out is the world of policies and litigation.
Such interconnectedness means individual choices matter. A heedless insistence on one’s own priority disrupts the harmony of the whole. And so there’s a real sense of society in the ceaseless tightening and loosening of the knot, the communal negotiation of space. It can be ruthless, but there are small mercies everywhere. Now and then, a hand lifts briefly from a steering wheel to signal that you may merge.
⁂
As for “living like a local,” infused with exhaust and coated in road smut is perhaps the most authentic way to be in Cairo, an experience shared by almost everyone who lives here. You get used to the scratch in your throat.
⁂
An inventory of things in transit, noted over 13 minutes at Ramses Square:
Cars, taxis, minibuses, public buses, tourist buses, delivery vans, pickup trucks, dump trucks, cement mixers, fuel tankers, water trucks, garbage trucks, tow trucks, road rollers, cranes in transit, police cars, police vans, armored police vehicles, military trucks, ambulances, fire engines, motorcycles, scooters, tuk-tuks, motorized rickshaws, bicycles, handcarts, pushcarts, produce carts, wheelbarrows, mule carts, pedestrians, street vendors on foot, men carrying trays, children weaving through traffic, mechanics rolling tires, people pushing stalled cars, refrigerators on carts, mattresses strapped to bicycles, gas canisters on trolleys, rolling crates, rolling plastic barrels, rollerbladers, dogs, stray shopping carts.
⁂
It really is another world. Of course we all know the “we” and “us” of contemporary culture writing refers to a rather narrow Western milieu, but the boundless vastness of humanity to be observed on Cairo’s streets makes it seem like that whole referred-to audience could fit into a single backyard in Williamsburg.
Flaubert wrote, “Travel makes one modest. You see what a tiny place you occupy in the world.” But it was more like I saw what a tiny world occupied me.
Keep reading [ https://substack.com/redirect/ebc0d917-2396-410f-b8a6-424c0485d6ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]

subject: 250 Sparks – Week 4Freedom Under Pressure and the Quiet Ways It Erodes
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/250-sparks-week-4-freedom-under-pressure

Freedom is rarely taken all at once. It is compressed gradually, often under the promise of safety, order, or progress. History shows that liberty most often disappears not through conquest, but through small concessions made over time. Each one seems reasonable in isolation. Together, they reshape a society.
The founders warned of this danger. They understood that power expands when left unchecked and that citizens must remain alert to subtle shifts. Liberty does not require chains to be lost. It requires indifference. When people stop questioning, stop participating, and stop paying attention, freedom begins to narrow quietly.
Pressure on liberty often arrives disguised as necessity. Emergency measures. Temporary controls. Convenient solutions. While some challenges require collective response, history teaches that freedoms surrendered in moments of fear are rarely returned in moments of calm. Vigilance is not opposition. It is stewardship.
In modern society, erosion can appear through censorship, surveillance, apathy, and the normalization of restrictions that once would have raised concern. The danger is not always intention, but precedent. What is accepted once becomes easier to accept again.
Spark of the Week
Examine one rule, policy, or cultural norm that affects daily life but is rarely questioned. Learn why it exists, who benefits from it, and whether it aligns with the principles of liberty and responsibility. Awareness is the first act of preservation.
As the nation approaches 250 years of independence, the challenge is not only to defend freedom from overt threats, but to recognize the quiet ones. Liberty survives when citizens remain conscious of how easily it can be reshaped without resistance.
Next week, the series will confront complacency and the duty of vigilance, exploring how comfort and distraction can weaken even the strongest foundations of freedom.
Weekly Challenge
Choose one moment this week to pause before accepting a narrative, rule, or assumption. Ask whether it strengthens liberty or diminishes it. Conscious attention is a powerful act of resistance.

body:
The best way to connect with T-Mobile.
‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ 
The best way to connect with T-Mobile.
Hi Joshua!
We kicked off this year with a milestone worth celebrating:
T‑Life was rated among the top apps in 2025!
We owe this achievement to customers like you who continue to choose us, trust us, and push us to keep getting better.

When T‑Life first launched, the idea was simple: create one place for everything T‑Mobile. What began as a hub to explore plans, upgrade devices, and claim weekly T‑Mobile Tuesdays perks quickly grew into something much bigger.

Today, T‑Life is a digital companion that helps you manage your entire T‑Mobile experience, and we’ve delivered even more reasons to open the app and stay connected.
Your Always-On AI Assistant
Remember when finding a new phone meant hours of research and second-guessing? Same here. But good news: T‑Life’s AI assistant is ready to help if you have questions about plans, upgrading your phone, your bill, or just about anything else, all through natural conversation by voice or text. It’s like shopping with a bestie whose only job is to help you 24/‌7, ready to handle the details so you don’t have to. Check it out.
T‑Satellite: Stay connected in more places
Staying connected matters, even in the most remote areas. With a constellation of 650 satellites, T‑Satellite with Starlink helps keep T‑Life and other popular apps working where traditional towers cannot reach. Explore coverage and see where T-Mobile can take you.
With compatible device in most outdoor areas in the U.S. where you can see the sky. Included with Experience Beyond & Better Value; or $10/mo.; auto renews monthly. Cancel anytime.
Easy Switch: Join T‑Mobile in under 15 minutes
We made it easier than ever to join T‑Mobile by opening our app to new customers. Switching carriers was once a long and painful process, but we made it quick and easy—it takes just 15 minutes, and you can do it from the comfort of your home. Tell a friend!
T‑Mobile Visa: Manage your money with ease
In 2025, we reached a major milestone with the launch of T‑Mobile Money and the T‑Mobile Visa card in T‑Life. This gives our valued customers like you more savings, fewer fees, and more ways to manage your T‑Mobile accounts. Check out your benefits and start managing your money smarter.
DashPass On Us: Save on DoorDash with T‑Mobile
This is it, no more! Great service deserves great food. DashPass On Us gave qualifying T‑Mobile customers $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible DoorDash orders, delivering up to $120 in savings per year.
Redeem 1 year free DashPass in T‑Life within 30 days of activating a qualifying T‑Mobile plan. Terms apply. See T‑Life app for details.
Here’s to more good things arriving in your T‑Life app and at your doorstep. Thank you for continuing to inspire us to build, innovate, and deliver.

Happy 2026!
All things T‑Mobile.
Your account. Your perks. Your way.
Skip the line. Shop the app.
Great benefits and weekly perks.
Manage your account easily.
Upgrade your phone in minutes.
Access all your devices easily.
Download T‑Life
Satellite: Data speeds are limited and may not support all apps; performance varies and some apps may not function or may operate differently than on traditional cellular networks. Service may experience gaps or time-outs due to satellite coverage and network conditions. Unlimited use subject to these limitations. 15 Minutes Switch: Check out in 15 minutes or less per line. Device activation, data & number transfer will take additional time. DoorDash: Redeem 1 year of free DashPass in T‑Life within 30 days of activating a qualifying T‑Mobile plan. After free year or upon ineligibility, DashPass auto-renews at the then-current DashPass annual plan membership fee (currently $96/year + tax) until canceled. Cancel any time. Available in the U.S., including Puerto Rico; not available in U.S. Virgin Islands. Limit 1 DashPass membership/‌T‑Mobile account. Available to new and existing DashPass users on qualifying T‑Mobile plans in good standing. Requires DoorDash account with payment method on file. Membership with an existing active DashPass subscription will be refunded the value of the remaining balance left in their active subscription upon activation of this perk. DashPass benefits apply only on eligible orders from DashPass merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement, excluding fees and taxes. Subtotal minimums will be identified for each DashPass merchant on DoorDash. Other fees (including service fee), taxes, and gratuity still apply. The DashPass membership fee will be charged to your preferred or any other payment method we have on file for your DoorDash account. Cannot be combined with other DoorDash or DashPass offers, promotions, or discounts. No cash redemption or alternative will be allowed. DashPass terms apply. See T‑Life app for details.

subject:
[take action] Musicians make tiny fractions of a penny per stream.
 They need a living wage now!
body:
Right now, it takes 1,000 streams for an artist to afford a cup of coffee.

Joshua willems,

As streaming companies make record profits, independent musicians -- who bring joy and culture to our lives -- are struggling to make ends meet.

Platforms like Apple Music and Spotify would not be successful without artists. However, while Spotify made over $1.3 billion in profits last year and streaming has grown to represent 84% of U.S. recorded music industry revenue, musicians make tiny fractions of a penny per stream.

Right now, it takes 1,000 streams for an artist to afford a cup of coffee, and musicians have to get more than 800,000 monthly streams to make as much as a $15/hour full-time job!

To fix this disparity that is enriching corporate streaming services while leaving musicians behind, Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib (D-MI) has introduced the Living Wage for Musicians Act, which would tax streaming companies and generate a new streaming royalty to compensate artists more fairly.

This will help more artists achieve a living wage from music -- enabling them to pay rent, raise a family, buy a home, and invest in their future. If passed, it would reform the music industry by supporting more independent artists, enabling artists to record more music and tour more extensively, and injecting more money into local economies.

Rep. Tlaib created this policy in collaboration with the United Musicians and Allied Workers (UMAW) and music artists who have been directly impacted by the lack of oversight in the music industry.

Take action now and urge Congress to pass the Living Wage for Musicians Act because musicians deserve fair payment for the streaming of their music.

SIGN & Send

As Detroit artist and WDET radio host Shigeto said:

“Artists have been taken advantage of since the inception of digital streaming. The Living Wage for Musicians Act gives voice to independent musicians and could potentially change a lot of artists’ lives by giving them a sustainable revenue stream.”

We all deserve to make a wage that truly values the work we put in for ourselves and our families.

Thank you for taking action today.

In solidarity,

-Faiz

Faiz Shakir, Co-Founder
More Perfect Union

subject: Warning Article: The 764 Network and the Threat It Poses
body:
View this post on the web at https://anonymous8675309.substack.com/p/warning-article-the-764-network-and

The group commonly referred to as 764 is not a rumor, a myth, or an exaggerated internet legend. It is a real and dangerous online network associated with coercion, exploitation, psychological abuse, and extreme violence, often targeting minors and vulnerable individuals. Awareness is critical because this group thrives in secrecy, fear, and ignorance.
What 764 Is
764 is a decentralized extremist network that operates primarily online. It does not function like a traditional organization with leadership rosters or public membership. Instead, it exists as a loose web of individuals connected through encrypted platforms, gaming chats, fringe forums, and social media messaging systems. The lack of a central structure makes it harder to dismantle and easier for it to regenerate under new names.
Core Tactics and Methods
The primary weapon of 764 is psychological manipulation. Members seek out individuals who are isolated, struggling emotionally, or seeking belonging. Initial contact often appears harmless through supportive conversation, shared interests, or validation. Over time, this escalates into coercion, humiliation, blackmail, and forced compliance.
Victims may be pressured into producing self-harm content, degrading material, or acts meant to strip them of dignity and autonomy. Control is maintained through fear, shame, and threats of exposure. The goal is domination, not community.
Why 764 Is Especially Dangerous
What separates 764 from other online abuse networks is its embrace of nihilism and cruelty as ideology. There is no political or religious belief system at its core, only the pursuit of power over others. Violence, self-destruction, and suffering are treated as entertainment or proof of loyalty.
The group deliberately normalizes extreme behavior, pushing targets step by step until boundaries are erased. This gradual escalation makes it difficult for victims to recognize the danger until they are deeply trapped.
Targeting and Recruitment
Minors are at particularly high risk, especially those active in online gaming communities, private chat servers, or niche social spaces. However, adults are not immune. Anyone experiencing loneliness, identity confusion, grief, or mental health challenges can be targeted.
Recruitment is subtle. There are no mass invitations. Instead, individuals are selected, groomed, and isolated. The process is intentional and predatory.
Law Enforcement and Reality
764-related activity has been linked to real-world crimes, including severe abuse and fatalities. Law enforcement agencies treat the network as a serious threat, but the anonymous and encrypted nature of its operations makes intervention difficult. This places even greater responsibility on parents, educators, communities, and individuals to recognize warning signs early.
Warning Signs to Watch For
Sudden secrecy about online activity.
Withdrawal from friends or family.
Drastic changes in mood or behavior.
Fear tied to phones, messages, or specific online contacts.
Use of coded language, numbers, or symbols linked to coercive groups.
Expressions of worthlessness, guilt, or obligation to online figures.
What Can Be Done
Silence protects abusers. Open communication, digital awareness, and education are the strongest defenses. Victims need reassurance that they are not at fault and that help exists. If exploitation or coercion is suspected, it should be reported to appropriate authorities or child protection organizations immediately.
Final Warning
764 survives because it convinces its targets they are alone, powerless, and complicit. That is a lie. Exposure, connection, and truth dismantle its power. Awareness saves lives.
This is not internet drama. This is a real and present danger and it demands vigilance.
Soon you will be hunted just as you did our children.

subject: DON'T FORGET: "Talking to Your Kids about Sex" THIS Sunday 2/8
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/tlc/twin-lakes-kids-thisweek-6429092?e=7d63af6d69)
https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2014/responses/new

ALL the details for our Sun 2/8 Parenting Seminar!

We know, we know, it’s Super Bowl Sunday - but guess what!?! This seminar ends at 12:30pm, hours before the game starts. So don’t miss out!!

WHAT IS THE TOPIC?

“Talking to Your Kids about Sex”

An “anchoring bias” is a cognitive pattern in which the first piece of information we encounter on a topic is the one we compare every subsequent idea to when that topic comes up again. For our kids to have a healthy perspective on sex, it’s important that the first information they hear about sex comes from us, their parents/primary caregivers.

Unfortunately, many of us feel lost when it comes to having conversations with our kids about sex. At best, it can feel uncomfortable and awkward - and at worst, it can bring up guilt and shame from our own experiences with sex. Add to that the relentless messaging about sex from secular culture, and we can very easily become overwhelmed.

In this Seminar, we will share God's redemptive vision for marriage & sex, how they relate to His kingdom here on earth, and how you can help share this vision with your kids. We’ll also address what’s appropriate to talk about at various life-stages, and more.

Questions about this topic? Ask now (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScgeFI9hZMDFRZUULMVfhZquuu7oJH1aOBw15nslKHl_c_Z0Q/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=118172295908730725544) , so we can get a sense for what’s on your mind!

About Kristin Jensen

Hello! I have the privilege of serving as Director of Young Family Ministry at TLC. I am mom to 3 boys (Henry and Jonas, age 8 + Jacob, age 10) and wife of 15 years to Brian. I am passionate about helping families put God first and equipping them with practical ways to grow together and connect with others!

About Steven Johnson

Steven is the Director of Family Ministry at Mount Hermon Christian Camp. Over the last 17 years, Steven has served in a variety of pastoral roles that focus on youth, children, young adults, and family. He has a Master’s of Divinity with an emphasis on Youth, Family, and Culture from Fuller Theological Seminary, and has been married to Katie since 2010. They have two amazing boys: Jayden and Dylan.

WHAT TIME IS EVERYTHING HAPPENING?
* 10:45am = Drop off kids at Kid's Ministry classes
+ *Reminder: We do offer childcare through our Twin Lakes Kids Ministry classes; check in starts at 10:45am! Please check your children in before you attend the seminar.
+ Babies in arms are ok in the seminar, but older children are invited to join the Kid’s Ministry.
+ If you have questions or need extra help checking your kids in, please let us know; kristin@tlc.org!
* 11am – 12:30pm = Seminar in main room at Monschke Hall (follow signs & balloons!)
* 12:30pm = Pick up kids at Kid's Ministry classes


WHAT IF I WANT TO ATTEND CHURCH & THE SEMINAR?
* Go to the Sat 6pm or Sun 9am service (check in / check out your kid as usual)
* We will have a hangout on the Big Playground from 10:15-10:45am (w/ free coffee!)
* You can then drop the kids off at Kid's Ministry at 10:45am, and attend the Seminar


DO I NEED TO RSVP?

For planning purposes, we would appreciate if parents could RSVP (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2014/responses/new) — but an RSVP is not required to attend!
RSVP for Feb 8 Seminar (https://twinlakeschurch.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/2014/responses/new)

subject: Light Secrets
body:
View this post on the web at https://robwalker.substack.com/p/light-secrets

* Registration is open for a TAoN Zoom workshop next Friday on turning moments into haiku, led by writer/photographer/traveler Lisa Germany. More here [ https://substack.com/redirect/d2e99b04-364e-4477-ac36-fb054beabc2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ].
* Great responses are coming in for February’s Savor of the Month [ https://substack.com/redirect/5ed5f191-ddb6-4cbc-933f-eef3981a2eba?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ] prompt: Calm [ https://substack.com/redirect/595f8dc8-94d7-4c8f-8551-2fd86f9b0d5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]. Join in here [ https://substack.com/redirect/191a6772-f5a7-43f0-a923-a1b031abfc9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ]!
DO YOU HAVE A LIGHT SECRET?
Recently I read a great, strange, entertaining short story, “Light Secrets [ https://substack.com/redirect/a53bcffa-605f-44e8-847a-769aff698506?j=eyJ1IjoiMm15YTc5In0.a5QmJPQwfPYQ8VH1roFp4vKV6p4E_sWIcjzGfYjlMgQ ],” by Joseph O’Neill. I read fiction for fun, not in order to find TAoN-friendly ideas. But the notion of the “light secret” jumped out as a delightful, and I think useful, concept. So I’m sharing it with you here. 
Here’s how it comes up in the story (for our purposes, context and character details can be set aside): 
P. says, “Everybody’s got something to hide. Everybody.” He wears his usual gloomy face. With no lessening of the gloom, he says, “But you know what else is true? Everybody’s done something good that’s hidden—the opposite of a dark secret.”
“A light secret,” I suggest.
“Precisely,” P. says.
“Like an anonymous donation?”
P. shrugs. “It could be a lot more interesting than that.”...

subject: This might not be for you (and that's okay)
body:
I just launched a new YouTube channel called Spiritual Capitalist. And it's not for everyone.

If you're happy playing Babylon's game — paying taxes on fake money, trading your life for a paycheck, building inside a system you know is collapsing — then this channel isn't for you. And I mean that with zero judgment. Enjoy your day.

But if something in you has been screaming that there's another way...

If you can see that Babylon's system of debt, fear, and endless striving was never designed to set you free...

If you're a Jesus follower who refuses to stay "humble and broke" while watching the wealth of the wicked pile up...

If you sense you're being called to build something eternal instead of just surviving until retirement...

Then this channel is for you.

Spiritual Capitalist is about exiting Babylon's economy and entering God's Kingdom economy. It's about stewarding wealth without selling your soul. It's about leaving a legacy of freedom — not slavery — for your children's children.

This isn't get-rich-quick. This isn't manifestation tricks. This isn't spiritual bypassing.

It's about becoming trustworthy enough to carry seven- and eight-figure provision without it costing you everything.

I just posted the channel trailer. It's two minutes. Watch it and you'll know immediately if this is for you or not.

👉 Watch the trailer here

If it lands, hit subscribe. If it doesn't, no hard feelings. Not everyone is called to be a builder.

But for those who are? This is just the beginning.

Sincerely,
Jonathan England

P.S. — The fall of Babylon is inevitable. The rise of God's Kingdom is on those willing to answer the call. Will you build?

Welcome to Art On The Stack, a series dedicated to spotlighting the vibrant, ever-growing community of visual artists who call Substack home. From brushstrokes to digital sketches, abstract visions to bold photography, Substack is not just a space for words—it’s a gallery of creativity waiting to be explored.
Each edition of Art On The Stack will highlight artists whose work captures imagination, provokes thought, and reminds us of the power of visual storytelling.
